Section 6 uses invented numbers (quality 0.90 at cost 1 against 0.91 at cost 100) to show Utility = Quality - lambda x Cost. With lambda 0 or 0.0001 the expensive method wins, and from lambda 0.001 the cheap one wins. The real choice is the value of lambda for your product, and it depends on latency, money and the cost of being wrong.","bodyKn":"ವಿಭಾಗ 3 ಪಾಠದ router ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ಸುಲಭ direct ಗೆ, verifier ಇಲ್ಲದ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ReAct ಗೆ, verifier ಇಲ್ಲದ ಕಠಿಣ ToT ಗೆ, verifier ಇರುವ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಅಪಾಯದ ಕಠಿಣ LATS ಗೆ. Verifier ಇರುವ ಆದರೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆದ್ಯತೆಯ ಕಠಿಣ ಕಾರ್ಯ ReAct ಗೆ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ, verifier ಇರುವ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ಕಾರ್ಯವೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ. ವಿಭಾಗ 6 ಕಲ್ಪಿತ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು (ವೆಚ್ಚ 1 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ 0.90 ವಿರುದ್ಧ ವೆಚ್ಚ 100 ರಲ್ಲಿ 0.91) ಬಳಸಿ Utility = Quality - lambda x Cost ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. lambda 0 ಅಥವಾ 0.0001 ರಲ್ಲಿ ದುಬಾರಿ ವಿಧಾನ ಗೆಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು lambda 0.001 ರಿಂದ ಅಗ್ಗದ್ದು. ನಿಜವಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಕ್ಕೆ lambda ಮೌಲ್ಯ, ಮತ್ತು ಅದು ವಿಳಂಬ, ಹಣ ಮತ್ತು ತಪ್ಪಾಗುವ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿತ."}},{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Production Design","textKn":"Production ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ","level":"H2"}},{"type":"table","data":{"headingEn":"Questions for choosing a search architecture","headingKn":"ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಆರಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು","headers":["Question","If the answer is yes"],"rows":[["Is the task hard and does a single trajectory often fail?","Consider search at all"],["Can candidates be checked cheaply and reliably (tests, parser, calculator)?","Search becomes much more attractive; prefer the verifier to model judgment"],["Is the environment predictable enough to plan up front?","Consider ReWOO-style planning instead"],["Is latency or cost tight?","Gate the search: cheap attempt first, escalate on failure"],["Is correctness valuable enough to pay for many candidates?","ToT or LATS may be justified"]]}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Escalation, Stopping and the Evaluator Bottleneck","headingKn":"ಏರಿಕೆ, ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ಮತ್ತು Evaluator ತಡೆ","bodyEn":"A practical agent tries a cheap path, verifies, and escalates to reflection and then to search only if verification fails. Every search needs stopping rules: goal reached, iteration or token budget, time budget, no improvement for N rounds, or hand-off to a human. The evaluator is usually the bottleneck. Combine model judgment with environment checks, weight objective checks higher, and remember that tests can be incomplete. Search also costs tokens, latency, tool calls and, for state-changing tools, side effects, so a search that executes real actions needs idempotency and approval, not only a good score.","bodyKn":"ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ agent ಅಗ್ಗದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ, ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ, ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ವಿಫಲವಾದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ reflection ಗೆ ನಂತರ ಹುಡುಕಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಏರುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಹುಡುಕಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಬೇಕು: ಗುರಿ ತಲುಪಿದೆ, ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ ಅಥವಾ token budget, ಸಮಯ budget, N ಸುತ್ತು ಸುಧಾರಣೆ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಅಥವಾ ಮನುಷ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರ. Evaluator ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ತಡೆ. ಮಾದರಿ ವಿವೇಚನೆಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಸರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ವಸ್ತುನಿಷ್ಠ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ತೂಕ ನೀಡಿ, ಮತ್ತು tests ಅಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿರಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ನೆನಪಿಡಿ. ಹುಡುಕಾಟಕ್ಕೆ tokens, ವಿಳಂಬ, tool ಕರೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಬದಲಿಸುವ tools ಗೆ side effects ವೆಚ್ಚವೂ ಇದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಿಜವಾದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸುವ ಹುಡುಕಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಅಂಕ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, idempotency ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಮೋದನೆ ಬೇಕು."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Why AI Uses This","headingKn":"AI ಇದನ್ನು ಏಕೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ","bodyEn":"Deliberate search is how extra inference compute is turned into reliability on hard problems with checkable candidates, and gating it keeps the cost proportional to difficulty. Production routers decide per request based on difficulty, verifier availability and stakes.","bodyKn":"ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ಇರುವ ಕೋಡ್ ದುರಸ್ತಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ: ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿ patches ಗೆ ಪರಿಸರ ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಾತ್ಮಕ ಗಣಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಒಗಟು ಪರಿಹಾರ value ಮಾದರಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಉದ್ದದ ವೆಬ್ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು plan-and-search ಮಿಶ್ರಣ ಬಳಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸುಲಭ ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ರೂಪಣ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದನ್ನೂ ಬಳಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. Production routers ಕಷ್ಟ, verifier ಲಭ್ಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾಯದ ಆಧಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ವಿನಂತಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Common Misconception","headingKn":"ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ತಪ್ಪು ಕಲ್ಪನೆ","bodyEn":"Misconception: "more search always improves the answer." Verifier: a check of candidate correctness. Escalation: moving from a cheap method to a stronger one on failure. Search gate: the rule that chooses the architecture. Evaluator bottleneck: search quality limited by value-function quality. Section 6 uses invented numbers (quality 0.90 at cost 1 against 0.91 at cost 100) to show Utility = Quality - lambda x Cost. Verifier ಇರುವ ಆದರೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆದ್ಯತೆಯ ಕಠಿಣ ಕಾರ್ಯ ReAct ಗೆ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ, verifier ಇರುವ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ಕಾರ್ಯವೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ. ವಿಭಾಗ 6 ಕಲ್ಪಿತ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು (ವೆಚ್ಚ 1 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ 0.90 ವಿರುದ್ಧ ವೆಚ್ಚ 100 ರಲ್ಲಿ 0.91) ಬಳಸಿ Utility = Quality - lambda x Cost ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. lambda 0 ಅಥವಾ 0.0001 ರಲ್ಲಿ ದುಬಾರಿ ವಿಧಾನ ಗೆಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು lambda 0.001 ರಿಂದ ಅಗ್ಗದ್ದು. ನಿಜವಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಕ್ಕೆ lambda ಮೌಲ್ಯ, ಮತ್ತು ಅದು ವಿಳಂಬ, ಹಣ ಮತ್ತು ತಪ್ಪಾಗುವ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿತ."}},{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Production Design","textKn":"Production ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ","level":"H2"}},{"type":"table","data":{"headingEn":"Questions for choosing a search architecture","headingKn":"ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಆರಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು","headers":["Question","If the answer is yes"],"rows":[["Is the task hard and does a single trajectory often fail?","Consider search at all"],["Can candidates be checked cheaply and reliably (tests, parser, calculator)?","Search becomes much more attractive; prefer the verifier to model judgment"],["Is the environment predictable enough to plan up front?","Consider ReWOO-style planning instead"],["Is latency or cost tight?","Gate the search: cheap attempt first, escalate on failure"],["Is correctness valuable enough to pay for many candidates?","ToT or LATS may be justified"]]}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Escalation, Stopping and the Evaluator Bottleneck","headingKn":"ಏರಿಕೆ, ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ಮತ್ತು Evaluator ತಡೆ","bodyEn":"A practical agent tries a cheap path, verifies, and escalates to reflection and then to search only if verification fails. Every search needs stopping rules: goal reached, iteration or token budget, time budget, no improvement for N rounds, or hand-off to a human. The evaluator is usually the bottleneck. Combine model judgment with environment checks, weight objective checks higher, and remember that tests can be incomplete. Search also costs tokens, latency, tool calls and, for state-changing tools, side effects, so a search that executes real actions needs idempotency and approval, not only a good score.","bodyKn":"ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ agent ಅಗ್ಗದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ, ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ, ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ವಿಫಲವಾದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ reflection ಗೆ ನಂತರ ಹುಡುಕಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಏರುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಹುಡುಕಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಬೇಕು: ಗುರಿ ತಲುಪಿದೆ, ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ ಅಥವಾ token budget, ಸಮಯ budget, N ಸುತ್ತು ಸುಧಾರಣೆ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಅಥವಾ ಮನುಷ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರ. Evaluator ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ತಡೆ. ಮಾದರಿ ವಿವೇಚನೆಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಸರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ವಸ್ತುನಿಷ್ಠ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ತೂಕ ನೀಡಿ, ಮತ್ತು tests ಅಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿರಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ನೆನಪಿಡಿ. ಹುಡುಕಾಟಕ್ಕೆ tokens, ವಿಳಂಬ, tool ಕರೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಬದಲಿಸುವ tools ಗೆ side effects ವೆಚ್ಚವೂ ಇದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಿಜವಾದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸುವ ಹುಡುಕಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಅಂಕ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, idempotency ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಮೋದನೆ ಬೇಕು."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Why AI Uses This","headingKn":"AI ಇದನ್ನು ಏಕೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ","bodyEn":"Deliberate search is how extra inference compute is turned into reliability on hard problems with checkable candidates, and gating it keeps the cost proportional to difficulty. title: Self-Refine and CRITIC: Iterative Output Improvement (Part 1 of 3) — Generate, Feedback, Refine and History
titleKn: Self-Refine ಮತ್ತು CRITIC: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿತ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ (ಭಾಗ 1 / 3) — Generate, Feedback, Refine ಮತ್ತು ಇತಿಹಾಸ
desc: Build the Self-Refine loop with history and an iteration budget, verify the 59/60-character boundary, find that a passing critique can hide mid-word truncation and that the loop returns no success flag, and see with a constructed pair what history prevents.
objectives: Explain generate, feedback and refine and why they should be separate roles.
Implement a refinement loop with history, a semantic stop and an iteration budget.
Explain why feedback must be specific and actionable.
Show that termination is not success and that a deterministic check proves only what it measures.
Explain the cost of iteration and the limit of pure self-feedback.
objectivesKn: Generate, feedback ಮತ್ತು refine ವಿವರಿಸಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಅವು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳಾಗಿರಬೇಕು ಏಕೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಸಿ.
ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಅರ್ಥಗರ್ಭಿತ ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ budget ಇರುವ ಪರಿಷ್ಕರಣೆ loop ಅಳವಡಿಸಿ.
Feedback ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು ಏಕೆ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
ಮುಕ್ತಾಯ ಯಶಸ್ಸಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಅಳೆಯುವುದನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಾಬೀತುಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸಿ.
ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಶುದ್ಧ ಸ್ವಯಂ-feedback ನ ಮಿತಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

The generator returns four bullets on purpose, so there is something to correct. feedback checks two deterministic constraints (exactly three bullets, each under 60 characters, so a 59-character line passes and a 60-character line fails). format_history turns attempts into text a prompt could include. refine removes extra bullets and shortens long ones.","descKn":"Attempt ಒಂದು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ಅದರ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಮತ್ತು critique. ತಿದ್ದಲು ಏನಾದರೂ ಇರಲಿ ಎಂದು generator ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು bullets ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. feedback ಎರಡು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ (ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಮೂರು bullets, ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು 60 ಅಕ್ಷರಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ 59-ಅಕ್ಷರ ಸಾಲು ಪಾಸ್, 60-ಅಕ್ಷರ ಸಾಲು ವಿಫಲ). format_history attempts ಅನ್ನು prompt ಒಳಗೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದಾದ ಪಠ್ಯವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. refine ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ bullets ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ದದವನ್ನು ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"from dataclasses import dataclass

TASK = "Write exactly 3 short bullet points about Python. Each bullet must be under 60 characters."


@dataclass
class Attempt:
    iteration: int
    output: str
    critique: list[str]


def generate(task: str) -> str:
    """An intentionally imperfect first draft: four bullets where three were requested."""
    return "\n".join([
        "- Python was created by Guido van Rossum.",
        "- Python was first released in 1991.",
        "- Python is widely used for automation.",
        "- Python emphasizes readable code.",
    ])


def bullets_of(output: str) -> list[str]:
    return [line.strip() for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith("- ")]


def feedback(task: str, output: str) -> list[str]:
    issues: list[str] = []
    bullets = bullets_of(output)
    if len(bullets) != 3:
        issues.append(f"Expected exactly 3 bullets; found {len(bullets)}.")
    for number, bullet in enumerate(bullets, start=1):
        if len(bullet) >= 60:
            issues.append(f"Bullet {number} must be under 60 characters.")
    return issues


def format_history(history: list[Attempt]) -> str:
    if not history:
        return "No previous attempts."
    sections = []
    for attempt in history:
        critique_text = "\n".join(f"- {i}" for i in attempt.critique) if attempt.critique else "- No issues."
        sections.append(f"Iteration {attempt.iteration}\nOutput:\n{attempt.output}\nCritique:\n{critique_text}")
    return "\n\n".join(sections)


def refine(task: str, output: str, critique: list[str], history: list[Attempt]) -> str:
    bullets = bullets_of(output)
    has_count_problem = any("exactly 3 bullets" in issue for issue in critique)
    if has_count_problem and len(bullets) > 3:
        bullets = bullets[:3]
    revised = []
    for bullet in bullets:
        if len(bullet) >= 60:
            bullet = bullet[:56].rstrip() + "..."
        revised.append(bullet)
    return "\n".join(revised)"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"selfrefine_1.py","headingEn":"The controller, two history refiners and the experiments","headingKn":"Controller, ಎರಡು ಇತಿಹಾಸ refiners ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"self_refine is the controller: generate, then for each iteration get feedback, record the attempt, stop on an empty critique, else refine. The for-else branch runs only when the budget is exhausted without a break. forgetful_refiner and history_refiner are a constructed pair for section 8. main() runs eight experiments.","descKn":"self_refine controller: generate, ನಂತರ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಗೆ feedback ಪಡೆದು, attempt ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ, ಖಾಲಿ critique ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ, ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ refine. for-else ಶಾಖೆ break ಇಲ್ಲದೆ budget ಮುಗಿದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. forgetful_refiner ಮತ್ತು history_refiner ವಿಭಾಗ 8 ಕ್ಕೆ ರಚಿಸಿದ ಜೋಡಿ. main() ಎಂಟು ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def self_refine(task: str, max_iterations: int = 4, refiner=refine, quiet=False, generator=generate):
    history: list[Attempt] = []
    output = generator(task)
    for iteration in range(max_iterations):
        critique = feedback(task, output)
        history.append(Attempt(iteration, output, critique.copy()))
        if not quiet:
            print(f"ITERATION {iteration}: bullets={len(bullets_of(output))} critique={critique or 'none'}")
        if not critique:
            if not quiet:
                print("STOP: the feedback stage found no remaining issues.")
            break
        output = refiner(task, output, critique, history)
    else:
        if not quiet:
            print("Maximum refinement iterations reached.")
    return output, history


def shorten(bullet: str) -> str:
    return bullet if len(bullet) < 60 else bullet[:56].rstrip() + "..."


def forgetful_refiner(task, output, critique, history):
    """Constructed to forget: it reacts only to the first issue and rewrites from scratch on a length issue."""
    first = critique[0]
    if "exactly 3 bullets" in first:
        return "\n".join(bullets_of(output)[:3])
    fresh = [shorten(b) for b in bullets_of(output)] + ["- Python has a large standard library."]
    return "\n".join(fresh)          # the rewrite quietly brings back a fourth bullet


def history_refiner(task, output, critique, history):
    """Same repair, but it carries forward every constraint that any earlier critique named."""
    bullets = [shorten(b) for b in bullets_of(output)]
    earlier = [c for a in history for c in a.critique]
    if any("exactly 3 bullets" in c for c in earlier):
        bullets = bullets[:3]
    return "\n".join(bullets)


def messy_generate(task):
    return "\n".join([
        "- Python was created by Guido van Rossum.",
        "- Python is widely used in data science and machine learning.",
        "- Python was first released in 1991.",
        "- Python emphasizes readable code.",
    ])


def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    section("1. The loop as the lesson builds it")
    print("TASK:", TASK)
    final, history = self_refine(TASK)
    print("FINAL OUTPUT:")
    print(final)

    section("2. History as context for the refiner")
    print(format_history(history))

    section("3. The boundary: under 60 means 59 passes, 60 fails")
    for n in (58, 59, 60, 61):
        line = "- " + "x" * (n - 2)
        print(f"bullet of {len(line)} characters -> {feedback(TASK, chr(10).join([line] * 3)) or 'accepted'}")

    section("4. What the toy refiner does to a long bullet")
    long_output = "\n".join([
        "- Python was created by Guido van Rossum in the Netherlands.",
        "- Python is widely used in data science and machine learning.",
        "- Python emphasizes readable code.",
    ])
    print("critique before:", feedback(TASK, long_output))
    fixed = refine(TASK, long_output, feedback(TASK, long_output), [])
    print(fixed)
    print("critique after :", feedback(TASK, fixed) or "none")
    print("lengths:", [len(b) for b in bullets_of(fixed)], "- the constraint is met, but the text is cut mid-sentence")

    section("5. A stubborn refiner: termination is not success")
    stubborn = lambda task, output, critique, history: output
    final, history = self_refine(TASK, max_iterations=4, refiner=stubborn)
    print("returned output still has", len(bullets_of(final)), "bullets")
    print("the loop returns (output, history) with no success flag; the last critique was:", history[-1].critique)

    section("6. Anti-pattern: regenerate instead of refine")
    for i in range(3):
        print(f"regenerate {i}: bullets={len(bullets_of(generate(TASK)))} (the critique was thrown away)")

    section("7. Cost model (arithmetic on stated assumptions, NOT a measurement)")
    cg, cf, cr = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    print("assume generate = feedback = refine = 1 unit")
    for n in (0, 1, 2, 4):
        print(f"n={n} refinement rounds: cost ~ Cg + n*(Cf+Cr) = {cg + n * (cf + cr)} units (+ one feedback to confirm the last output)")
    per_iter = 800 + 200
    print("history growth if each attempt is 800 tokens and each critique 200:",
          [per_iter * k for k in range(1, 5)], "tokens after iterations 1..4")

    section("8. A constructed scenario: what history is for (4 bullets, one too long)")
    for name, refiner in (("forgetful refiner", forgetful_refiner), ("history-aware refiner", history_refiner)):
        print(name + ":")
        final, hist = self_refine(TASK, max_iterations=5, refiner=refiner, quiet=True, generator=messy_generate)

The generator returns four bullets on purpose, so there is something to correct. feedback checks two deterministic constraints (exactly three bullets, each under 60 characters, so a 59-character line passes and a 60-character line fails). format_history turns attempts into text a prompt could include. refine removes extra bullets and shortens long ones.","descKn":"Attempt ಒಂದು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ಅದರ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಮತ್ತು critique. ತಿದ್ದಲು ಏನಾದರೂ ಇರಲಿ ಎಂದು generator ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು bullets ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. feedback ಎರಡು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ (ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಮೂರು bullets, ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು 60 ಅಕ್ಷರಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ 59-ಅಕ್ಷರ ಸಾಲು ಪಾಸ್, 60-ಅಕ್ಷರ ಸಾಲು ವಿಫಲ). format_history attempts ಅನ್ನು prompt ಒಳಗೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದಾದ ಪಠ್ಯವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. refine ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ bullets ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ದದವನ್ನು ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"from dataclasses import dataclass

TASK = "Write exactly 3 short bullet points about Python. Each bullet must be under 60 characters."


@dataclass
class Attempt:
    iteration: int
    output: str
    critique: list[str]


def generate(task: str) -> str:
    """An intentionally imperfect first draft: four bullets where three were requested."""
    return "\n".join([
        "- Python was created by Guido van Rossum.",
        "- Python was first released in 1991.",
        "- Python is widely used for automation.",
        "- Python emphasizes readable code.",
    ])


def bullets_of(output: str) -> list[str]:
    return [line.strip() for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith("- ")]


def feedback(task: str, output: str) -> list[str]:
    issues: list[str] = []
    bullets = bullets_of(output)
    if len(bullets) != 3:
        issues.append(f"Expected exactly 3 bullets; found {len(bullets)}.")
    for number, bullet in enumerate(bullets, start=1):
        if len(bullet) >= 60:
            issues.append(f"Bullet {number} must be under 60 characters.")
    return issues


def format_history(history: list[Attempt]) -> str:
    if not history:
        return "No previous attempts."
    sections = []
    for attempt in history:
        critique_text = "\n".join(f"- {i}" for i in attempt.critique) if attempt.critique else "- No issues."
        sections.append(f"Iteration {attempt.iteration}\nOutput:\n{attempt.output}\nCritique:\n{critique_text}")
    return "\n\n".join(sections)


def refine(task: str, output: str, critique: list[str], history: list[Attempt]) -> str:
    bullets = bullets_of(output)
    has_count_problem = any("exactly 3 bullets" in issue for issue in critique)
    if has_count_problem and len(bullets) > 3:
        bullets = bullets[:3]
    revised = []
    for bullet in bullets:
        if len(bullet) >= 60:
            bullet = bullet[:56].rstrip() + "..."
        revised.append(bullet)
    return "\n".join(revised)"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"selfrefine_1.py","headingEn":"The controller, two history refiners and the experiments","headingKn":"Controller, ಎರಡು ಇತಿಹಾಸ refiners ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"self_refine is the controller: generate, then for each iteration get feedback, record the attempt, stop on an empty critique, else refine. The for-else branch runs only when the budget is exhausted without a break. forgetful_refiner and history_refiner are a constructed pair for section 8. main() runs eight experiments.","descKn":"self_refine controller: generate, ನಂತರ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಗೆ feedback ಪಡೆದು, attempt ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ, ಖಾಲಿ critique ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ, ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ refine. for-else ಶಾಖೆ break ಇಲ್ಲದೆ budget ಮುಗಿದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. forgetful_refiner ಮತ್ತು history_refiner ವಿಭಾಗ 8 ಕ್ಕೆ ರಚಿಸಿದ ಜೋಡಿ. main() ಎಂಟು ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def self_refine(task: str, max_iterations: int = 4, refiner=refine, quiet=False, generator=generate):
    history: list[Attempt] = []
    output = generator(task)
    for iteration in range(max_iterations):
        critique = feedback(task, output)
        history.append(Attempt(iteration, output, critique.copy()))
        if not quiet:
            print(f"ITERATION {iteration}: bullets={len(bullets_of(output))} critique={critique or 'none'}")
        if not critique:
            if not quiet:
                print("STOP: the feedback stage found no remaining issues.")
            break
        output = refiner(task, output, critique, history)
    else:
        if not quiet:
            print("Maximum refinement iterations reached.")
    return output, history


def shorten(bullet: str) -> str:
    return bullet if len(bullet) < 60 else bullet[:56].rstrip() + "..."


def forgetful_refiner(task, output, critique, history):
    """Constructed to forget: it reacts only to the first issue and rewrites from scratch on a length issue."""
    first = critique[0]
    if "exactly 3 bullets" in first:
        return "\n".join(bullets_of(output)[:3])
    fresh = [shorten(b) for b in bullets_of(output)] + ["- Python has a large standard library."]
    return "\n".join(fresh)          # the rewrite quietly brings back a fourth bullet


def history_refiner(task, output, critique, history):
    """Same repair, but it carries forward every constraint that any earlier critique named."""
    bullets = [shorten(b) for b in bullets_of(output)]
    earlier = [c for a in history for c in a.critique]
    if any("exactly 3 bullets" in c for c in earlier):
        bullets = bullets[:3]
    return "\n".join(bullets)


def messy_generate(task):
    return "\n".join([
        "- Python was created by Guido van Rossum.",
        "- Python is widely used in data science and machine learning.",
        "- Python was first released in 1991.",
        "- Python emphasizes readable code.",
    ])


def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    section("1. The loop as the lesson builds it")
    print("TASK:", TASK)
    final, history = self_refine(TASK)
    print("FINAL OUTPUT:")
    print(final)

    section("2. History as context for the refiner")
    print(format_history(history))

    section("3. The boundary: under 60 means 59 passes, 60 fails")
    for n in (58, 59, 60, 61):
        line = "- " + "x" * (n - 2)
        print(f"bullet of {len(line)} characters -> {feedback(TASK, chr(10).join([line] * 3)) or 'accepted'}")

    section("4. What the toy refiner does to a long bullet")
    long_output = "\n".join([
        "- Python was created by Guido van Rossum in the Netherlands.",
        "- Python is widely used in data science and machine learning.",
        "- Python emphasizes readable code.",
    ])
    print("critique before:", feedback(TASK, long_output))
    fixed = refine(TASK, long_output, feedback(TASK, long_output), [])
    print(fixed)
    print("critique after :", feedback(TASK, fixed) or "none")
    print("lengths:", [len(b) for b in bullets_of(fixed)], "- the constraint is met, but the text is cut mid-sentence")

    section("5. A stubborn refiner: termination is not success")
    stubborn = lambda task, output, critique, history: output
    final, history = self_refine(TASK, max_iterations=4, refiner=stubborn)
    print("returned output still has", len(bullets_of(final)), "bullets")
    print("the loop returns (output, history) with no success flag; the last critique was:", history[-1].critique)

    section("6. Anti-pattern: regenerate instead of refine")
    for i in range(3):
        print(f"regenerate {i}: bullets={len(bullets_of(generate(TASK)))} (the critique was thrown away)")

    section("7. Cost model (arithmetic on stated assumptions, NOT a measurement)")
    cg, cf, cr = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    print("assume generate = feedback = refine = 1 unit")
    for n in (0, 1, 2, 4):
        print(f"n={n} refinement rounds: cost ~ Cg + n*(Cf+Cr) = {cg + n * (cf + cr)} units (+ one feedback to confirm the last output)")
    per_iter = 800 + 200
    print("history growth if each attempt is 800 tokens and each critique 200:",
          [per_iter * k for k in range(1, 5)], "tokens after iterations 1..4")

    section("8. A constructed scenario: what history is for (4 bullets, one too long)")
    for name, refiner in (("forgetful refiner", forgetful_refiner), ("history-aware refiner", history_refiner)):
        print(name + ":")
        final, hist = self_refine(TASK, max_iterations=5, refiner=refiner, quiet=True, generator=messy_generate)
        for a in hist:
            print(f"  iteration {a.iteration}: bullets={len(bullets_of(a.output))} critique={a.critique or 'none'}")
        print("  ended clean:", not hist[-1].critique)
    print("our regular refine() accepts history but never reads it, so only this constructed pair shows what history buys")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

title: Self-Refine and CRITIC: Iterative Output Improvement (Part 2 of 3) — CRITIC and Tool-Grounded Verification

desc: Add an external verifier to the loop, watch it catch a false claim the structural checks accept, then find that evidence is not a repair, that coverage limits what a pass means, and that UNKNOWN must not count as PASS, with real JSON and arithmetic verifiers.
objectives: Explain why format validity does not imply factual validity.
Implement a verifier that returns passed, issues and evidence and merge it with self-feedback.
Stop the loop only when both self-feedback and external verification pass.
Demonstrate verifier coverage limits and the risk of treating UNKNOWN as PASS.
Choose deterministic verifiers (parser, calculator) where a property can be measured exactly.
objectivesKn: ರೂಪ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ ವಾಸ್ತವ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಏಕೆ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
passed, issues ಮತ್ತು evidence ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುವ verifier ಅಳವಡಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಯಂ-feedback ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ವಿಲೀನಗೊಳಿಸಿ.
ಸ್ವಯಂ-feedback ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಎರಡೂ ಪಾಸ್ ಆದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ loop ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ.
Verifier ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಮಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು UNKNOWN ಅನ್ನು PASS ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುವ ಅಪಾಯವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಿ.

from enum import Enum

from selfrefine_1 import TASK, feedback as structural_feedback, bullets_of


@dataclass
class VerificationResult:
    passed: bool
    issues: list[str]
    evidence: list[str]


@dataclass
class Attempt:
    iteration: int
    output: str
    self_feedback: list[str]
    external_feedback: list[str]
    evidence: list[str]


# The toy "external" source: a table of known-false claims, each with evidence and a replacement.
KNOWN_FALSE_CLAIMS = {
    "Python was originally created by Microsoft.": {
        "evidence": "Python was created by Guido van Rossum.",
        "replacement": "Python supports multiple programming paradigms.",
    },
}


def generate(task: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join([
        "- Python was created by Guido van Rossum.",
        "- Python was first released in 1991.",
        "- Python was originally created by Microsoft.",
    ])


def claims(output: str) -> list[str]:
    return [b[2:].strip() for b in bullets_of(output)]


def verify_external(output: str, table=KNOWN_FALSE_CLAIMS) -> VerificationResult:
    issues, evidence = [], []
    for number, claim in enumerate(claims(output), start=1):
        record = table.get(claim)
        if record is not None:
            issues.append(f"Bullet {number} contains a known false claim: {claim}")
            evidence.append(f"Verifier evidence for bullet {number}: {record['evidence']}")
    return VerificationResult(passed=not issues, issues=issues, evidence=evidence)


def merge_feedback(self_feedback, verification):
    return list(self_feedback) + list(verification.issues)


def refine(task, output, critique, evidence, history, dedupe=True):
    revised = []
    for claim in claims(output):

        revised.append("- " + (record["replacement"] if record else claim))

    history, output = [], (generator or generate)(task)
    for iteration in range(max_iterations):
        sf = feedback_fn(task, output)
        ver = verifier(output)
        history.append(Attempt(iteration, output, sf, ver.issues, ver.evidence))
        if not quiet:
            print(f"ITERATION {iteration}: self={sf or 'ok'} external={ver.issues or 'passed'}")
        if not sf and ver.passed:
            if not quiet:

            return output, history, True
        output = refiner(task, output, merge_feedback(sf, ver), ver.evidence, history)
    return output, history, False


# ---- three-state verification --------------------------------------------------------------

class VStatus(Enum):
    PASS = "pass"
    FAIL = "fail"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"


def flaky_verifier(online: bool):
    def verify(output):
        if not online:
            return VStatus.UNKNOWN, ["verifier unavailable (timeout)"]
        res = verify_external(output)
        return (VStatus.PASS if res.passed else VStatus.FAIL), res.issues
    return verify


# ---- deterministic verifiers ----------------------------------------------------------------

def verify_json(text):
    try:
        json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        return False, str(exc)
    return True, "valid JSON"


OPS = {ast.Add: operator.add, ast.Sub: operator.sub, ast.Mult: operator.mul, ast.Div: operator.truediv}


def safe_eval(expr):
    def ev(n):
        if isinstance(n, ast.Expression):
            return ev(n.body)
        if isinstance(n, ast.Constant) and isinstance(n.value, (int, float)):
            return n.value
        if isinstance(n, ast.BinOp) and type(n.op) in OPS:
            return OPS[type(n.op)](ev(n.left), ev(n.right))
        raise ValueError("expression not allowed")
    return ev(ast.parse(expr, mode="eval"))


def check_equation(claim):
    left, right = claim.split("=")
    return safe_eval(left.strip()), float(right.strip())


def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")

    def lazy_refine(task, output, critique, evidence, history):

Generator ಒಂದು ತಪ್ಪು ಹೇಳಿಕೆ ಇರುವ ಮೂರು bullets ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ರಚನಾತ್ಮಕ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳು ಪಾಸ್.","code":"from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum

from selfrefine_1 import TASK, feedback as structural_feedback, bullets_of


@dataclass
class VerificationResult:
    passed: bool
    issues: list[str]
    evidence: list[str]


@dataclass
class Attempt:
    iteration: int
    output: str
    self_feedback: list[str]
    external_feedback: list[str]
    evidence: list[str]


# The toy "external" source: a table of known-false claims, each with evidence and a replacement.
KNOWN_FALSE_CLAIMS = {
    "Python was originally created by Microsoft.": {
        "evidence": "Python was created by Guido van Rossum.",
        "replacement": "Python supports multiple programming paradigms.",
    },
}


def generate(task: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join([
        "- Python was created by Guido van Rossum.",
        "- Python was first released in 1991.",
        "- Python was originally created by Microsoft.",
    ])


def claims(output: str) -> list[str]:
    return [b[2:].strip() for b in bullets_of(output)]


def verify_external(output: str, table=KNOWN_FALSE_CLAIMS) -> VerificationResult:
    issues, evidence = [], []
    for number, claim in enumerate(claims(output), start=1):
        record = table.get(claim)
        if record is not None:
            issues.append(f"Bullet {number} contains a known false claim: {claim}")
            evidence.append(f"Verifier evidence for bullet {number}: {record['evidence']}")
    return VerificationResult(passed=not issues, issues=issues, evidence=evidence)


def merge_feedback(self_feedback, verification):
    return list(self_feedback) + list(verification.issues)


def refine(task, output, critique, evidence, history, dedupe=True):
    revised = []
    for claim in claims(output):
        record = KNOWN_FALSE_CLAIMS.get(claim)
        revised.append("- " + (record["replacement"] if record else claim))
    return "\n".join(revised)"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"selfrefine_2.py","headingEn":"critic_loop, three-state verification and deterministic verifiers","headingKn":"critic_loop, ಮೂರು-ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಾತ್ಮಕ verifiers","descEn":"critic_loop stops only when self-feedback finds nothing and the verifier passes (S AND E). VStatus gives three states, PASS, FAIL and UNKNOWN. verify_json uses the real JSON parser, and check_equation evaluates arithmetic with an allow-list AST evaluator instead of eval(). main() runs seven experiments.","descKn":"critic_loop ಸ್ವಯಂ-feedback ಏನೂ ಕಾಣದಿದ್ದಾಗ ಮತ್ತು verifier ಪಾಸ್ ಆದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ (S AND E). VStatus ಮೂರು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ: PASS, FAIL ಮತ್ತು UNKNOWN. verify_json ನಿಜವಾದ JSON parser ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು check_equation eval() ಬದಲು allow-list AST evaluator ಬಳಸಿ ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. main() ಏಳು ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def critic_loop(task, max_iterations=4, quiet=False, refiner=refine, feedback_fn=structural_feedback, verifier=verify_external, generator=None):
    history, output = [], (generator or generate)(task)
    for iteration in range(max_iterations):
        sf = feedback_fn(task, output)
        ver = verifier(output)
        history.append(Attempt(iteration, output, sf, ver.issues, ver.evidence))
        if not quiet:
            print(f"ITERATION {iteration}: self={sf or 'ok'} external={ver.issues or 'passed'}")
        if not sf and ver.passed:
            if not quiet:
                print("STOP: self-feedback found no issues and external verification passed.")
            return output, history, True
        output = refiner(task, output, merge_feedback(sf, ver), ver.evidence, history)
    return output, history, False


# ---- three-state verification --------------------------------------------------------------

class VStatus(Enum):
    PASS = "pass"
    FAIL = "fail"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"


def flaky_verifier(online: bool):
    def verify(output):
        if not online:
            return VStatus.UNKNOWN, ["verifier unavailable (timeout)"]
        res = verify_external(output)
        return (VStatus.PASS if res.passed else VStatus.FAIL), res.issues
    return verify


# ---- deterministic verifiers ----------------------------------------------------------------

def verify_json(text):
    try:
        json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        return False, str(exc)
    return True, "valid JSON"


OPS = {ast.Add: operator.add, ast.Sub: operator.sub, ast.Mult: operator.mul, ast.Div: operator.truediv}


def safe_eval(expr):
    def ev(n):
        if isinstance(n, ast.Expression):
            return ev(n.body)
        if isinstance(n, ast.Constant) and isinstance(n.value, (int, float)):
            return n.value
        if isinstance(n, ast.BinOp) and type(n.op) in OPS:
            return OPS[type(n.op)](ev(n.left), ev(n.right))
        raise ValueError("expression not allowed")
    return ev(ast.parse(expr, mode="eval"))


def check_equation(claim):
    left, right = claim.split("=")
    return safe_eval(left.strip()), float(right.strip())


def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    section("1. Self-Refine only: the structural checks accept a false claim")
    out = generate(TASK)
    print(out)
    print("structural feedback:", structural_feedback(TASK, out) or "none -> the loop would stop here")

    section("2. The external verifier disagrees")
    ver = verify_external(out)
    print("passed:", ver.passed)
    print("issues:", ver.issues)
    print("evidence:", ver.evidence)

    section("3. The CRITIC loop")
    final, hist, ok = critic_loop(TASK)
    print(final)
    print("verified:", ok)

    section("4. Evidence is not a repair: replacing a bullet with the evidence duplicates it")
    def lazy_refine(task, output, critique, evidence, history):
        rows = []
        for c in claims(output):
            rec = KNOWN_FALSE_CLAIMS.get(c)
            rows.append("- " + (rec["evidence"] if rec else c))
        return "\n".join(rows)
    final, hist, ok = critic_loop(TASK, refiner=lazy_refine)
    print(final)
    print("bullets 1 and 3 identical:", claims(final)[0] == claims(final)[2], "| loop accepted it:", ok)

    section("5. Coverage: a false claim the verifier does not know")
    def generate_unknown(task):
        return "\n".join(["- Python was created by Guido van Rossum.", "- Python was first released in 1985.", "- Python emphasizes readable code."])
    final, hist, ok = critic_loop(TASK, generator=generate_unknown)
    print("verified:", ok, "- 1985 is wrong (it was 1991) but is not in the verifier's table")

    section("6. Three-state verification: unavailable is not the same as passed")
    for online in (True, False):
        status, notes = flaky_verifier(online)(generate(TASK))
        as_bool = status != VStatus.FAIL          # the tempting two-state reading
        print(f"verifier online={online!s:<5} status={status.value:<7} notes={notes}")
        print(f"   'not failed' reading would accept: {as_bool} | strict reading accepts: {status == VStatus.PASS}")

    section("7. Deterministic verifiers beat asking a model")
    for text in ('{"name": "Alex", "age": 25}', '{"name": "Alex", "age": 25,}'):
        print(f"json {text!r:<32} -> {verify_json(text)}")
    for claim in ("17 * 24 = 418", "19 * 37 = 713", "4387 * 91 = 399217"):
        computed, claimed = check_equation(claim)
        print(f"{claim:<20} computed {computed} -> {'OK' if computed == claimed else 'WRONG'}")
    try:
        safe_eval("__import__('os').system('echo hi')")
    except ValueError as exc:

Why?","qKn":""Python was first released in 1985" loop ಅನ್ನು ಪಾಸ್ ಮಾಡಿತು. ಏಕೆ?","opts":["The refiner changed it","The claim is not in the verifier's table, so neither check flagged it","The structure was invalid","The verifier crashed"],"optsKn":["Refiner ಅದನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಿತು","ಹೇಳಿಕೆ verifier ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಯಾವ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಯೂ ಅದನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಲಿಲ್ಲ","ರಚನೆ ಅಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿತ್ತು","Verifier crash ಆಯಿತು"],"correct":1},{"q":"Why is UNKNOWN a separate verification status?","qKn":"UNKNOWN ಒಂದು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಏಕೆ?","opts":["It is faster","A verifier outage must not silently count as approval","Python requires three states","FAIL is not allowed"],"optsKn":["ಅದು ವೇಗ","Verifier ವ್ಯತ್ಯಯ ಮೌನವಾಗಿ ಅನುಮೋದನೆ ಎಂದು ಎಣಿಸಬಾರದು","Python ಗೆ ಮೂರು ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಬೇಕು","FAIL ಅನುಮತಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿಲ್ಲ"],"correct":1},{"q":"What does a passing external verifier actually show?","qKn":"ಪಾಸ್ ಆದ ಬಾಹ್ಯ verifier ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಏನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?","opts":["The output is universally correct","The checks that were run passed","The model is confident","The output is the best possible"],"optsKn":["ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಸಾರ್ವತ್ರಿಕವಾಗಿ ಸರಿ","ಚಲಾಯಿಸಿದ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳು ಪಾಸ್ ಆದವು","ಮಾದರಿಗೆ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸವಿದೆ","ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾದ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ"],"correct":1}]}}]

title: Self-Refine and CRITIC: Iterative Output Improvement (Part 3 of 3) — Evaluator-Optimizer, Stopping Rules and Guardrails
titleKn: Self-Refine ಮತ್ತು CRITIC: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿತ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ (ಭಾಗ 3 / 3) — Evaluator-Optimizer, ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಮತ್ತು Guardrails
desc: Build an evaluator-optimizer controller with structured issues, severities, three-state verification, stagnation and oscillation detection and a final guardrail, and see stop reasons as data, a verifier outage that leaves correct output unverified, and a guardrail that rescues a misconfigured suite.
objectives: Model issues with source, category, severity and evidence, and separate blocking errors from warnings.
Use PASS, FAIL and UNKNOWN so a verifier outage never counts as approval.
Detect stagnation and oscillation by comparing against all history, and bound runs with a budget.
Add an output guardrail as a final boundary and explain defense in depth.
Return stop_reason and success as data and distinguish termination from success.
objectivesKn: Source, ವರ್ಗ, ತೀವ್ರತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾದರೀಕರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ತಡೆಯುವ ದೋಷಗಳನ್ನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿ.
PASS, FAIL ಮತ್ತು UNKNOWN ಬಳಸಿ, ಆಗ verifier ವ್ಯತ್ಯಯ ಎಂದೂ ಅನುಮೋದನೆ ಎಂದು ಎಣಿಸಲ್ಪಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
ಇಡೀ ಇತಿಹಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ ನಿಶ್ಚಲತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಂದೋಲನ ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಿ, ಮತ್ತು budget ನಿಂದ ಓಟಗಳನ್ನು ಮಿತಿಗೊಳಿಸಿ.
ಅಂತಿಮ ಗಡಿಯಾಗಿ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ guardrail ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆಳದ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
stop_reason ಮತ್ತು success ಅನ್ನು ಡೇಟಾ ಆಗಿ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಕ್ತಾಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿ.

title: Tool Use and Function Calling (Part 1 of 3) — Toolformer, BFCL, Tool Schemas and the Registry
titleKn: Tool Use ಮತ್ತು Function Calling (ಭಾಗ 1 / 3) — Toolformer, BFCL, Tool Schemas ಮತ್ತು Registry
desc: Learn function calling as model-proposes, runtime-executes, build a Tool, ToolCall and ToolRegistry, see what happens when raw model arguments reach an executor, measure how descriptions affect routing, and read the compounding-reliability arithmetic.
objectives: Explain the difference between text generation and function calling and who executes what.
Describe Toolformer's loss-based filtering and the five BFCL V4 categories.
Build a registry that separates the model-facing schema from the executor.
Show why model-generated arguments must never reach an executor unvalidated.
Explain how description quality affects routing and how step reliability compounds.
objectivesKn: ಪಠ್ಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಮತ್ತು function calling ನಡುವಿನ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾರು ಏನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
Toolformer ನ loss-ಆಧಾರಿತ ಫಿಲ್ಟರಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಐದು BFCL V4 ವರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
ಮಾದರಿ-ಮುಖದ schema ಅನ್ನು executor ನಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸುವ registry ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ.
ಮಾದರಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸಿದ arguments ಮಾನ್ಯಗೊಳಿಸದೆ executor ತಲುಪಬಾರದು ಏಕೆ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸಿ.
ವಿವರಣೆ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ routing ಮೇಲೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹಂತ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಂಯೋಜಿತವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

title: Tool Use and Function Calling (Part 2 of 3) — Validation, Coercion, Safe Dispatch and Timeouts
titleKn: Tool Use ಮತ್ತು Function Calling (ಭಾಗ 2 / 3) — ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ, Coercion, ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ Dispatch ಮತ್ತು Timeouts
desc: Build the validation boundary: a JSON-schema-style validator with narrow coercion, structured errors, an AST-based calculator and a dispatcher with timeouts, then find that an arithmetic allow-list is still a resource risk and that a timeout stops waiting rather than working.
objectives: Distinguish validation, coercion, authorization and sandboxing.
Implement a validator with required, enum and unexpected-field checks and narrow coercion.
Return every outcome as a structured ToolResult with an error type.
Build a restricted calculator with an AST allow-list and see its limits.
Explain what a thread timeout does and does not guarantee.
objectivesKn: Validation, coercion, authorization ಮತ್ತು sandboxing ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿ.
ಅಗತ್ಯ, enum ಮತ್ತು ಅನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ-ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಿರಿದಾದ coercion ಇರುವ validator ಅಳವಡಿಸಿ.
ಪ್ರತಿ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ದೋಷ ವಿಧದೊಂದಿಗೆ ರಚನಾತ್ಮಕ ToolResult ಆಗಿ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸಿ.
AST allow-list ಇರುವ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಿತ calculator ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಮಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ.
Thread timeout ಏನು ಖಾತರಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಖಾತರಿಪಡಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

title: Tool Use and Function Calling (Part 3 of 3) — Parallel Calls, Routing, Dynamic Agents and State-Based Evaluation
titleKn: Tool Use ಮತ್ತು Function Calling (ಭಾಗ 3 / 3) — ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ ಕರೆಗಳು, Routing, ಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ Agents ಮತ್ತು State-Based ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ
desc: Run independent tool calls in parallel and join them by tool_use_id, test a router and find three of the lesson's routing claims fail, run a dynamic agent, evaluate final state, and see that a timed-out write can still happen and that a stress test without a race proves little.
objectives: Execute independent tool calls in parallel and correlate results by tool_use_id.
Build a router with abstention and test it on real queries, including negative-boundary effects.
Build an agent whose later actions depend on earlier observations without inventing data.
Verify outcomes with state-based postconditions instead of trusting tool results.
Explain indeterminate outcomes, idempotency and why a clean stress test is weak evidence.
objectivesKn: ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ tool ಕರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮಾನಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ಚಲಾಯಿಸಿ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಗಳನ್ನು tool_use_id ಮೂಲಕ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ.
Abstention ಇರುವ router ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ-ಗಡಿ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳೂ ಸೇರಿ ನಿಜವಾದ queries ಮೇಲೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ.
ನಂತರದ actions ಹಿಂದಿನ observations ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವ, ಡೇಟಾ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸದ agent ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ.
Tool ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ನಂಬುವ ಬದಲು state-based postconditions ಮೂಲಕ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
ಅನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ, idempotency ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ ಒತ್ತಡ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ದುರ್ಬಲ ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಏಕೆ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

This lesson replaces the earlier lesson at this position.","bodyKn":"• Type: Build · ಭಾಷೆ: Python (stdlib ಮಾತ್ರ) · ಸಮಯ: ~60 ನಿಮಿಷ. ಮೂರು ಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರನೆಯದು: ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ tool ಕರೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು correlation IDs, abstention ಇರುವ routing, ಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಬಹು-ಹಂತ agent ಮತ್ತು state-based ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ output toolcall_3.py (toolcall_1.py ಮತ್ತು toolcall_2.py ಮೇಲೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿತ) ಮೂಲಕ Python 3.14.5 ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಪಡೆದದ್ದು. Router ಪದ-ಆಧಾರಿತ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಾತ್ಮಕ, semantic ಮಾದರಿಗೆ ಬದಲಿ. ಈ ಭಾಗದ ಮೂಲ ಪಠ್ಯ ಅದರ ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣದ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು, ಮತ್ತು ಕೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪಾಠದ ವಿವರಣೆಯಿಂದ ಮರುನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ lesson ಈ ಸ್ಥಾನದ ಹಿಂದಿನ lesson ಅನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ."}},{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Parallel Tool Calls","textKn":"ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ Tool ಕರೆಗಳು","level":"H2"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Independent Calls Can Run Together","headingKn":"ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಕರೆಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಚಲಿಸಬಹುದು","bodyEn":"When one model turn requests a search, a calculation and a database lookup that need nothing from each other, running them concurrently approaches max(latencies) instead of the sum. But completion order is not request order, so each call carries a tool_use_id and every result, success or failure, carries it back. Calls that depend on each other (look up an email address, then send to it) must stay sequential, and two parallel writes to one record race.","bodyKn":"ಒಂದು ಮಾದರಿ ಸುತ್ತು ಒಂದಕ್ಕೊಂದು ಏನೂ ಬೇಡದ search, ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಡೇಟಾಬೇಸ್ ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ, ಅವನ್ನು ಏಕಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಲಾಯಿಸಿದರೆ ಮೊತ್ತದ ಬದಲು max(ವಿಳಂಬ) ಹತ್ತಿರ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಕ್ರಮ ವಿನಂತಿ ಕ್ರಮವಲ್ಲ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕರೆ tool_use_id ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ, ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಅಥವಾ ವೈಫಲ್ಯ, ಅದನ್ನು ಹಿಂದೆ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೂರು ಕರೆಗಳೂ search_web ಆಗಿರಬಹುದಾದ್ದರಿಂದ tool ಹೆಸರು ಕರೆಯನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಲಾರದು. ನಕಲು ids ಖಾತರಿ ನಾಶಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಮೊದಲೇ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಂದರ ಮೇಲೊಂದು ಅವಲಂಬಿತ ಕರೆಗಳು (ಇಮೇಲ್ ವಿಳಾಸ ಹುಡುಕಿ, ನಂತರ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ) ಅನುಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು, ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದೇ ದಾಖಲೆಗೆ ಎರಡು ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ ಬರವಣಿಗೆಗಳು ಓಟ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತವೆ."}},{"type":"diagram","data":{"headingEn":"Correlation by tool_use_id","headingKn":"tool_use_id ಮೂಲಕ ಜೋಡಣೆ","svgCode":"<svg viewBox="0 0 300 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="monospace" font-size="7">

Joining on the id restores the right mapping.","captionKn":"ಮೂರು ಕರೆಗಳು ವಿನಂತಿ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಬೇರೆ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತವೆ. id ಮೇಲೆ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಮರಳುತ್ತದೆ."}},{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Building the Runtime","textKn":"Runtime ನಿರ್ಮಿಸುವುದು","level":"H2"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"toolcall_3.py","headingEn":"create_task, parallel dispatch, correlation and the router","headingKn":"create_task, ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ dispatch, ಜೋಡಣೆ ಮತ್ತು router","descEn":"execute_parallel submits each call to a thread pool and collects results as they complete, with future_to_call kept as a second correlation layer. restore_call_order rebuilds request order by id. route_tool scores each description against the query and returns None (abstain) below a threshold. create_task changes shared state, so it can demonstrate state-based evaluation.","descKn":"execute_parallel ಪ್ರತಿ ಕರೆಯನ್ನು thread pool ಗೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಂಡಂತೆ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, future_to_call ಎರಡನೇ ಜೋಡಣೆ ಪದರವಾಗಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. restore_call_order id ಮೂಲಕ ವಿನಂತಿ ಕ್ರಮ ಮರುಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ. route_tool ಪ್ರತಿ ವಿವರಣೆಗೆ query ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಅಂಕ ನೀಡಿ ಮಿತಿಗಿಂತ ಕೆಳಗೆ None (abstain) ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. create_task ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ state-based ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ತೋರಿಸಬಹುದು.","code":"TASKS: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
NEXT_TASK_ID = 1
CREATE_DELAY = 0.0


def create_task(title: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    global NEXT_TASK_ID
    time.sleep(CREATE_DELAY)
    task_id = NEXT_TASK_ID
    NEXT_TASK_ID += 1
    TASKS[task_id] = {"id": task_id, "title": title, "completed": False}
    return {"created": True, "task": TASKS[task_id]}


def task_exists(title: str) -> bool:
    return any(t["title"] == title for t in TASKS.values())


def reset_tasks():
    global NEXT_TASK_ID
    TASKS.clear()
    NEXT_TASK_ID = 1


def full_registry() -> ToolRegistry:
    reg = build_registry()
    reg.register(Tool("create_task", "Create a new local task with a title. This changes task-store state.",
                      {"type": "object", "properties": {"title": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["title"], "additionalProperties": False},
                      1.0, create_task))
    return reg


def validate_call_ids(calls):
    seen = set()
    for c in calls:
        if c.tool_use_id in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate tool_use_id: {c.tool_use_id}")
        seen.add(c.tool_use_id)


def execute_parallel(registry, calls, max_workers=4):
    if not calls:
        return []
    validate_call_ids(calls)
    results = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(max_workers, len(calls))) as pool:
        future_to_call = {pool.submit(execute_tool_call, registry, c): c for c in calls}
        for fut in as_completed(future_to_call):
            results.append(fut.result())
    return results


def restore_call_order(calls, results):
    by_id = {r.tool_use_id: r for r in results}
    return [by_id[c.tool_use_id] for c in calls]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RouteDecision:
    tool_name: str | None
    score: float
    reason: str


def route_tool(registry, query, threshold=0.15):
    best, best_score = None, 0.0
    for tool in registry.all_tools():
        s = lexical_similarity(query, tool.description)
        if s > best_score:
            best, best_score = tool.name, s
    if best is None or best_score < threshold:
        return RouteDecision(None, round(best_score, 3), "no registered tool matched strongly enough")
    return RouteDecision(best, round(best_score, 3), "best lexical match")"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"toolcall_3.py","headingEn":"The dynamic agent and eight experiments","headingKn":"ಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ agent ಮತ್ತು ಎಂಟು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"run_customer_agent looks up a customer, and only if the account exists and is open does it build a calculator call from the returned balance. main() runs parallel and ordering experiments, duplicate ids, routing, the agent on three customers, state-based checks, a timed-out write, a thread-safety test and the reliability arithmetic.","descKn":"run_customer_agent ಗ್ರಾಹಕರನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಖಾತೆ ಇದ್ದು ತೆರೆದಿದ್ದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿದ ಬಾಕಿಯಿಂದ calculator ಕರೆ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. main() ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರಮ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು, ನಕಲು ids, routing, ಮೂರು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಮೇಲೆ agent, state-based ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳು, timeout ಆದ ಬರವಣಿಗೆ, thread-ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆ ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def run_customer_agent(registry, customer_id):
    state = {"customer_id": customer_id, "customer": None, "ten_percent": None, "completed": False, "reason": None}
    trace = []
    r = execute_tool_call(registry, ToolCall("agent_lookup", "query_db", {"customer_id": customer_id}))
    trace.append(f"query_db({customer_id}) -> {'ok' if r.ok else r.error_type}")
    if not r.ok:
        state["reason"] = "customer lookup failed"
        return state, trace
    out = r.output
    if not out["found"]:
        state["reason"] = "customer not found; no balance invented"
        return state, trace
    state["customer"] = out["customer"]
    if out["customer"]["status"] != "open":
        state.update(completed=True, reason="account is not open; no calculation needed")
        return state, trace
    expr = f"{out['customer']['balance']} * 0.10"
    r2 = execute_tool_call(registry, ToolCall("agent_calc", "run_python", {"expression": expr}))
    trace.append(f"run_python({expr!r}) -> {r2.output['result'] if r2.ok else r2.error_type}")
    if r2.ok:
        state.update(ten_percent=r2.output["result"], completed=True, reason="goal completed")
    return state, trace


def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    global CREATE_DELAY
    reg = full_registry()

    section("1. Parallel calls with different delays: completion order versus request order")
    delays = {"A": 0.30, "B": 0.05, "C": 0.15}

    def delayed(label):
        time.sleep(delays[label])
        return f"result for {label}"

    dreg = ToolRegistry()
    dreg.register(Tool("lookup", "delayed lookup", {"type": "object", "properties": {"label": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["label"], "additionalProperties": False}, 2.0, delayed))
    calls = [ToolCall(f"call_00{i}", "lookup", {"label": l}) for i, l in enumerate("ABC", 1)]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    results = execute_parallel(dreg, calls)
    wall = time.perf_counter() - t0
    print("request order   :", [c.tool_use_id for c in calls], "(all the same tool name: 'lookup')")
    print("completion order:", [r.tool_use_id for r in results])
    print("restored order  :", [r.tool_use_id for r in restore_call_order(calls, results)])
    print("mapping         :", {r.tool_use_id: r.output for r in results})
    print(f"wall time {wall:.2f}s against {sum(delays.values()):.2f}s sequential")

    section("2. Duplicate correlation ids are rejected")
    try:
        execute_parallel(dreg, [calls[0], ToolCall("call_001", "lookup", {"label": "B"})])
    except ValueError as exc:
        print("ValueError:", exc)

    section("3. Routing and abstention (lexical stand-in for a semantic router)")
    queries = ["Search public factual information about France", "Use arithmetic to calculate a numeric result",
               "Read an internal customer record", "Write a poem about rain",
               "multiply 15 and 20", "Delete customer 101"]
    for q in queries:
        d = route_tool(reg, q)
        print(f"{q:<48} -> {d.tool_name or 'NO_TOOL':<12} score={d.score}")
    print("'multiply 15 and 20' has no word in common with the calculator description, so a lexical router abstains where a semantic one would route")
    print("'Delete customer 101' routes to the read-only query_db because 'customer' matches: the verb is not considered")

    section("4. A dynamic agent: the second call exists only because of the first observation")
    for cid in (103, 102, 999):
        state, trace = run_customer_agent(reg, cid)
        print(f"customer {cid}: {state['reason']}")
        for line in trace:
            print("    ", line)
        print("     ten_percent:", state["ten_percent"], "| completed:", state["completed"])

    section("5. State-based evaluation: the call succeeded, did the world change?")
    reset_tasks()
    wanted = "Review quarterly report"
    r = execute_tool_call(reg, ToolCall("state_001", "create_task", {"title": wanted}))
    print("tool result ok:", r.ok, "| postcondition task_exists:", task_exists(wanted))
    reset_tasks()
    r = execute_tool_call(reg, ToolCall("state_002", "create_task", {"title": "Quarterly report"}))
    print("wrong title    -> tool result ok:", r.ok, "| postcondition for the REQUESTED title:", task_exists(wanted))

    section("6. A timed-out call whose work still happened")
    reset_tasks()
    CREATE_DELAY = 0.3
    r = execute_tool_call(reg, ToolCall("state_003", "create_task", {"title": "Timed out task"}), timeout_override=0.1)
    print("observation:", r.error_type, "|", r.error_message)
    print("immediately after, task exists:", task_exists("Timed out task"))
    time.sleep(0.5)
    print("0.5s later, task exists:", task_exists("Timed out task"), "| a blind retry would now create a duplicate")
    CREATE_DELAY = 0.0

    section("7. Is create_task thread-safe? 4000 parallel calls, 16 workers")
    reset_tasks()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(create_task, f"task {i}") for i in range(4000)]
        ids = [f.result()["task"]["id"] for f in futures]
    print("calls:", len(ids), "| distinct ids returned:", len(set(ids)), "| tasks stored:", len(TASKS), "| last NEXT_TASK_ID:", NEXT_TASK_ID)
    print("read-modify-write on a shared counter is a race by construction; whether this run showed it depends on the interpreter's scheduling")

    section("8. Per-step reliability compounds (independence assumed: NOT a benchmark)")
    for p, n in ((0.98, 10), (0.98, 20), (0.98, 40), (0.99, 40)):
        print(f"per-step {p} x {n:>2} steps = {p ** n:.3f}")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

NEXT_TASK_ID = 1
CREATE_DELAY = 0.0


def create_task(title: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    global NEXT_TASK_ID
    time.sleep(CREATE_DELAY)
    task_id = NEXT_TASK_ID
    NEXT_TASK_ID += 1
    TASKS[task_id] = {"id": task_id, "title": title, "completed": False}
    return {"created": True, "task": TASKS[task_id]}


def task_exists(title: str) -> bool:
    return any(t["title"] == title for t in TASKS.values())


def reset_tasks():
    global NEXT_TASK_ID
    TASKS.clear()
    NEXT_TASK_ID = 1


def full_registry() -> ToolRegistry:
    reg = build_registry()
    reg.register(Tool("create_task", "Create a new local task with a title. This changes task-store state.",
                      {"type": "object", "properties": {"title": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["title"], "additionalProperties": False},
                      1.0, create_task))
    return reg


def validate_call_ids(calls):
    seen = set()
    for c in calls:
        if c.tool_use_id in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate tool_use_id: {c.tool_use_id}")
        seen.add(c.tool_use_id)


def execute_parallel(registry, calls, max_workers=4):
    if not calls:
        return []
    validate_call_ids(calls)
    results = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(max_workers, len(calls))) as pool:
        future_to_call = {pool.submit(execute_tool_call, registry, c): c for c in calls}
        for fut in as_completed(future_to_call):
            results.append(fut.result())
    return results


def restore_call_order(calls, results):
    by_id = {r.tool_use_id: r for r in results}
    return [by_id[c.tool_use_id] for c in calls]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RouteDecision:
    tool_name: str | None
    score: float
    reason: str


def route_tool(registry, query, threshold=0.15):
    best, best_score = None, 0.0
    for tool in registry.all_tools():
        s = lexical_similarity(query, tool.description)
        if s > best_score:
            best, best_score = tool.name, s
    if best is None or best_score < threshold:
        return RouteDecision(None, round(best_score, 3), "no registered tool matched strongly enough")
    return RouteDecision(best, round(best_score, 3), "best lexical match")"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"toolcall_3.py","headingEn":"The dynamic agent and eight experiments","headingKn":"ಕ್ರಿಯಾತ್ಮಕ agent ಮತ್ತು ಎಂಟು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"run_customer_agent looks up a customer, and only if the account exists and is open does it build a calculator call from the returned balance. main() runs parallel and ordering experiments, duplicate ids, routing, the agent on three customers, state-based checks, a timed-out write, a thread-safety test and the reliability arithmetic.","descKn":"run_customer_agent ಗ್ರಾಹಕರನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಖಾತೆ ಇದ್ದು ತೆರೆದಿದ್ದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿದ ಬಾಕಿಯಿಂದ calculator ಕರೆ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. main() ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರಮ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು, ನಕಲು ids, routing, ಮೂರು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಮೇಲೆ agent, state-based ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗಳು, timeout ಆದ ಬರವಣಿಗೆ, thread-ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆ ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def run_customer_agent(registry, customer_id):
    state = {"customer_id": customer_id, "customer": None, "ten_percent": None, "completed": False, "reason": None}
    trace = []
    r = execute_tool_call(registry, ToolCall("agent_lookup", "query_db", {"customer_id": customer_id}))
    trace.append(f"query_db({customer_id}) -> {'ok' if r.ok else r.error_type}")
    if not r.ok:
        state["reason"] = "customer lookup failed"
        return state, trace
    out = r.output
    if not out["found"]:
        state["reason"] = "customer not found; no balance invented"
        return state, trace
    state["customer"] = out["customer"]
    if out["customer"]["status"] != "open":
        state.update(completed=True, reason="account is not open; no calculation needed")
        return state, trace
    expr = f"{out['customer']['balance']} * 0.10"
    r2 = execute_tool_call(registry, ToolCall("agent_calc", "run_python", {"expression": expr}))
    trace.append(f"run_python({expr!r}) -> {r2.output['result'] if r2.ok else r2.error_type}")
    if r2.ok:
        state.update(ten_percent=r2.output["result"], completed=True, reason="goal completed")
    return state, trace


def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    global CREATE_DELAY
    reg = full_registry()

    section("1. Parallel calls with different delays: completion order versus request order")
    delays = {"A": 0.30, "B": 0.05, "C": 0.15}

    def delayed(label):
        time.sleep(delays[label])
        return f"result for {label}"

    dreg = ToolRegistry()
    dreg.register(Tool("lookup", "delayed lookup", {"type": "object", "properties": {"label": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["label"], "additionalProperties": False}, 2.0, delayed))
    calls = [ToolCall(f"call_00{i}", "lookup", {"label": l}) for i, l in enumerate("ABC", 1)]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    results = execute_parallel(dreg, calls)
    wall = time.perf_counter() - t0
    print("request order   :", [c.tool_use_id for c in calls], "(all the same tool name: 'lookup')")
    print("completion order:", [r.tool_use_id for r in results])
    print("restored order  :", [r.tool_use_id for r in restore_call_order(calls, results)])
    print("mapping         :", {r.tool_use_id: r.output for r in results})
    print(f"wall time {wall:.2f}s against {sum(delays.values()):.2f}s sequential")

    section("2. Duplicate correlation ids are rejected")
    try:
        execute_parallel(dreg, [calls[0], ToolCall("call_001", "lookup", {"label": "B"})])
    except ValueError as exc:
        print("ValueError:", exc)

    section("3. Routing and abstention (lexical stand-in for a semantic router)")
    queries = ["Search public factual information about France", "Use arithmetic to calculate a numeric result",
               "Read an internal customer record", "Write a poem about rain",
               "multiply 15 and 20", "Delete customer 101"]
    for q in queries:
        d = route_tool(reg, q)
        print(f"{q:<48} -> {d.tool_name or 'NO_TOOL':<12} score={d.score}")
    print("'multiply 15 and 20' has no word in common with the calculator description, so a lexical router abstains where a semantic one would route")
    print("'Delete customer 101' routes to the read-only query_db because 'customer' matches: the verb is not considered")

    section("4. A dynamic agent: the second call exists only because of the first observation")
    for cid in (103, 102, 999):
        state, trace = run_customer_agent(reg, cid)
        print(f"customer {cid}: {state['reason']}")
        for line in trace:
            print("    ", line)
        print("     ten_percent:", state["ten_percent"], "| completed:", state["completed"])

    section("5. State-based evaluation: the call succeeded, did the world change?")
    reset_tasks()
    wanted = "Review quarterly report"
    r = execute_tool_call(reg, ToolCall("state_001", "create_task", {"title": wanted}))
    print("tool result ok:", r.ok, "| postcondition task_exists:", task_exists(wanted))
    reset_tasks()
    r = execute_tool_call(reg, ToolCall("state_002", "create_task", {"title": "Quarterly report"}))
    print("wrong title    -> tool result ok:", r.ok, "| postcondition for the REQUESTED title:", task_exists(wanted))

    section("6. A timed-out call whose work still happened")
    reset_tasks()
    CREATE_DELAY = 0.3
    r = execute_tool_call(reg, ToolCall("state_003", "create_task", {"title": "Timed out task"}), timeout_override=0.1)
    print("observation:", r.error_type, "|", r.error_message)
    print("immediately after, task exists:", task_exists("Timed out task"))
    time.sleep(0.5)
    print("0.5s later, task exists:", task_exists("Timed out task"), "| a blind retry would now create a duplicate")
    CREATE_DELAY = 0.0

    section("7. Is create_task thread-safe? 4000 parallel calls, 16 workers")
    reset_tasks()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(create_task, f"task {i}") for i in range(4000)]
        ids = [f.result()["task"]["id"] for f in futures]
    print("calls:", len(ids), "| distinct ids returned:", len(set(ids)), "| tasks stored:", len(TASKS), "| last NEXT_TASK_ID:", NEXT_TASK_ID)
    print("read-modify-write on a shared counter is a race by construction; whether this run showed it depends on the interpreter's scheduling")

    section("8. Per-step reliability compounds (independence assumed: NOT a benchmark)")
    for p, n in ((0.98, 10), (0.98, 20), (0.98, 40), (0.99, 40)):
        print(f"per-step {p} x {n:>2} steps = {p ** n:.3f}")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

title: Agent Memory: Virtual Context and Memory Paging (Part 1 of 3) — Context Is Not Memory, the Main Context and Compaction
titleKn: Agent Memory: Virtual Context ಮತ್ತು Memory Paging (ಭಾಗ 1 / 3) — Context ಮೆಮೊರಿ ಅಲ್ಲ, Main Context ಮತ್ತು Compaction
desc: Understand overflow, dilution and persistence, the virtual-memory analogy and core versus archival memory; build a budgeted MainContext with compaction, and find that eviction without an archive is deletion, pinned memory can exceed the budget, and the word-based token estimate cannot see Kannada.
objectives: Distinguish a context window from memory and explain overflow, dilution and persistence.
Explain the OS virtual-memory analogy and what virtual context really means.
Implement a MainContext with pinned core memory, rolling messages and automatic compaction.
Show that eviction without archiving is permanent loss and that pinned memory has a cost.
Explain why a word-based token estimate fails for non-English text.
objectivesKn: Context window ಮತ್ತು ಮೆಮೊರಿ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಉಕ್ಕಿ ಹರಿಯುವಿಕೆ, ದುರ್ಬಲಗೊಳ್ಳುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರತೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
OS virtual-memory ಹೋಲಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು virtual context ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಏನರ್ಥ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
ಪಿನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ core ಮೆಮೊರಿ, ಉರುಳುವ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತ compaction ಇರುವ MainContext ಅಳವಡಿಸಿ.
Archiving ಇಲ್ಲದ eviction ಶಾಶ್ವತ ನಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ಪಿನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮೆಮೊರಿಗೆ ವೆಚ್ಚವಿದೆ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸಿ.
ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಅಲ್ಲದ ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಪದ-ಆಧಾರಿತ token ಅಂದಾಜು ವಿಫಲವಾಗುವುದು ಏಕೆ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

The mapping is main context is RAM, external context is disk, a memory record is a page, a memory write is a page-out, retrieval is a page-in, a missing fact is a page fault, a memory tool is a system call and the agent runtime is the kernel. Virtual context therefore means a finite main context plus large external storage plus a paging mechanism. It does not mean an infinite prompt: the window stays finite and only retrieved results enter it.","bodyKn":"MemGPT ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ಆಲೋಚನೆಯನ್ನು ಎರವಲು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ: ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬೈಟ್ ಅನ್ನು RAM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಅದಕ್ಕೆ backing store ಇದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇಕಾದಾಗ ಡೇಟಾ page in ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನಕ್ಷೆ: main context RAM, external context disk, ಮೆಮೊರಿ ದಾಖಲೆ page, ಮೆಮೊರಿ ಬರವಣಿಗೆ page-out, ಪಡೆಯುವಿಕೆ page-in, ಕಾಣೆಯಾದ ಸಂಗತಿ page fault, ಮೆಮೊರಿ tool system call ಮತ್ತು agent runtime kernel. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ virtual context ಎಂದರೆ ಸೀಮಿತ main context ಜೊತೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ಜೊತೆ paging ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ. ಅದು ಅನಂತ prompt ಎಂದರ್ಥವಲ್ಲ: window ಸೀಮಿತವಾಗಿಯೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪಡೆದ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಗಳು ಮಾತ್ರ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸುತ್ತವೆ."}},{"type":"diagram","data":{"headingEn":"Virtual Context","headingKn":"Virtual Context","svgCode":"<svg viewBox="0 0 300 215" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="monospace" font-size="7">

Messages are rolling and the oldest go first. Pinning is not free: core competes for the same budget as conversation, so what is promoted must be chosen. Working memory is simply the assembled prompt for the current task. A decision rule: needed now goes in working context, needed on most turns goes in core, could matter later goes in the archive, and otherwise do not persist.","bodyKn":"Main context ಒಳಗೆ core ಮೆಮೊರಿ prompt ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಿನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ ಹೆಸರಿಸಿದ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳನ್ನು (project, preferences, constraints) ಹೊಂದಿದೆ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅವು ಬಹುತೇಕ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಬೇಕು; ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಾರಿ ಹುಡುಕುವುದು ಕರೆಗಳನ್ನು ವ್ಯರ್ಥಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂದೇಶಗಳು ಉರುಳುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹಳೆಯವು ಮೊದಲು ಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಪಿನ್ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಉಚಿತವಲ್ಲ: core ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆಯಷ್ಟೇ budget ಗೆ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಏನನ್ನು ಬಡ್ತಿ ನೀಡಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಆರಿಸಬೇಕು. Working ಮೆಮೊರಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದ prompt. ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ನಿಯಮ: ಈಗ ಬೇಕಾದದ್ದು working context ಗೆ, ಬಹುತೇಕ ಸುತ್ತುಗಳಿಗೆ ಬೇಕಾದದ್ದು core ಗೆ, ನಂತರ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಬಹುದಾದದ್ದು archive ಗೆ, ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಉಳಿಸಬೇಡಿ."}},{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Building the Main Context","textKn":"Main Context ನಿರ್ಮಿಸುವುದು","level":"H2"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"memgpt_1.py","headingEn":"tokenize, estimate_tokens and MainContext","headingKn":"tokenize, estimate_tokens ಮತ್ತು MainContext","descEn":"estimate_tokens is the lesson's teaching approximation: the number of lowercase letter-and-digit words times 1.3, at least 1. MainContext holds max_tokens, pinned core sections and rolling messages. render() serialises them to prompt text, token_count() measures it, and add_message() appends and then calls compact(), so the component that owns the budget enforces it. compact() evicts the oldest message while the context is over budget and more than one message remains. We added an evicted list so the lesson can inspect what was lost.","descKn":"estimate_tokens ಪಾಠದ ಬೋಧನಾ ಅಂದಾಜು: ಸಣ್ಣ-ಅಕ್ಷರ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಕೆ ಪದಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಗುಣಿಸು 1.3, ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 1. MainContext max_tokens, ಪಿನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ core ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಉರುಳುವ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. render() ಅವನ್ನು prompt ಪಠ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಧಾರಾವಾಹಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, token_count() ಅದನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು add_message() ಸೇರಿಸಿ ನಂತರ compact() ಕರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ budget ಹೊಂದಿದ ಘಟಕವೇ ಅದನ್ನು ಜಾರಿಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. compact() context budget ಮೀರಿದ್ದು ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಂದೇಶ ಉಳಿದಿರುವವರೆಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಸಂದೇಶ ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಏನು ಕಳೆದುಹೋಯಿತು ಎಂದು ಪಾಠ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಲು ನಾವು evicted ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಸೇರಿಸಿದ್ದೇವೆ.","code":"import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, List


def tokenize(text: str) -> List[str]:
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())


def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    words = tokenize(text)
    return max(1, int(len(words) * 1.3))


@dataclass
class MainContext:
    max_tokens: int = 120
    core: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    messages: List[Dict[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)
    evicted: List[Dict[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)   # kept only so the lesson can inspect what was lost

    def core_text(self) -> str:
        return "\n".join(f"[CORE:{section}] {text}" for section, text in self.core.items())

    def messages_text(self) -> str:
        return "\n".join(f"{m['role'].upper()}: {m['content']}" for m in self.messages)

    def render(self) -> str:
        parts = []
        core, msgs = self.core_text(), self.messages_text()
        if core:
            parts.append(core)
        if msgs:
            parts.append(msgs)
        return "\n\n".join(parts)

    def token_count(self) -> int:
        return estimate_tokens(self.render())

    def add_message(self, role: str, content: str) -> None:
        self.messages.append({"role": role, "content": content})
        self.compact()

    def compact(self) -> None:
        while self.token_count() > self.max_tokens and len(self.messages) > 1:
            removed = self.messages.pop(0)
            self.evicted.append(removed)
            print("[COMPACT]", "evicted", removed["role"], "message:", removed["content"][:60])"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"memgpt_1.py","headingEn":"main(): seven experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಏಳು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs the tokenizer on four strings, does the overflow arithmetic, renders a context, forces compaction with a tiny budget, shows what eviction loses without an archive, tests an oversized core, and checks the estimator on Kannada.","descKn":"main() ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ tokenizer ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಉಕ್ಕಿ ಹರಿಯುವಿಕೆ ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, context ಅನ್ನು render ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಚಿಕ್ಕ budget ಜೊತೆ compaction ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, archive ಇಲ್ಲದೆ eviction ಏನು ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ದೊಡ್ಡ core ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಕನ್ನಡದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಂದಾಜನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    section("1. The tokenizer and the estimate")
    for text in ("Alice owns the evaluation pipeline.", "Hello", "", "The deadline is October 20."):
        print(f"{text!r:<42} tokens(words)={tokenize(text)} estimate={estimate_tokens(text)}")

    section("2. Why a bigger window only postpones overflow (arithmetic)")
    used, limit = 1200 * 14, 32768
    print(f"1200 tokens/turn x 14 turns = {used:,} tokens = {used / limit:.0%} of a {limit:,}-token budget")
    for turns in (14, 27, 28, 100):
        print(f"{turns:>4} turns -> {1200 * turns:>8,} tokens; over budget: {1200 * turns > limit}")

    section("3. Rendering: structured memory becomes prompt text")
    main_ctx = MainContext(max_tokens=200)
    main_ctx.core["project"] = "The active project is Orion."
    main_ctx.core["preferences"] = "The user prefers concise technical explanations."
    main_ctx.add_message("user", "What are we building?")
    print(main_ctx.render())
    print("approximate tokens:", main_ctx.token_count())

    section("4. Compaction under a tiny budget (max_tokens=50)")
    m = MainContext(max_tokens=50)
    m.core["project"] = "The active project is Orion."
    for role, text in (("user", "We need to prepare the prototype."),
                       ("assistant", "I will help organize the prototype work."),
                       ("user", "First we need traction testing."),
                       ("assistant", "Traction testing is now the active task."),
                       ("user", "Alice owns the evaluation pipeline.")):
        m.add_message(role, text)
        print(f"   after add: tokens={m.token_count()} messages={len(m.messages)}")
    print("\nrendered context now:")
    print(m.render())
    print("core survived:", "[CORE:project]" in m.render())

    section("5. Eviction is not forgetting only if something archived it")
    lost = [e["content"] for e in m.evicted]
    print("evicted from the working context:", lost)
    print("is that exact message still in main.messages?", any(x["content"] == "We need to prepare the prototype." for x in m.messages))
    print("nothing else stored it, so it is gone")

    section("6. Edge case: pinned core memory larger than the budget")
    big = MainContext(max_tokens=20)
    big.core["rules"] = " ".join(["Never modify the production database."] * 6)
    big.add_message("user", "hello there")
    big.add_message("user", "second message")
    print("core tokens:", estimate_tokens(big.core_text()), "| budget:", big.max_tokens, "| total now:", big.token_count())
    print("messages left:", len(big.messages), "(compaction stops at one message, still over budget)")

    section("7. Genuinely checking the estimator on Kannada text")
    en = "Alice owns the evaluation pipeline."
    kn = "ಆಲಿಸ್ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಪೈಪ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ವಿಳಂಬವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ."
    print("English :", estimate_tokens(en), "tokens", tokenize(en))
    print("Kannada :", estimate_tokens(kn), "token ", tokenize(kn))
    import contextlib, io

    def first_eviction(text, budget=100):
        ctx = MainContext(max_tokens=budget)
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            for n in range(1, 400):
                ctx.add_message("user", text)
                if ctx.evicted:
                    return n, ctx.token_count()
        return None, ctx.token_count()

    for label, text in (("English", en), ("Kannada", kn), ("empty text", "")):
        n, tok = first_eviction(text)
        print(f"{label:<10} first eviction after {n} messages (budget 100)")
    print("the Kannada run behaves exactly like empty messages: only the 'USER' label is counted, so the message content is invisible to the budget")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

''                                         tokens(words)=[] estimate=1

--- 2. Why a bigger window only postpones overflow (arithmetic) ---
1200 tokens/turn x 14 turns = 16,800 tokens = 51% of a 32,768-token budget
  14 turns ->   16,800 tokens; over budget: False
  27 turns ->   32,400 tokens; over budget: False
  28 turns ->   33,600 tokens; over budget: True
 100 turns ->  120,000 tokens; over budget: True

Core ಸಾಲು "[CORE:project] The active project is Orion." ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಭಾಗ 5 ಮುಖ್ಯ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ: ತೆಗೆದ ಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನು ಯಾವುದೂ archive ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅದು ಹೋಗಿದೆ. ಬೇರೆಡೆ ಯಾವುದಾದರೂ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದ್ದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ eviction "ಸದ್ಯ ಲೋಡ್ ಆಗಿಲ್ಲ" ಎಂದರ್ಥ, ಅದನ್ನೇ ಭಾಗ 2 ನಿರ್ಮಿಸುತ್ತದೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Genuinely Found: Pinned Memory Can Exceed the Budget","headingKn":"ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡುಬಂದದ್ದು: ಪಿನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮೆಮೊರಿ Budget ಮೀರಬಹುದು","bodyEn":"Section 6 pins a 41-token rule block under a budget of 20. Pinned memory is not free and also needs limits, summarisation, replacement or demotion to the archive, and the loop also guarantees the single remaining message survives even when it alone is too large.","bodyKn":"ವಿಭಾಗ 6 20 ರ budget ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 41-token ನಿಯಮ ಗುಂಪನ್ನು ಪಿನ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. Compaction "hello there" ತೆಗೆದು, ಒಂದು ಸಂದೇಶ ಉಳಿದಾಗ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ loop ಕೊನೆಯ ಸಂದೇಶ ತೆಗೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಮತ್ತು 20 ರ budget ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಒಟ್ಟು 45 tokens. Compaction ಉರುಳುವ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಕುಗ್ಗಿಸಬಲ್ಲದು. ಪಿನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ ಮೆಮೊರಿ ಉಚಿತವಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಅದಕ್ಕೂ ಮಿತಿಗಳು, ಸಾರಾಂಶ, ಬದಲಿ ಅಥವಾ archive ಗೆ ಇಳಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಬೇಕು, ಮತ್ತು loop ಉಳಿದ ಒಂದೇ ಸಂದೇಶ ಅದೊಂದೇ ತುಂಬಾ ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ಉಳಿಯುವುದನ್ನು ಖಾತರಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Genuinely Found: The Token Estimate Is Blind to Kannada","headingKn":"ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡುಬಂದದ್ದು: Token ಅಂದಾಜಿಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕಾಣುವುದಿಲ್ಲ","bodyEn":"Section 7 tests the estimator on a Kannada sentence. tokenize returns an empty list and estimate_tokens returns 1, against 6 for the English sentence. With a budget of 100, English messages trigger the first eviction after 13 messages, while Kannada messages take 78, exactly the same as empty messages: only the "USER" label is counted and the content is invisible to the budget. For a bilingual platform that is a real bug: a Kannada conversation would overflow the real model long before this budget noticed. Budget with the target model's own tokenizer, which counts every script, and keep a safety margin.","bodyKn":"ವಿಭಾಗ 7 ಒಂದು ಕನ್ನಡ ವಾಕ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಂದಾಜನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. tokenize ಖಾಲಿ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು estimate_tokens 1 ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ವಾಕ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ 6 ವಿರುದ್ಧ. ಮಾದರಿ a ಯಿಂದ z ಮತ್ತು 0 ಯಿಂದ 9 ಮಾತ್ರ ಹೊಂದಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಯಾವುದೇ ಕನ್ನಡ ಅಕ್ಷರ ಎಂದೂ ಎಣಿಕೆಯಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. 100 ರ budget ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳು 13 ಸಂದೇಶಗಳ ನಂತರ ಮೊದಲ eviction ಪ್ರಚೋದಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ 78, ಖಾಲಿ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಅದೇ: ಕೇವಲ "USER" ಲೇಬಲ್ ಎಣಿಕೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯ budget ಗೆ ಕಾಣುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ದ್ವಿಭಾಷಾ ವೇದಿಕೆಗೆ ಇದು ನಿಜವಾದ ದೋಷ: ಈ budget ಗಮನಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲೇ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆ ನಿಜವಾದ ಮಾದರಿಯನ್ನು ಉಕ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. ಗುರಿ ಮಾದರಿಯ ಸ್ವಂತ tokenizer ನಿಂದ budget ಮಾಡಿ, ಅದು ಪ್ರತಿ ಲಿಪಿಯನ್ನೂ ಎಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಸುರಕ್ಷತಾ ಅಂಚು ಇಡಿ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Compaction Versus Archiving, and FIFO Is Not Enough","headingKn":"Compaction ಮತ್ತು Archiving, ಹಾಗೂ FIFO ಸಾಕಾಗದು","bodyEn":"These are different operations. Compaction without archiving loses information, and archiving without compaction still overflows, so a robust system needs both.
