    def run_once(_):
        return llm.generate(f"Vote on this:\n{prompt}")
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=n) as pool:
        votes = list(pool.map(run_once, range(n)))
    counts = Counter(votes)
    winner = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return votes, winner


def parallel_sections(task, workers, strict=True):
    def run_worker(item):
        name, worker = item
        try:
            return name, worker(task)
        except Exception as exc:
            if strict:
                raise
            return name, f"FAILED: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(workers)) as pool:
        return dict(pool.map(run_worker, workers.items()))


def orchestrator_workers(llm, task, workers):
    selected, lowered = [], task.lower()
    if "research" in lowered:
        selected.append("researcher")
    if "code" in lowered:
        selected.append("coder")
    if not selected:
        selected.append("generalist")
    results = {}
    for worker_name in selected:
        results[worker_name] = workers[worker_name](task)
    synthesis = llm.generate(f"Synthesize worker results for task: {task}\nRESULTS:\n{results}")
    return selected, results, synthesis

    "coder": lambda task: f"Code implementation for {task}",
    "generalist": lambda task: f"General solution for {task}",

    def run_once(_):
        return llm.generate(f"Vote on this:\n{prompt}")
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=n) as pool:
        votes = list(pool.map(run_once, range(n)))
    counts = Counter(votes)
    winner = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return votes, winner


def parallel_sections(task, workers, strict=True):
    def run_worker(item):
        name, worker = item
        try:
            return name, worker(task)
        except Exception as exc:
            if strict:
                raise
            return name, f"FAILED: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(workers)) as pool:
        return dict(pool.map(run_worker, workers.items()))


def orchestrator_workers(llm, task, workers):
    selected, lowered = [], task.lower()
    if "research" in lowered:
        selected.append("researcher")
    if "code" in lowered:
        selected.append("coder")
    if not selected:
        selected.append("generalist")
    results = {}
    for worker_name in selected:
        results[worker_name] = workers[worker_name](task)
    synthesis = llm.generate(f"Synthesize worker results for task: {task}\nRESULTS:\n{results}")
    return selected, results, synthesis


WORKERS = {
    "researcher": lambda task: f"Research findings for {task}",
    "coder": lambda task: f"Code implementation for {task}",
    "generalist": lambda task: f"General solution for {task}",

title: Anthropic's Workflow Patterns: Simple Over Complex (Part 3 of 3) — Evaluator-Optimizer and the Decision
titleKn: Anthropic ನ Workflow Patterns: ಸರಳ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮೇಲು (ಭಾಗ 3 / 3) — Evaluator-Optimizer ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಧಾರ
desc: Build a bounded evaluator-optimizer loop, count model calls for all five patterns, encode the workflow-versus-agent decision as code, and find an unverified return value, an evaluator fooled by the task text and an exact-string verdict that wastes calls.
objectives: Implement a bounded evaluator-optimizer loop.
Return an honest result when the budget is exhausted.
Parse verdicts robustly instead of by exact equality.
Compare the model-call cost of the five patterns.
Apply the workflow-versus-agent decision rules.

    candidate = proposer(task)
    for iteration in range(1, max_iter + 1):
        verdict = evaluator(task, candidate)
        print(f"[iteration {iteration}] candidate={candidate!r} verdict={verdict!r}")
        if verdict == "PASS":
            return candidate
        candidate = llm.generate(f"Improve this answer using feedback '{verdict}':\n{candidate}")
    return candidate


def make_pair(llm):
    def proposer(task):
        return f"Initial answer for {task}"
    def evaluator(task, candidate):
        return llm.generate(f"Evaluate this candidate for task '{task}':\n{candidate}")
    return proposer, evaluator


def decide(*, one_call_ok, needs_tools, steps_known, categories, independent, subtasks_vary, quality_loop, next_depends_on_observations):
    if one_call_ok:
        return "direct call"
    path = ["augmented LLM"] if needs_tools else []
    if steps_known:
        if categories:
            return "routing"
        if independent:
            return "parallelization"
        if quality_loop:
            return "evaluator-optimizer"
        return "prompt chaining"
    if subtasks_vary and not next_depends_on_observations:
        return "orchestrator-workers"
    if next_depends_on_observations:
        return "agent"
    return " + ".join(path) or "prompt chaining""}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"wf_3.py","headingEn":"main(): seven sections","headingKn":"main(): ಏಳು ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs the loop, exhausts the budget, checks what is returned, lets the task text fool the evaluator, tests exact-string verdicts against a structured parser, counts model calls for all five patterns, and runs the decision function over seven example tasks.","descKn":"main() ಚಕ್ರ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಬಜೆಟ್ ಖಾಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಏನು ಹಿಂತಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಕಾರ್ಯ ಪಠ್ಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪಕವನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ, ನಿಖರ-ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್ ತೀರ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ರಚನಾತ್ಮಕ parser ಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಐದು ಮಾದರಿಗಳ ಮಾದರಿ ಕರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಏಳು ಉದಾಹರಣೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):

    class AlwaysFail(ScriptedLLM):

    section("4. Genuinely checking: the evaluator can read the answer from the task")

            return "Improved answer with evidence"

    def structured_verdict(text):

    for raw in ("PASS", "PASS.", "pass - all criteria satisfied", "FAIL: add evidence"):

    section("6. All five patterns, with measured model calls")

    candidate = proposer(task)
    for iteration in range(1, max_iter + 1):
        verdict = evaluator(task, candidate)
        print(f"[iteration {iteration}] candidate={candidate!r} verdict={verdict!r}")
        if verdict == "PASS":
            return candidate
        candidate = llm.generate(f"Improve this answer using feedback '{verdict}':\n{candidate}")
    return candidate


def make_pair(llm):
    def proposer(task):
        return f"Initial answer for {task}"
    def evaluator(task, candidate):
        return llm.generate(f"Evaluate this candidate for task '{task}':\n{candidate}")
    return proposer, evaluator


def decide(*, one_call_ok, needs_tools, steps_known, categories, independent, subtasks_vary, quality_loop, next_depends_on_observations):
    if one_call_ok:
        return "direct call"
    path = ["augmented LLM"] if needs_tools else []
    if steps_known:
        if categories:
            return "routing"
        if independent:
            return "parallelization"
        if quality_loop:
            return "evaluator-optimizer"
        return "prompt chaining"
    if subtasks_vary and not next_depends_on_observations:
        return "orchestrator-workers"
    if next_depends_on_observations:
        return "agent"
    return " + ".join(path) or "prompt chaining""}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"wf_3.py","headingEn":"main(): seven sections","headingKn":"main(): ಏಳು ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs the loop, exhausts the budget, checks what is returned, lets the task text fool the evaluator, tests exact-string verdicts against a structured parser, counts model calls for all five patterns, and runs the decision function over seven example tasks.","descKn":"main() ಚಕ್ರ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಬಜೆಟ್ ಖಾಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಏನು ಹಿಂತಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಕಾರ್ಯ ಪಠ್ಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪಕವನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ, ನಿಖರ-ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್ ತೀರ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ರಚನಾತ್ಮಕ parser ಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಐದು ಮಾದರಿಗಳ ಮಾದರಿ ಕರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಏಳು ಉದಾಹರಣೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):

title: Stateful Graph Orchestration: Durable Execution and Checkpoints (Part 1 of 3) — State, Nodes and Edges
titleKn: Stateful Graph Orchestration: Durable Execution ಮತ್ತು Checkpoints (ಭಾಗ 1 / 3) — State, Nodes ಮತ್ತು Edges
desc: Model an agent as typed state, update-returning nodes and conditional edges, and find that update() drops messages, TypedDict does not validate at runtime, random nodes break replay and cycles need budgets.
objectives: Explain durable execution and why it needs an explicit state machine.
Implement nodes that return updates and edges that route from state.
Show why a per-field merge rule is needed.
Recognise the limits of TypedDict at runtime.
Bound cycles and keep nodes replay-safe.
objectivesKn: Durable execution ಮತ್ತು ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ state machine ಏಕೆ ಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
ಅಪ್‌ಡೇಟ್ ನೀಡುವ nodes ಮತ್ತು state ಯಿಂದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಆರಿಸುವ edges ಅಳವಡಿಸಿ.
ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಲೀನ ನಿಯಮ ಏಕೆ ಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸಿ.
ಚಕ್ರಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಿತಿ ಹಾಕಿ ಮತ್ತು nodes ಅನ್ನು replay-ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿಡಿ.

    messages: list
    step: int
    route: str
    output: str
    human_approval: bool


Node = Callable


class StateGraph:
    def __init__(self):
        self.nodes, self.edges, self.conditional_edges = {}, {}, {}

    def add_node(self, name, node):
        if name in self.nodes:
            raise ValueError(f"Node already exists: {name}")
        self.nodes[name] = node

    def add_edge(self, source, target):
        self.edges[source] = target

    def add_conditional_edges(self, source, chooser, routes):
        self.conditional_edges[source] = (chooser, routes)

    def next_node(self, current, state):
        if current in self.conditional_edges:
            chooser, routes = self.conditional_edges[current]
            route = chooser(state)
            if route not in routes:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown route {route!r} from node {current!r}")
            return routes[route]
        return self.edges.get(current)

    def run(self, start, initial_state, max_steps=50, trace=None):
        state, current, steps = deepcopy(initial_state), start, 0
        while current is not None:
            steps += 1
            if steps > max_steps:
                raise RuntimeError(f"step budget of {max_steps} exceeded at node {current!r}")
            if trace is not None:
                trace.append(current)
            update = self.nodes[current](state)
            state.update(update)
            current = self.next_node(current, state)
        return state


def classify_node(state):
    message = state["messages"][-1].lower()
    if "refund" in message or "charged" in message:
        route = "refund"
    elif "bug" in message or "error" in message:
        route = "bug"
    else:
        route = "sales"
    return {"route": route, "step": state["step"] + 1}


def choose_route(state):
    return state["route"]


def refund_node(state):
    return {"output": "Refund request prepared and awaiting approval.", "step": state["step"] + 1}


def bug_node(state):
    return {"output": "Bug report prepared for the engineering queue.", "step": state["step"] + 1}


def sales_node(state):
    return {"output": "Sales inquiry prepared for follow-up.", "step": state["step"] + 1}


def build():
    g = StateGraph()
    for name, fn in (("classify", classify_node), ("refund", refund_node), ("bug", bug_node), ("sales", sales_node)):
        g.add_node(name, fn)
    g.add_conditional_edges("classify", choose_route, {"refund": "refund", "bug": "bug", "sales": "sales"})
    return g"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"lg_1.py","headingEn":"main(): seven experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಏಳು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs three requests through the same graph, checks the caller's state is untouched, shows why update() is not a reducer, shows that TypedDict does not stop a typo at runtime, forces an unknown route, runs a random node repeatedly, and bounds a cycle.","descKn":"main() ಅದೇ graph ಮೂಲಕ ಮೂರು ವಿನಂತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಕರೆಯುವವರ state ಮುಟ್ಟಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, update() reducer ಅಲ್ಲ ಏಕೆ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, TypedDict ರನ್‌ಟೈಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುದ್ರಣದೋಷ ತಡೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಜ್ಞಾತ route ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ node ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಚಕ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಮಿತಿ ಹಾಕುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    g = build()

    section("1. Same graph, different state, different path")
    for text in ("I was charged twice and need a refund.", "The app shows an error on startup.", "Do you have a team plan?"):
        trace = []
        out = g.run("classify", fresh(text), trace=trace)
        print(f"{text!r:<42} path={trace} step={out['step']}")
        print(f"   output: {out['output']}")

    section("2. The runner works on a copy of the caller's state")
    initial = fresh("I need a refund")
    g.run("classify", initial)
    print("initial state after the run:", initial)

    section("3. Genuinely checking: dict.update replaces, it does not accumulate")
    state = fresh("User: hello")
    update = {"messages": ["Agent: hi"]}
    merged = dict(state)
    merged.update(update)
    print("before:", state["messages"], "| update:", update["messages"])
    print("after state.update():", merged["messages"], "(the user's message is gone)")
    print("an append reducer is needed to get:", state["messages"] + update["messages"])

    section("4. Genuinely checking: TypedDict is a contract for tools, not for the runtime")
    g2 = StateGraph()
    g2.add_node("typo", lambda s: {"routing": "refund", "step": s["step"] + 1})
    out = g2.run("typo", fresh("x"))
    print("a node returned a misspelled key 'routing':", {k: out[k] for k in ("route", "routing") if k in out})
    print("no error was raised: 'route' stayed empty and a stray key appeared")

    section("5. Genuinely checking: an unknown route fails loudly")
    g3 = StateGraph()
    g3.add_node("classify", lambda s: {"route": "payments"})
    g3.add_conditional_edges("classify", choose_route, {"refund": "refund"})
    try:
        g3.run("classify", fresh("x"))
    except ValueError as e:
        print("ValueError:", e)

    section("6. Genuinely checking: a random node makes replay unreliable")
    rng = random.Random()
    g4 = StateGraph()
    g4.add_node("pick", lambda s: {"route": rng.choice(["refund", "bug", "sales"])})
    picks = [g4.run("pick", fresh("x"))["route"] for _ in range(8)]
    print("8 runs of the same node on the same state:", picks)
    print("a resumed workflow would not take the same branch; capture the choice in state instead")

    section("7. Cycles need a budget")
    g5 = StateGraph()
    g5.add_node("generate", lambda s: {"step": s["step"] + 1})
    g5.add_node("grade", lambda s: {"route": "fail"})
    g5.add_edge("generate", "grade")
    g5.add_conditional_edges("grade", choose_route, {"fail": "generate", "pass": None})
    try:
        g5.run("generate", fresh("x"), max_steps=10)
    except RuntimeError as e:
        print("RuntimeError:", e)

That is durable execution, and it needs the agent to be a state machine: typed state, nodes that do work, edges that choose what happens next, and a checkpoint saved after each successful node.","bodyKn":"40-ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ agent ಓಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ 38 ರಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಫಲವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಊಹಿಸಿ. ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ ಮರುಆರಂಭವಾದರೆ 37 ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಅವುಗಳ API ಕರೆಗಳು, ಮಾದರಿ ಕರೆಗಳು, ಫೈಲ್ ಬರವಣಿಗೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮಿಷಗಳ ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ನಿಮಗೆ ಬೇಕಾದದ್ದು ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ 37 ರ ನಂತರದ state ಮರುಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ 38 ರಿಂದ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುವುದು. ಅದೇ durable execution, ಮತ್ತು ಅದಕ್ಕೆ agent state machine ಆಗಿರಬೇಕು: ಟೈಪ್ ಮಾಡಿದ state, ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವ nodes, ಮುಂದೇನು ಎಂದು ಆರಿಸುವ edges, ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿ node ನ ನಂತರ ಉಳಿಸಿದ checkpoint."}},{"type":"diagram","data":{"headingEn":"The State Graph","headingKn":"State Graph","svgCode":"<svg viewBox="0 0 300 215" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="monospace" font-size="7">

    messages: list
    step: int
    route: str
    output: str
    human_approval: bool


Node = Callable


class StateGraph:
    def __init__(self):
        self.nodes, self.edges, self.conditional_edges = {}, {}, {}

    def add_node(self, name, node):
        if name in self.nodes:
            raise ValueError(f"Node already exists: {name}")
        self.nodes[name] = node

    def add_edge(self, source, target):
        self.edges[source] = target

    def add_conditional_edges(self, source, chooser, routes):
        self.conditional_edges[source] = (chooser, routes)

    def next_node(self, current, state):
        if current in self.conditional_edges:
            chooser, routes = self.conditional_edges[current]
            route = chooser(state)
            if route not in routes:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown route {route!r} from node {current!r}")
            return routes[route]
        return self.edges.get(current)

    def run(self, start, initial_state, max_steps=50, trace=None):
        state, current, steps = deepcopy(initial_state), start, 0
        while current is not None:
            steps += 1
            if steps > max_steps:
                raise RuntimeError(f"step budget of {max_steps} exceeded at node {current!r}")
            if trace is not None:
                trace.append(current)
            update = self.nodes[current](state)
            state.update(update)
            current = self.next_node(current, state)
        return state


def classify_node(state):
    message = state["messages"][-1].lower()
    if "refund" in message or "charged" in message:
        route = "refund"
    elif "bug" in message or "error" in message:
        route = "bug"
    else:
        route = "sales"
    return {"route": route, "step": state["step"] + 1}


def choose_route(state):
    return state["route"]


def refund_node(state):
    return {"output": "Refund request prepared and awaiting approval.", "step": state["step"] + 1}


def bug_node(state):
    return {"output": "Bug report prepared for the engineering queue.", "step": state["step"] + 1}


def sales_node(state):
    return {"output": "Sales inquiry prepared for follow-up.", "step": state["step"] + 1}


def build():
    g = StateGraph()
    for name, fn in (("classify", classify_node), ("refund", refund_node), ("bug", bug_node), ("sales", sales_node)):
        g.add_node(name, fn)
    g.add_conditional_edges("classify", choose_route, {"refund": "refund", "bug": "bug", "sales": "sales"})
    return g"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"lg_1.py","headingEn":"main(): seven experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಏಳು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs three requests through the same graph, checks the caller's state is untouched, shows why update() is not a reducer, shows that TypedDict does not stop a typo at runtime, forces an unknown route, runs a random node repeatedly, and bounds a cycle.","descKn":"main() ಅದೇ graph ಮೂಲಕ ಮೂರು ವಿನಂತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಕರೆಯುವವರ state ಮುಟ್ಟಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, update() reducer ಅಲ್ಲ ಏಕೆ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, TypedDict ರನ್‌ಟೈಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುದ್ರಣದೋಷ ತಡೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಜ್ಞಾತ route ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ node ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಚಕ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಮಿತಿ ಹಾಕುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    g = build()

    section("1. Same graph, different state, different path")
    for text in ("I was charged twice and need a refund.", "The app shows an error on startup.", "Do you have a team plan?"):
        trace = []
        out = g.run("classify", fresh(text), trace=trace)
        print(f"{text!r:<42} path={trace} step={out['step']}")
        print(f"   output: {out['output']}")

    section("2. The runner works on a copy of the caller's state")
    initial = fresh("I need a refund")
    g.run("classify", initial)
    print("initial state after the run:", initial)

    section("3. Genuinely checking: dict.update replaces, it does not accumulate")
    state = fresh("User: hello")
    update = {"messages": ["Agent: hi"]}
    merged = dict(state)
    merged.update(update)
    print("before:", state["messages"], "| update:", update["messages"])
    print("after state.update():", merged["messages"], "(the user's message is gone)")
    print("an append reducer is needed to get:", state["messages"] + update["messages"])

    section("4. Genuinely checking: TypedDict is a contract for tools, not for the runtime")
    g2 = StateGraph()
    g2.add_node("typo", lambda s: {"routing": "refund", "step": s["step"] + 1})
    out = g2.run("typo", fresh("x"))
    print("a node returned a misspelled key 'routing':", {k: out[k] for k in ("route", "routing") if k in out})
    print("no error was raised: 'route' stayed empty and a stray key appeared")

    section("5. Genuinely checking: an unknown route fails loudly")
    g3 = StateGraph()
    g3.add_node("classify", lambda s: {"route": "payments"})
    g3.add_conditional_edges("classify", choose_route, {"refund": "refund"})
    try:
        g3.run("classify", fresh("x"))
    except ValueError as e:
        print("ValueError:", e)

    section("6. Genuinely checking: a random node makes replay unreliable")
    rng = random.Random()
    g4 = StateGraph()
    g4.add_node("pick", lambda s: {"route": rng.choice(["refund", "bug", "sales"])})
    picks = [g4.run("pick", fresh("x"))["route"] for _ in range(8)]
    print("8 runs of the same node on the same state:", picks)
    print("a resumed workflow would not take the same branch; capture the choice in state instead")

    section("7. Cycles need a budget")
    g5 = StateGraph()
    g5.add_node("generate", lambda s: {"step": s["step"] + 1})
    g5.add_node("grade", lambda s: {"route": "fail"})
    g5.add_edge("generate", "grade")
    g5.add_conditional_edges("grade", choose_route, {"fail": "generate", "pass": None})
    try:
        g5.run("generate", fresh("x"), max_steps=10)
    except RuntimeError as e:
        print("RuntimeError:", e)
    g5.nodes["grade"] = lambda s: {"route": "pass" if s["step"] >= 3 else "fail"}
    trace = []
    out = g5.run("generate", fresh("x"), trace=trace)
    print("with a grader that passes at step 3:", trace, "| step", out["step"])"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

title: Stateful Graph Orchestration: Durable Execution and Checkpoints (Part 2 of 3) — Reducers, Checkpoints and Resume
titleKn: Stateful Graph Orchestration: Durable Execution ಮತ್ತು Checkpoints (ಭಾಗ 2 / 3) — Reducers, Checkpoints ಮತ್ತು Resume
desc: Add reducers, a checkpoint after every successful node, failure boundaries, resume and a human gate, and find that serialization can fail after work is done and that JSON in memory is not persistence.
objectives: Implement per-field reducers.
Save a checkpoint only after a node returns.
Resume from the saved next node and show earlier nodes do not rerun.
Implement a human gate with durable approval.
Identify serialization and persistence pitfalls.
objectivesKn: Node ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿದ ನಂತರ ಮಾತ್ರ checkpoint ಉಳಿಸಿ.

ಸ್ಥಿರ ಅನುಮೋದನೆ ಇರುವ ಮಾನವ gate ಅಳವಡಿಸಿ.

    state: AgentState
    next_node: Optional[str]
    last_completed_node: Optional[str]
    checkpoint_number: int


def replace_reducer(old, new):
    return deepcopy(new)


def append_reducer(old, new):
    return deepcopy(old) + deepcopy(new)


class MemoryCheckpointer:
    """Serialises to JSON text but keeps it in process memory: checkpoint semantics, not durability."""

    def __init__(self):
        self._storage = {}

    def save(self, session_id, checkpoint):
        self._storage[session_id] = json.dumps(checkpoint)

    def load(self, session_id):
        raw = self._storage.get(session_id)
        return None if raw is None else json.loads(raw)

    def update_state(self, session_id, updates):
        checkpoint = self.load(session_id)
        if checkpoint is None:
            raise ValueError(f"No checkpoint for {session_id!r}")
        checkpoint["state"].update(updates)
        self.save(session_id, checkpoint)


class StateGraph:
    def __init__(self, checkpointer):
        self.checkpointer = checkpointer
        self.nodes, self.edges, self.conditional_edges, self.reducers = {}, {}, {}, {}
        self.executed = []

    def add_node(self, name, node):
        self.nodes[name] = node

    def add_edge(self, source, target):
        self.edges[source] = target

    def add_conditional_edges(self, source, chooser, routes):
        self.conditional_edges[source] = (chooser, routes)

    def set_reducer(self, field, reducer):
        self.reducers[field] = reducer

    def merge_update(self, state, update):
        new_state = deepcopy(state)
        for key, value in update.items():
            reducer = self.reducers.get(key, replace_reducer)
            new_state[key] = reducer(new_state.get(key), value)
        return new_state

    def next_node(self, current, state):
        if current in self.conditional_edges:
            chooser, routes = self.conditional_edges[current]
            route = chooser(state)
            if route not in routes:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown route {route!r} from {current!r}")
            return routes[route]
        return self.edges.get(current)

    def _execute(self, session_id, state, current, checkpoint_number):
        while current is not None:
            print(f"[execute] node={current}")
            self.executed.append(current)
            try:
                update = self.nodes[current](state)
            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"[stopped] node={current} reason={exc}")
                raise
            state = self.merge_update(state, update)
            following = self.next_node(current, state)
            checkpoint_number += 1
            self.checkpointer.save(session_id, {"state": state, "next_node": following,
                                                "last_completed_node": current, "checkpoint_number": checkpoint_number})
            print(f"[checkpoint {checkpoint_number}] completed={current} next={following}")
            current = following
        return state

    def run(self, session_id, start, initial_state):
        return self._execute(session_id, deepcopy(initial_state), start, 0)

    def resume(self, session_id):
        cp = self.checkpointer.load(session_id)
        if cp is None:
            raise ValueError(f"No checkpoint for {session_id!r}")
        print(f"[resume] checkpoint={cp['checkpoint_number']} last_completed={cp['last_completed_node']} next={cp['next_node']}")
        return self._execute(session_id, cp["state"], cp["next_node"], cp["checkpoint_number"])


def refund_with_messages(state):
    return {"messages": ["Agent: Refund request prepared."], "output": "Refund request prepared and awaiting approval.", "step": state["step"] + 1}


def human_gate_node(state):
    if not state["human_approval"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Human approval required")
    return {"messages": ["Human approval received."], "step": state["step"] + 1}


def send_node(state):
    return {"messages": ["Final response sent."], "output": state["output"] + " Approved and sent.", "step": state["step"] + 1}

MemoryCheckpointer json.dumps ನಿಂದ ಧಾರಾವಾಹಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. _execute ಹೃದಯ: ಚಲಾಯಿಸು, ವಿಲೀನಿಸು, ಮುಂದಿನದು ಆರಿಸು, ಉಳಿಸು, ಮುಂದುವರಿ, run() ಮತ್ತು resume() ಎರಡೂ ಅದನ್ನು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. resume() ಉಳಿಸಿದ state ಮರುಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿ next_node ನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"class Checkpoint(TypedDict):
    state: AgentState
    next_node: Optional[str]
    last_completed_node: Optional[str]
    checkpoint_number: int


def replace_reducer(old, new):
    return deepcopy(new)


def append_reducer(old, new):
    return deepcopy(old) + deepcopy(new)


class MemoryCheckpointer:
    """Serialises to JSON text but keeps it in process memory: checkpoint semantics, not durability."""

    def __init__(self):
        self._storage = {}

    def save(self, session_id, checkpoint):
        self._storage[session_id] = json.dumps(checkpoint)

    def load(self, session_id):
        raw = self._storage.get(session_id)
        return None if raw is None else json.loads(raw)

    def update_state(self, session_id, updates):
        checkpoint = self.load(session_id)
        if checkpoint is None:
            raise ValueError(f"No checkpoint for {session_id!r}")
        checkpoint["state"].update(updates)
        self.save(session_id, checkpoint)


class StateGraph:
    def __init__(self, checkpointer):
        self.checkpointer = checkpointer
        self.nodes, self.edges, self.conditional_edges, self.reducers = {}, {}, {}, {}
        self.executed = []

    def add_node(self, name, node):
        self.nodes[name] = node

    def add_edge(self, source, target):
        self.edges[source] = target

    def add_conditional_edges(self, source, chooser, routes):
        self.conditional_edges[source] = (chooser, routes)

    def set_reducer(self, field, reducer):
        self.reducers[field] = reducer

    def merge_update(self, state, update):
        new_state = deepcopy(state)
        for key, value in update.items():
            reducer = self.reducers.get(key, replace_reducer)
            new_state[key] = reducer(new_state.get(key), value)
        return new_state

    def next_node(self, current, state):
        if current in self.conditional_edges:
            chooser, routes = self.conditional_edges[current]
            route = chooser(state)
            if route not in routes:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown route {route!r} from {current!r}")
            return routes[route]
        return self.edges.get(current)

    def _execute(self, session_id, state, current, checkpoint_number):
        while current is not None:
            print(f"[execute] node={current}")
            self.executed.append(current)
            try:
                update = self.nodes[current](state)
            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"[stopped] node={current} reason={exc}")
                raise
            state = self.merge_update(state, update)
            following = self.next_node(current, state)
            checkpoint_number += 1
            self.checkpointer.save(session_id, {"state": state, "next_node": following,
                                                "last_completed_node": current, "checkpoint_number": checkpoint_number})
            print(f"[checkpoint {checkpoint_number}] completed={current} next={following}")
            current = following
        return state

    def run(self, session_id, start, initial_state):
        return self._execute(session_id, deepcopy(initial_state), start, 0)

    def resume(self, session_id):
        cp = self.checkpointer.load(session_id)
        if cp is None:
            raise ValueError(f"No checkpoint for {session_id!r}")
        print(f"[resume] checkpoint={cp['checkpoint_number']} last_completed={cp['last_completed_node']} next={cp['next_node']}")
        return self._execute(session_id, cp["state"], cp["next_node"], cp["checkpoint_number"])


def refund_with_messages(state):
    return {"messages": ["Agent: Refund request prepared."], "output": "Refund request prepared and awaiting approval.", "step": state["step"] + 1}


def human_gate_node(state):
    if not state["human_approval"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Human approval required")
    return {"messages": ["Human approval received."], "step": state["step"] + 1}


def send_node(state):
    return {"messages": ["Final response sent."], "output": state["output"] + " Approved and sent.", "step": state["step"] + 1}

title: Stateful Graph Orchestration: Durable Execution and Checkpoints (Part 3 of 3) — SQLite, Crashes and Replay Safety
titleKn: Stateful Graph Orchestration: Durable Execution ಮತ್ತು Checkpoints (ಭಾಗ 3 / 3) — SQLite, Crashes ಮತ್ತು Replay ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆ
desc: Persist checkpoints in SQLite, resume from a brand-new process after a genuine os._exit crash, show a replayed side effect and fix it with an idempotency key, and find that the sqlite3 context manager leaks the connection.
objectives: Persist checkpoints in SQLite and resume from a new process.
Reproduce a replayed side effect after a real crash.
Make a node replay-safe with an idempotency key.
Version checkpoints and refuse unknown schemas.
Describe supervisor, swarm and hierarchical topologies and bound their cycles.
objectivesKn: Checkpoints ಅನ್ನು SQLite ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಿರಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಿಂದ resume ಮಾಡಿ.
ನಿಜವಾದ crash ನಂತರ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿತ ಅಡ್ಡ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಪುನರುತ್ಪಾದಿಸಿ.
Idempotency key ಯಿಂದ node ಅನ್ನು replay-ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಮಾಡಿ.
Checkpoints ಗೆ version ನೀಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಜ್ಞಾತ schemas ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿ.
Supervisor, swarm ಮತ್ತು ಶ್ರೇಣೀಕೃತ topologies ವಿವರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಚಕ್ರಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಿತಿ ಹಾಕಿ.

It opens each connection through contextlib.closing so connections are really closed. child_main is what the second process runs: it can exit abruptly with os._exit right after an external side effect, which is a real crash, not a simulated one.","descKn":"SQLiteCheckpointer ಪ್ರತಿ session ಗೆ schema_version ಇರುವ ಒಂದು JSON ಸಾಲು upsert ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ತನಗೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗದ version ನಿರಾಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು update_state ಬೆಂಬಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದು ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕವನ್ನು contextlib.closing ಮೂಲಕ ತೆರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳು ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತವೆ. child_main ಎರಡನೇ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುವುದು: ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಅಡ್ಡ ಪರಿಣಾಮದ ತಕ್ಷಣ os._exit ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹಠಾತ್ ನಿರ್ಗಮಿಸಬಹುದು, ಇದು ನಿಜವಾದ crash, ಸಿಮ್ಯುಲೇಟೆಡ್ ಅಲ್ಲ.","code":"class SQLiteCheckpointer:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as conn, conn:
            conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS checkpoints (session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, checkpoint_json TEXT NOT NULL)")

    def save(self, session_id, checkpoint):
        checkpoint = dict(checkpoint, schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION)
        data = json.dumps(checkpoint, sort_keys=True)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as conn, conn:
            conn.execute("INSERT INTO checkpoints (session_id, checkpoint_json) VALUES (?, ?) "
                         "ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET checkpoint_json = excluded.checkpoint_json", (session_id, data))

    def load(self, session_id):
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as conn:
            row = conn.execute("SELECT checkpoint_json FROM checkpoints WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        cp = json.loads(row[0])
        if cp.get("schema_version") != SCHEMA_VERSION:
            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint schema {cp.get('schema_version')} != supported {SCHEMA_VERSION}")
        return cp

    def update_state(self, session_id, updates):
        cp = self.load(session_id)
        if cp is None:
            raise ValueError(f"No checkpoint for {session_id!r}")
        cp["state"].update(updates)
        self.save(session_id, cp)

It opens each connection through contextlib.closing so connections are really closed. child_main is what the second process runs: it can exit abruptly with os._exit right after an external side effect, which is a real crash, not a simulated one.","descKn":"SQLiteCheckpointer ಪ್ರತಿ session ಗೆ schema_version ಇರುವ ಒಂದು JSON ಸಾಲು upsert ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ತನಗೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗದ version ನಿರಾಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು update_state ಬೆಂಬಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದು ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕವನ್ನು contextlib.closing ಮೂಲಕ ತೆರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳು ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತವೆ. child_main ಎರಡನೇ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುವುದು: ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಅಡ್ಡ ಪರಿಣಾಮದ ತಕ್ಷಣ os._exit ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹಠಾತ್ ನಿರ್ಗಮಿಸಬಹುದು, ಇದು ನಿಜವಾದ crash, ಸಿಮ್ಯುಲೇಟೆಡ್ ಅಲ್ಲ.","code":"class SQLiteCheckpointer:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as conn, conn:
            conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS checkpoints (session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, checkpoint_json TEXT NOT NULL)")

    def save(self, session_id, checkpoint):
        checkpoint = dict(checkpoint, schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION)
        data = json.dumps(checkpoint, sort_keys=True)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as conn, conn:
            conn.execute("INSERT INTO checkpoints (session_id, checkpoint_json) VALUES (?, ?) "
                         "ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET checkpoint_json = excluded.checkpoint_json", (session_id, data))

    def load(self, session_id):
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path)) as conn:
            row = conn.execute("SELECT checkpoint_json FROM checkpoints WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        cp = json.loads(row[0])
        if cp.get("schema_version") != SCHEMA_VERSION:
            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint schema {cp.get('schema_version')} != supported {SCHEMA_VERSION}")
        return cp

    def update_state(self, session_id, updates):
        cp = self.load(session_id)
        if cp is None:
            raise ValueError(f"No checkpoint for {session_id!r}")
        cp["state"].update(updates)
        self.save(session_id, cp)

    g.add_edge("refund", "human_gate")

title: The Actor Model for Agents: Async Messages and Typed Runtimes (Part 1 of 3) — Actors, Messages and the Runtime

desc: Replace agent-to-agent calls with messages, build Message, Actor and a queue-based Runtime, and find that frozen does not freeze a mutable body and that actor loops need a budget.

Identify mutable-body and runaway-loop hazards.

CounterActor ತನ್ನ handler ಮಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಿಸುವ ಖಾಸಗಿ count ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.","code":"@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Message:
    sender: str
    recipient: str
    topic: str
    body: Any


class Actor(ABC):
    def __init__(self, actor_id: str):
        self.actor_id = actor_id

    @abstractmethod
    def receive(self, message: Message, runtime: "Runtime") -> None:
        raise NotImplementedError


class Runtime:
    def __init__(self, max_messages=1000):
        self.actors: dict = {}
        self.queue: Queue = Queue()
        self.max_messages = max_messages
        self.delivered = 0

    def register(self, actor: Actor) -> None:
        if actor.actor_id in self.actors:
            raise ValueError(f"actor already registered: {actor.actor_id}")
        self.actors[actor.actor_id] = actor

    def send(self, message: Message) -> None:
        self.queue.put(message)

    def run(self) -> None:
        while not self.queue.empty():
            if self.delivered >= self.max_messages:
                raise RuntimeError(f"message budget of {self.max_messages} exhausted, {self.queue.qsize()} still queued")
            message = self.queue.get()
            self.delivered += 1
            actor = self.actors.get(message.recipient)
            if actor is None:
                continue
            actor.receive(message, self)


class EchoActor(Actor):
    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        print(f"{self.actor_id} received: {message.body}")


class CounterActor(Actor):
    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.count = 0

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        if message.topic == "increment":
            self.count += 1
            print(f"{self.actor_id}: {self.count}")


class PingPong(Actor):
    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        other = "pong" if self.actor_id == "ping" else "ping"
        runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, other, "ball", message.body))"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"actor_1.py","headingEn":"main(): six experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಆರು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() shows that send does not handle, runs the envelope, tests registry rules, probes what frozen really protects, runs a ping-pong loop against the message budget, and checks queue ordering.","descKn":"main() send ಎಂದರೆ handle ಅಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, envelope ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ನೋಂದಣಿ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, frozen ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಏನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಂದೇಶ budget ವಿರುದ್ಧ ping-pong ಚಕ್ರ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಸರತಿ ಕ್ರಮ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    section("1. Sending is not handling")
    rt = Runtime()
    counter = CounterActor("counter")
    rt.register(counter)
    for _ in range(3):
        rt.send(Message("main", "counter", "increment", None))
    print("after three sends, before run(): count =", counter.count, "| queued:", rt.queue.qsize())
    rt.run()
    print("after run(): count =", counter.count)

    section("2. The message envelope: routing metadata plus a body")
    rt2 = Runtime()
    rt2.register(EchoActor("echo"))
    rt2.send(Message("main", "echo", "say", "Hello actor!"))
    rt2.run()

    section("3. Registry rules")
    try:
        rt2.register(EchoActor("echo"))
    except ValueError as e:
        print("duplicate id ->", e)
    rt2.send(Message("main", "nobody", "say", "anyone there?"))
    rt2.run()
    print("a message to an unknown recipient was silently dropped by this first runtime; Part 2 fixes that")

    section("4. Genuinely checking: frozen protects the fields, not what they point to")
    m = Message("main", "echo", "say", {"items": ["a"]})
    try:
        m.topic = "other"
    except FrozenInstanceError as e:
        print("assigning m.topic ->", type(e).__name__)
    seen = []
    class Recorder(Actor):
        def receive(self, message, runtime):
            seen.append(list(message.body["items"]))
    rt3 = Runtime()
    rt3.register(Recorder("rec"))
    shared = {"items": ["a"]}
    rt3.send(Message("main", "rec", "t", shared))
    shared["items"].append("INJECTED AFTER SEND")
    rt3.run()
    print("recipient saw:", seen[0], "| the sender changed the body after sending")
    print("use tuples or copy.deepcopy(body) when sending, or immutable payload dataclasses")

    section("5. Genuinely checking: two actors can keep a run alive forever")
    rt4 = Runtime(max_messages=50)
    rt4.register(PingPong("ping"))
    rt4.register(PingPong("pong"))
    rt4.send(Message("main", "ping", "ball", 0))
    try:
        rt4.run()
    except RuntimeError as e:
        print("RuntimeError:", e)
    print("an event loop needs a message budget or a termination rule, like any agent loop")

    section("6. Ordering: one FIFO queue")
    rt5 = Runtime()
    log = []
    class Logger(Actor):
        def receive(self, message, runtime):
            log.append(message.body)
    rt5.register(Logger("log"))
    for i in range(5):
        rt5.send(Message("main", "log", "t", i))
    rt5.run()
    print("delivery order:", log)
    print("a real distributed transport weakens this: retries, partitions and parallel workers all reorder")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

But the body is a dict that the sender still holds. The sender appends "INJECTED AFTER SEND" after calling send(), and the recipient, who receives the message later, sees the changed list. frozen=True stops reassignment; it does not make a mutable object immutable, and a queued message is shared state until it is delivered. Send tuples, deep-copy the body, or use frozen payload dataclasses, which is what Part 3 does.","bodyKn":"ವಿಭಾಗ 4 message.topic ಗೆ ನಿಯೋಜಿಸುವುದು FrozenInstanceError ಎತ್ತುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ envelope ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳು ರಕ್ಷಿತ. ಆದರೆ body ಕಳುಹಿಸುವವರು ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಿಡಿದಿರುವ ನಿಘಂಟು. ಕಳುಹಿಸುವವರು send() ಕರೆದ ನಂತರ "INJECTED AFTER SEND" ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರ ಸಂದೇಶ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುವವರು ಬದಲಾದ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ನೋಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. frozen=True ಮರುನಿಯೋಜನೆ ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಗದಂತೆ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಮತ್ತು ಸರತಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಸಂದೇಶ ವಿತರಣೆಯಾಗುವವರೆಗೆ ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯ state. Tuples ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ, body deep-copy ಮಾಡಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಫ್ರೋಜನ್ payload dataclasses ಬಳಸಿ, ಭಾಗ 3 ಮಾಡುವುದು ಅದನ್ನೇ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Genuinely Found: Event Loops Need Termination","headingKn":"ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡುಬಂದದ್ದು: Event Loops ಗೆ ಮುಕ್ತಾಯ ಬೇಕು","bodyEn":"Section 5 registers two actors that each reply to the other. The run never ends on its own; the message budget stops it with "message budget of 50 exhausted, 1 still queued". This is the same lesson as an agent loop: anything that can keep producing work needs an explicit stopping rule. Section 3 also shows a limit of this first runtime, a message to an unknown recipient simply vanishes. CounterActor ತನ್ನ handler ಮಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಿಸುವ ಖಾಸಗಿ count ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.","code":"@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Message:
    sender: str
    recipient: str
    topic: str
    body: Any


class Actor(ABC):
    def __init__(self, actor_id: str):
        self.actor_id = actor_id

    @abstractmethod
    def receive(self, message: Message, runtime: "Runtime") -> None:
        raise NotImplementedError


class Runtime:
    def __init__(self, max_messages=1000):
        self.actors: dict = {}
        self.queue: Queue = Queue()
        self.max_messages = max_messages
        self.delivered = 0

    def register(self, actor: Actor) -> None:
        if actor.actor_id in self.actors:
            raise ValueError(f"actor already registered: {actor.actor_id}")
        self.actors[actor.actor_id] = actor

    def send(self, message: Message) -> None:
        self.queue.put(message)

    def run(self) -> None:
        while not self.queue.empty():
            if self.delivered >= self.max_messages:
                raise RuntimeError(f"message budget of {self.max_messages} exhausted, {self.queue.qsize()} still queued")
            message = self.queue.get()
            self.delivered += 1
            actor = self.actors.get(message.recipient)
            if actor is None:
                continue
            actor.receive(message, self)


class EchoActor(Actor):
    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        print(f"{self.actor_id} received: {message.body}")


class CounterActor(Actor):
    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.count = 0

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        if message.topic == "increment":
            self.count += 1
            print(f"{self.actor_id}: {self.count}")


class PingPong(Actor):
    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        other = "pong" if self.actor_id == "ping" else "ping"
        runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, other, "ball", message.body))"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"actor_1.py","headingEn":"main(): six experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಆರು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() shows that send does not handle, runs the envelope, tests registry rules, probes what frozen really protects, runs a ping-pong loop against the message budget, and checks queue ordering.","descKn":"main() send ಎಂದರೆ handle ಅಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, envelope ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ನೋಂದಣಿ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, frozen ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಏನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಂದೇಶ budget ವಿರುದ್ಧ ping-pong ಚಕ್ರ ಚಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಸರತಿ ಕ್ರಮ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    section("1. Sending is not handling")
    rt = Runtime()
    counter = CounterActor("counter")
    rt.register(counter)
    for _ in range(3):
        rt.send(Message("main", "counter", "increment", None))
    print("after three sends, before run(): count =", counter.count, "| queued:", rt.queue.qsize())
    rt.run()
    print("after run(): count =", counter.count)

    section("2. The message envelope: routing metadata plus a body")
    rt2 = Runtime()
    rt2.register(EchoActor("echo"))
    rt2.send(Message("main", "echo", "say", "Hello actor!"))
    rt2.run()

    section("3. Registry rules")
    try:
        rt2.register(EchoActor("echo"))
    except ValueError as e:
        print("duplicate id ->", e)
    rt2.send(Message("main", "nobody", "say", "anyone there?"))
    rt2.run()
    print("a message to an unknown recipient was silently dropped by this first runtime; Part 2 fixes that")

    section("4. Genuinely checking: frozen protects the fields, not what they point to")
    m = Message("main", "echo", "say", {"items": ["a"]})
    try:
        m.topic = "other"
    except FrozenInstanceError as e:
        print("assigning m.topic ->", type(e).__name__)
    seen = []
    class Recorder(Actor):
        def receive(self, message, runtime):
            seen.append(list(message.body["items"]))
    rt3 = Runtime()
    rt3.register(Recorder("rec"))
    shared = {"items": ["a"]}
    rt3.send(Message("main", "rec", "t", shared))
    shared["items"].append("INJECTED AFTER SEND")
    rt3.run()
    print("recipient saw:", seen[0], "| the sender changed the body after sending")
    print("use tuples or copy.deepcopy(body) when sending, or immutable payload dataclasses")

    section("5. Genuinely checking: two actors can keep a run alive forever")
    rt4 = Runtime(max_messages=50)
    rt4.register(PingPong("ping"))
    rt4.register(PingPong("pong"))
    rt4.send(Message("main", "ping", "ball", 0))
    try:
        rt4.run()
    except RuntimeError as e:
        print("RuntimeError:", e)
    print("an event loop needs a message budget or a termination rule, like any agent loop")

    section("6. Ordering: one FIFO queue")
    rt5 = Runtime()
    log = []
    class Logger(Actor):
        def receive(self, message, runtime):
            log.append(message.body)
    rt5.register(Logger("log"))
    for i in range(5):
        rt5.send(Message("main", "log", "t", i))
    rt5.run()
    print("delivery order:", log)
    print("a real distributed transport weakens this: retries, partitions and parallel workers all reorder")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

title: The Actor Model for Agents: Async Messages and Typed Runtimes (Part 2 of 3) — Fault Isolation and Concurrency
titleKn: Agents ಗಾಗಿ Actor ಮಾದರಿ: Async ಸಂದೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು Typed Runtimes (ಭಾಗ 2 / 3) — ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕತೆ ಮತ್ತು Concurrency
desc: Add a delivery boundary that isolates handler failures and stores dead letters, then find that isolation is not recovery, retries duplicate work, SystemExit escapes, and independent actors overlap in measured time.
objectives: Isolate handler failures at the runtime delivery boundary.
Store undeliverable messages as dead letters.
Explain why isolation is not recovery and add a failure notification.
Make handlers idempotent against duplicate delivery.
Measure per-actor concurrency.
objectivesKn: Runtime ವಿತರಣಾ ಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ handler ವೈಫಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕಿಸಿ.
ತಲುಪಿಸಲಾಗದ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು dead letters ಆಗಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ.

ನಕಲು ವಿತರಣೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧ handlers ಅನ್ನು idempotent ಮಾಡಿ.

Reviewer and Checklist are the two collaborating actors; Sleeper simulates slow I/O.","descKn":"deliver() ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುವವರನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸಿ, ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ dead letter ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ, ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ receive ಅನ್ನು try/except ಒಳಗೆ ಕರೆದು ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ದಾಖಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಐಚ್ಛಿಕ ನೀತಿಗಳು: max_attempts ವರೆಗೆ ಮರುಪ್ರಯತ್ನ, ಅಥವಾ ಮೂಲ ಕಳುಹಿಸುವವರಿಗೆ actor_failed ಸಂದೇಶ ಕಳುಹಿಸುವುದು. Reviewer ಮತ್ತು Checklist ಸಹಕರಿಸುವ ಎರಡು actors; Sleeper ನಿಧಾನ I/O ಅನುಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"class Runtime:
    def __init__(self, notify_sender=False, max_attempts=1, max_messages=1000):
        self.actors, self.queue = {}, Queue()
        self.failures, self.dead_letters, self.trace = [], [], []
        self.notify_sender, self.max_attempts, self.max_messages = notify_sender, max_attempts, max_messages
        self.attempts = {}
        self.delivered = 0

    def log(self, text):
        self.trace.append(text)
        print(text)

    def register(self, actor):
        if actor.actor_id in self.actors:
            raise ValueError(f"actor already registered: {actor.actor_id}")
        self.actors[actor.actor_id] = actor

    def send(self, message):
        self.log(f"[send] {message.sender} -> {message.recipient} topic={message.topic}")
        self.queue.put(message)

    def deliver(self, message):
        actor = self.actors.get(message.recipient)
        if actor is None:
            self.dead_letters.append(message)
            self.log(f"[dead-letter] recipient={message.recipient} topic={message.topic}")
            return
        try:
            actor.receive(message, self)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.failures.append({"actor": actor.actor_id, "topic": message.topic, "error": str(exc)})
            self.log(f"[failure] actor={actor.actor_id} topic={message.topic} error={exc}")
            key = id(message)
            self.attempts[key] = self.attempts.get(key, 0) + 1
            if self.attempts[key] < self.max_attempts:
                self.log(f"[retry] attempt {self.attempts[key] + 1} of {self.max_attempts}")
                self.queue.put(message)
            elif self.notify_sender and message.sender in self.actors:
                self.queue.put(Message("runtime", message.sender, "actor_failed", {"actor": actor.actor_id, "topic": message.topic, "error": str(exc)}))

    def run(self):
        while not self.queue.empty():
            self.delivered += 1
            if self.delivered > self.max_messages:
                raise RuntimeError("message budget exhausted")
            message = self.queue.get()
            self.log(f"[deliver] {message.recipient} <- {message.sender} topic={message.topic}")
            self.deliver(message)


class Echo(Actor):
    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        print(f"{self.actor_id} received: {message.body}")


class Broken(Actor):
    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        raise RuntimeError("simulated actor crash")


class Reviewer(Actor):
    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.status = "IDLE"
        self.verdict = None

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        if message.topic == "review_request":
            self.status = "WAITING_FOR_CHECKLIST"
            runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, "checklist", "checklist_request", message.body))
        elif message.topic == "checklist_result":
            self.status = "COMPLETE"
            self.verdict = "APPROVED"
        elif message.topic == "actor_failed":
            self.status = "FAILED"
            self.verdict = f"UNKNOWN ({message.body['actor']} failed)"


class Checklist(Actor):
    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.check_count = 0

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        self.check_count += 1
        if message.body.get("simulate_failure"):
            raise RuntimeError("simulated checklist failure")
        runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, "reviewer", "checklist_result", {"findings": []}))


class Sleeper(Actor):
    def __init__(self, actor_id, seconds):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.seconds, self.handled = seconds, []

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        time.sleep(self.seconds)
        self.handled.append(message.body)"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"actor_2.py","headingEn":"main(): seven experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಏಳು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() isolates a crash, stores a dead letter, shows a stuck workflow, adds a failure notification, tests retries and duplicate delivery, raises SystemExit inside a handler, and times one thread against one thread per mailbox.","descKn":"main() crash ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, dead letter ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಿಲುಕಿದ workflow ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ಸೂಚನೆ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮರುಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮತ್ತು ನಕಲು ವಿತರಣೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, handler ಒಳಗೆ SystemExit ಎತ್ತುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು thread ಅನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿ mailbox ಗೆ ಒಂದು thread ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಸಮಯ ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    section("1. A crashing actor does not stop the runtime")
    rt = Runtime()
    rt.register(Broken("broken"))
    rt.register(Echo("echo"))
    rt.send(Message("main", "broken", "test", None))
    rt.send(Message("main", "echo", "say", "Still alive!"))
    rt.run()
    print("failures:", rt.failures)

    section("2. Dead letters are kept, not lost")
    rt2 = Runtime()
    rt2.send(Message("main", "missing-agent", "ping", None))
    rt2.run()
    print("dead letters stored:", len(rt2.dead_letters))

    section("3. Genuinely checking: isolation is not recovery")
    rt3 = Runtime()
    reviewer, checklist = Reviewer("reviewer"), Checklist("checklist")
    rt3.register(reviewer)
    rt3.register(checklist)
    rt3.send(Message("main", "reviewer", "review_request", {"simulate_failure": True}))
    rt3.run()
    print("reviewer.status after the checklist crashed:", reviewer.status, "| verdict:", reviewer.verdict)
    print("the runtime survived, and the workflow is stuck waiting for a result that will never arrive")

    section("4. A failure notification lets the sender react")
    rt4 = Runtime(notify_sender=True)
    reviewer4, checklist4 = Reviewer("reviewer"), Checklist("checklist")
    rt4.register(reviewer4)
    rt4.register(checklist4)
    rt4.send(Message("main", "reviewer", "review_request", {"simulate_failure": True}))
    rt4.run()
    print("reviewer.status:", reviewer4.status, "| verdict:", reviewer4.verdict)

    section("5. Genuinely checking: retries and duplicate processing")
    rt5 = Runtime(max_attempts=3)
    flaky_calls = []
    class Flaky(Actor):
        def receive(self, message, runtime):
            flaky_calls.append(1)
            if len(flaky_calls) < 3:
                raise RuntimeError("transient")
            print("flaky succeeded on call", len(flaky_calls))
    rt5.register(Flaky("flaky"))
    rt5.send(Message("main", "flaky", "t", None))
    rt5.run()
    class Charger(Actor):
        def __init__(self, actor_id, idempotent):
            super().__init__(actor_id)
            self.charges, self.seen, self.idempotent = 0, set(), idempotent
        def receive(self, message, runtime):
            if self.idempotent and message.body["id"] in self.seen:
                return
            self.seen.add(message.body["id"])
            self.charges += 1
    for idem in (False, True):
        rt6 = Runtime()
        ch = Charger("charge", idem)
        rt6.register(ch)
        dup = Message("main", "charge", "charge", {"id": "op-1"})
        rt6.queue.put(dup)
        rt6.queue.put(dup)
        rt6.run()
        print(f"same message delivered twice, idempotent={idem}: charges applied = {ch.charges}")

    section("6. Genuinely checking: what 'except Exception' does not catch")
    rt7 = Runtime()
    class Quitter(Actor):
        def receive(self, message, runtime):
            raise SystemExit("actor called exit")
    rt7.register(Quitter("q"))
    rt7.register(Echo("echo"))
    rt7.send(Message("main", "q", "t", None))
    rt7.send(Message("main", "echo", "say", "never printed"))
    try:
        rt7.run()
    except SystemExit as e:
        print("SystemExit escaped the runtime:", e, "| messages still queued:", rt7.queue.qsize())

    section("7. Genuinely measuring: independent actors overlap, one actor serialises")
    a, b = Sleeper("a", 0.2), Sleeper("b", 0.2)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for actor in (a, b):
        for i in range(3):
            actor.receive(Message("main", actor.actor_id, "t", i), None)
    sequential = time.perf_counter() - t0
    a, b = Sleeper("a", 0.2), Sleeper("b", 0.2)
    def mailbox_loop(actor, box):
        while True:
            m = box.get()
            if m is None:
                return
            actor.receive(m, None)
    boxes = {"a": Queue(), "b": Queue()}
    threads = [threading.Thread(target=mailbox_loop, args=(actor, boxes[actor.actor_id])) for actor in (a, b)]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for actor in (a, b):
        for i in range(3):
            boxes[actor.actor_id].put(Message("main", actor.actor_id, "t", i))
        boxes[actor.actor_id].put(None)
    for t in threads:
        t.join()
    concurrent = time.perf_counter() - t0
    print(f"6 handler calls of 0.2 s: one thread {sequential:.2f}s | one thread per actor mailbox {concurrent:.2f}s")

Reviewer ಮತ್ತು Checklist ಸಹಕರಿಸುವ ಎರಡು actors; Sleeper ನಿಧಾನ I/O ಅನುಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"class Runtime:
    def __init__(self, notify_sender=False, max_attempts=1, max_messages=1000):
        self.actors, self.queue = {}, Queue()
        self.failures, self.dead_letters, self.trace = [], [], []
        self.notify_sender, self.max_attempts, self.max_messages = notify_sender, max_attempts, max_messages
        self.attempts = {}
        self.delivered = 0

    def log(self, text):
        self.trace.append(text)
        print(text)

    def register(self, actor):
        if actor.actor_id in self.actors:
            raise ValueError(f"actor already registered: {actor.actor_id}")
        self.actors[actor.actor_id] = actor

    def send(self, message):
        self.log(f"[send] {message.sender} -> {message.recipient} topic={message.topic}")
        self.queue.put(message)

    def deliver(self, message):
        actor = self.actors.get(message.recipient)
        if actor is None:
            self.dead_letters.append(message)
            self.log(f"[dead-letter] recipient={message.recipient} topic={message.topic}")
            return
        try:
            actor.receive(message, self)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.failures.append({"actor": actor.actor_id, "topic": message.topic, "error": str(exc)})
            self.log(f"[failure] actor={actor.actor_id} topic={message.topic} error={exc}")
            key = id(message)
            self.attempts[key] = self.attempts.get(key, 0) + 1
            if self.attempts[key] < self.max_attempts:
                self.log(f"[retry] attempt {self.attempts[key] + 1} of {self.max_attempts}")
                self.queue.put(message)
            elif self.notify_sender and message.sender in self.actors:
                self.queue.put(Message("runtime", message.sender, "actor_failed", {"actor": actor.actor_id, "topic": message.topic, "error": str(exc)}))

    def run(self):
        while not self.queue.empty():
            self.delivered += 1
            if self.delivered > self.max_messages:
                raise RuntimeError("message budget exhausted")
            message = self.queue.get()
            self.log(f"[deliver] {message.recipient} <- {message.sender} topic={message.topic}")
            self.deliver(message)


class Echo(Actor):
    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        print(f"{self.actor_id} received: {message.body}")


class Broken(Actor):
    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        raise RuntimeError("simulated actor crash")


class Reviewer(Actor):
    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.status = "IDLE"
        self.verdict = None

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        if message.topic == "review_request":
            self.status = "WAITING_FOR_CHECKLIST"
            runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, "checklist", "checklist_request", message.body))
        elif message.topic == "checklist_result":
            self.status = "COMPLETE"
            self.verdict = "APPROVED"
        elif message.topic == "actor_failed":
            self.status = "FAILED"
            self.verdict = f"UNKNOWN ({message.body['actor']} failed)"


class Checklist(Actor):
    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.check_count = 0

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        self.check_count += 1

class Sleeper(Actor):

def main():
    section("1. A crashing actor does not stop the runtime")
    rt = Runtime()
    rt.register(Broken("broken"))
    rt.register(Echo("echo"))
    rt.send(Message("main", "broken", "test", None))
    rt.send(Message("main", "echo", "say", "Still alive!"))
    rt.run()
    print("failures:", rt.failures)

    section("2. Dead letters are kept, not lost")
    rt2 = Runtime()
    rt2.send(Message("main", "missing-agent", "ping", None))
    rt2.run()
    print("dead letters stored:", len(rt2.dead_letters))

    section("3. Genuinely checking: isolation is not recovery")
    rt3 = Runtime()
    reviewer, checklist = Reviewer("reviewer"), Checklist("checklist")
    rt3.register(reviewer)
    rt3.register(checklist)
    rt3.send(Message("main", "reviewer", "review_request", {"simulate_failure": True}))
    rt3.run()
    print("reviewer.status after the checklist crashed:", reviewer.status, "| verdict:", reviewer.verdict)
    print("the runtime survived, and the workflow is stuck waiting for a result that will never arrive")

    section("4. A failure notification lets the sender react")
    rt4 = Runtime(notify_sender=True)
    reviewer4, checklist4 = Reviewer("reviewer"), Checklist("checklist")
    rt4.register(reviewer4)
    rt4.register(checklist4)
    rt4.send(Message("main", "reviewer", "review_request", {"simulate_failure": True}))
    rt4.run()
    print("reviewer.status:", reviewer4.status, "| verdict:", reviewer4.verdict)

    section("5. Genuinely checking: retries and duplicate processing")
    rt5 = Runtime(max_attempts=3)
    flaky_calls = []
    class Flaky(Actor):
        def receive(self, message, runtime):
            flaky_calls.append(1)
            if len(flaky_calls) < 3:
                raise RuntimeError("transient")
            print("flaky succeeded on call", len(flaky_calls))
    rt5.register(Flaky("flaky"))
    rt5.send(Message("main", "flaky", "t", None))
    rt5.run()
    class Charger(Actor):
        def __init__(self, actor_id, idempotent):
            super().__init__(actor_id)
            self.charges, self.seen, self.idempotent = 0, set(), idempotent
        def receive(self, message, runtime):
            if self.idempotent and message.body["id"] in self.seen:
                return
            self.seen.add(message.body["id"])
            self.charges += 1
    for idem in (False, True):
        rt6 = Runtime()
        ch = Charger("charge", idem)
        rt6.register(ch)
        dup = Message("main", "charge", "charge", {"id": "op-1"})
        rt6.queue.put(dup)
        rt6.queue.put(dup)
        rt6.run()
        print(f"same message delivered twice, idempotent={idem}: charges applied = {ch.charges}")

    section("6. Genuinely checking: what 'except Exception' does not catch")
    rt7 = Runtime()
    class Quitter(Actor):
        def receive(self, message, runtime):

    rt7.register(Quitter("q"))

    rt7.send(Message("main", "q", "t", None))
    rt7.send(Message("main", "echo", "say", "never printed"))
    try:

    section("7. Genuinely measuring: independent actors overlap, one actor serialises")
    a, b = Sleeper("a", 0.2), Sleeper("b", 0.2)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for actor in (a, b):
        for i in range(3):
            actor.receive(Message("main", actor.actor_id, "t", i), None)
    sequential = time.perf_counter() - t0
    a, b = Sleeper("a", 0.2), Sleeper("b", 0.2)
    def mailbox_loop(actor, box):
        while True:
            m = box.get()
            if m is None:
                return
            actor.receive(m, None)
    boxes = {"a": Queue(), "b": Queue()}
    threads = [threading.Thread(target=mailbox_loop, args=(actor, boxes[actor.actor_id])) for actor in (a, b)]

        boxes[actor.actor_id].put(None)

title: The Actor Model for Agents: Async Messages and Typed Runtimes (Part 3 of 3) — The Full System and Its Hidden Race
titleKn: Agents ಗಾಗಿ Actor ಮಾದರಿ: Async ಸಂದೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು Typed Runtimes (ಭಾಗ 3 / 3) — ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಡಗಿದ Race
desc: Run a complete typed reviewer and checklist system through five proof cases, then put two reviews in flight and find a single-slot reviewer approving eval code, fixed by keying state with a correlation id.
objectives: Define typed message payloads and validate them at the handler.
Run a message-only collaboration to a consensus verdict.
Prove fault isolation with a later successful request and a dead letter.
Explain why actor state must replace the suspended call stack.
Fix in-flight state collisions with correlation ids.

class ReviewRequest:

    simulate_failure: bool = False
    review_id: str = "r-1"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChecklistRequest:
    code: str
    reviewer_findings: tuple
    simulate_failure: bool = False
    review_id: str = "r-1"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChecklistResult:
    findings: tuple
    passed: bool
    review_id: str = "r-1"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FinalVerdict:
    verdict: str
    findings: tuple


class Runtime:
    def __init__(self):
        self.actors, self.queue = {}, Queue()
        self.failures, self.dead_letters, self.trace = [], [], []

    def log(self, text):
        self.trace.append(text)
        print(text)

    def register(self, actor):
        if actor.actor_id in self.actors:
            raise ValueError(f"actor already registered: {actor.actor_id}")
        self.actors[actor.actor_id] = actor

    def send(self, message):
        self.log(f"[send] {message.sender} -> {message.recipient} topic={message.topic}")
        self.queue.put(message)

    def deliver(self, message):
        actor = self.actors.get(message.recipient)
        if actor is None:
            self.dead_letters.append(message)
            self.log(f"[dead-letter] recipient={message.recipient} topic={message.topic}")
            return
        try:
            actor.receive(message, self)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.failures.append({"actor": actor.actor_id, "topic": message.topic, "error": str(exc)})
            self.log(f"[failure] actor={actor.actor_id} topic={message.topic} error={exc}")

    def run(self):
        while not self.queue.empty():
            message = self.queue.get()
            self.log(f"[deliver] {message.recipient} <- {message.sender} topic={message.topic}")
            self.deliver(message)


class ReviewerAgent(Actor):
    """Deliberately single-slot: it remembers one review at a time (the weakness Part 3 exposes)."""

    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.review_count = 0
        self.status = "IDLE"
        self.current_code = ""
        self.reviewer_findings = ()
        self.final_verdict: Optional[FinalVerdict] = None

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        if message.topic == "review_request":
            self._on_review(message, runtime)
        elif message.topic == "checklist_result":
            self._on_result(message, runtime)

    def _on_review(self, message, runtime):
        body = message.body
        if not isinstance(body, ReviewRequest):
            raise TypeError("review_request requires ReviewRequest")
        self.review_count += 1
        self.status = "REVIEWING"
        self.current_code = body.code
        findings = []
        if "eval(" in body.code:
            findings.append("avoid eval()")
        if "except:" in body.code:
            findings.append("avoid bare except")
        self.reviewer_findings = tuple(findings)
        runtime.log(f"[reviewer] review={self.review_count} findings={list(self.reviewer_findings)}")
        self.status = "WAITING_FOR_CHECKLIST"
        runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, "checklist", "checklist_request",
                             ChecklistRequest(body.code, self.reviewer_findings, body.simulate_failure, body.review_id)))

    def _on_result(self, message, runtime):
        body = message.body
        if not isinstance(body, ChecklistResult):
            raise TypeError("checklist_result requires ChecklistResult")
        all_findings = self.reviewer_findings + body.findings
        verdict = "APPROVED" if (not all_findings and body.passed) else "CHANGES_REQUESTED"
        self.final_verdict = FinalVerdict(verdict, all_findings)
        self.status = "COMPLETE"
        runtime.log(f"[reviewer] consensus={verdict} review_id={body.review_id} combined_findings={list(all_findings)}")


class ChecklistAgent(Actor):
    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.check_count = 0
        self.status = "IDLE"
        self.last_findings = ()

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        if message.topic != "checklist_request":
            return
        body = message.body
        if not isinstance(body, ChecklistRequest):
            raise TypeError("checklist_request requires ChecklistRequest")
        self.check_count += 1
        self.status = "CHECKING"
        runtime.log(f"[checklist] check={self.check_count}")
        if body.simulate_failure:
            self.status = "FAILED"
            raise RuntimeError("simulated checklist failure")
        findings = []
        if "def " not in body.code:
            findings.append("no function definition found")
        if "return " not in body.code:
            findings.append("no explicit return found")
        if len(body.code.strip()) < 20:
            findings.append("implementation is unusually short")
        self.last_findings = tuple(findings)
        self.status = "COMPLETE"
        runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, "reviewer", "checklist_result",
                             ChecklistResult(self.last_findings, not findings, body.review_id)))

class ReviewRequest:
    code: str
    simulate_failure: bool = False

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChecklistRequest:
    code: str
    reviewer_findings: tuple
    simulate_failure: bool = False
    review_id: str = "r-1"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChecklistResult:
    findings: tuple
    passed: bool
    review_id: str = "r-1"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FinalVerdict:
    verdict: str
    findings: tuple


class Runtime:
    def __init__(self):
        self.actors, self.queue = {}, Queue()
        self.failures, self.dead_letters, self.trace = [], [], []

    def log(self, text):
        self.trace.append(text)
        print(text)

    def register(self, actor):
        if actor.actor_id in self.actors:
            raise ValueError(f"actor already registered: {actor.actor_id}")
        self.actors[actor.actor_id] = actor

    def send(self, message):
        self.log(f"[send] {message.sender} -> {message.recipient} topic={message.topic}")
        self.queue.put(message)

    def deliver(self, message):
        actor = self.actors.get(message.recipient)
        if actor is None:
            self.dead_letters.append(message)
            self.log(f"[dead-letter] recipient={message.recipient} topic={message.topic}")
            return
        try:
            actor.receive(message, self)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.failures.append({"actor": actor.actor_id, "topic": message.topic, "error": str(exc)})
            self.log(f"[failure] actor={actor.actor_id} topic={message.topic} error={exc}")

    def run(self):
        while not self.queue.empty():
            message = self.queue.get()
            self.log(f"[deliver] {message.recipient} <- {message.sender} topic={message.topic}")
            self.deliver(message)


class ReviewerAgent(Actor):
    """Deliberately single-slot: it remembers one review at a time (the weakness Part 3 exposes)."""

    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.review_count = 0
        self.status = "IDLE"
        self.current_code = ""
        self.reviewer_findings = ()
        self.final_verdict: Optional[FinalVerdict] = None

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        if message.topic == "review_request":
            self._on_review(message, runtime)
        elif message.topic == "checklist_result":
            self._on_result(message, runtime)

    def _on_review(self, message, runtime):
        body = message.body
        if not isinstance(body, ReviewRequest):
            raise TypeError("review_request requires ReviewRequest")
        self.review_count += 1
        self.status = "REVIEWING"
        self.current_code = body.code
        findings = []
        if "eval(" in body.code:
            findings.append("avoid eval()")
        if "except:" in body.code:
            findings.append("avoid bare except")
        self.reviewer_findings = tuple(findings)
        runtime.log(f"[reviewer] review={self.review_count} findings={list(self.reviewer_findings)}")
        self.status = "WAITING_FOR_CHECKLIST"
        runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, "checklist", "checklist_request",
                             ChecklistRequest(body.code, self.reviewer_findings, body.simulate_failure, body.review_id)))

    def _on_result(self, message, runtime):
        body = message.body
        if not isinstance(body, ChecklistResult):
            raise TypeError("checklist_result requires ChecklistResult")
        all_findings = self.reviewer_findings + body.findings
        verdict = "APPROVED" if (not all_findings and body.passed) else "CHANGES_REQUESTED"
        self.final_verdict = FinalVerdict(verdict, all_findings)
        self.status = "COMPLETE"
        runtime.log(f"[reviewer] consensus={verdict} review_id={body.review_id} combined_findings={list(all_findings)}")


class ChecklistAgent(Actor):
    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.check_count = 0
        self.status = "IDLE"
        self.last_findings = ()

    def receive(self, message, runtime):
        if message.topic != "checklist_request":
            return
        body = message.body
        if not isinstance(body, ChecklistRequest):
            raise TypeError("checklist_request requires ChecklistRequest")
        self.check_count += 1
        self.status = "CHECKING"
        runtime.log(f"[checklist] check={self.check_count}")
        if body.simulate_failure:
            self.status = "FAILED"
            raise RuntimeError("simulated checklist failure")
        findings = []
        if "def " not in body.code:
            findings.append("no function definition found")
        if "return " not in body.code:
            findings.append("no explicit return found")
        if len(body.code.strip()) < 20:
            findings.append("implementation is unusually short")
        self.last_findings = tuple(findings)
        self.status = "COMPLETE"
        runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, "reviewer", "checklist_result",
                             ChecklistResult(self.last_findings, not findings, body.review_id)))


class KeyedReviewer(ReviewerAgent):
    """Fix: per-review state keyed by review_id, so reviews can be in flight together."""

    def __init__(self, actor_id):
        super().__init__(actor_id)
        self.pending = {}
        self.verdicts = {}

        runtime.send(Message(self.actor_id, "checklist", "checklist_request", ChecklistRequest(body.code, findings, body.simulate_failure, body.review_id)))

    def _on_result(self, message, runtime):
        body = message.body
        all_findings = self.pending.pop(body.review_id) + body.findings

def submit(rt, code, **kw):

title: Role-Based Agent Teams: Crews, Tasks and Processes (Part 1 of 3) — Agent, Task, Crew and Process
titleKn: ಪಾತ್ರ-ಆಧಾರಿತ Agent ತಂಡಗಳು: Crews, Tasks ಮತ್ತು Processes (ಭಾಗ 1 / 3) — Agent, Task, Crew ಮತ್ತು Process
desc: Build Agent, Task, a sequential crew and a manager-driven hierarchical crew, then measure what handoffs lose, what a manager costs and why a text-reading manager loops.
objectives: Define Agent, Task, Crew and Process.
Run a sequential crew and trace context threading.
Compare the call cost of a hierarchical process.
Explain why routing needs state rather than wording.
Explain that expected_output is not enforcement.
objectivesKn: Agent, Task, Crew ಮತ್ತು Process ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಿಸಿ.
