cleanup ತಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಖಾಲಿ ಅಥವಾ string ಅಲ್ಲದ next_action ಅನ್ನು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ payload ಮತ್ತು ಅದರಿಂದ Markdown ರೂಪ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def trim_naive(records, keep_last=3):
    if keep_last < 0:
        raise ValueError("keep_last must not be negative")
    return records[-keep_last:]


def trim_feedback(records, keep_last=3):
    if keep_last < 0:
        raise ValueError("keep_last must not be negative")
    return records[len(records) - keep_last:] if keep_last else []


def trim_keep_failures(records, keep_last=3):
    tail = trim_feedback(records, keep_last)
    failed = [r for r in records if r["exit_code"] != 0 and r not in tail]
    return failed + tail


def generate_handoff(snap):
    if snap["cleanup"]["blocking_issues"]:
        raise ValueError("cleanup blockers: " + "; ".join(snap["cleanup"]["blocking_issues"]))
    na = snap["state"].get("next_action")
    if not isinstance(na, str) or not na.strip():
        raise ValueError("next_action is missing or blank")
    payload = {
        "summary": snap["state"]["summary"],
        "changed_files": sorted(snap["changed_files"]),
        "commands_run": [r["command"] for r in trim_keep_failures(snap["feedback"])],
        "failed_attempts": snap["state"].get("failed_attempts", []),
        "open_risks": snap["state"].get("open_risks", []),
        "next_action": na.strip(),
        "verdict_pointer": snap["verdict_pointer"],
    }
    md = ["# Handoff", ""] + [f"## {k}{chr(10)}{payload[k] if isinstance(payload[k], str) else chr(10).join('- ' + str(x) for x in payload[k]) or '(none)'}{chr(10)}" for k in FIELDS]
    return chr(10).join(md), payload"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ms_1.py","headingEn":"main(): six experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಆರು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() generates a handoff, compares a naive and a guarded trim for keep_last 3, 1 and 0, checks whether trimming drops the one failure, tries four bad snapshots, tests a vague next action and writes both files.","descKn":"main() ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರ ರಚಿಸಿ, keep_last 3, 1 ಮತ್ತು 0 ಗೆ ಸರಳ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಯ್ದ ಕತ್ತರಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ಕತ್ತರಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಏಕೈಕ ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು ಕೆಟ್ಟ snapshots ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ, ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ next action ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡೂ ಫೈಲ್ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    section("1. Genuinely running: generating the seven-field handoff")
    md, payload = generate_handoff(snapshot())
    print("fields present:", [k for k in FIELDS if k in payload], "| all seven:", all(k in payload for k in FIELDS))
    print("next_action:", payload["next_action"])
    print("commands_run kept:", payload["commands_run"])
    print("every field of the packet came from the snapshot of artifacts, not from a conversation; the next session can read next_action first and start work")

    section("2. Genuinely checking: trimming the feedback list")
    recs = [{"command": f"c{i}", "exit_code": 0} for i in range(6)]
    for k in (3, 1, 0):
        print(f"keep_last={k}: naive slice keeps {len(trim_naive(recs, k))} records | guarded version keeps {len(trim_feedback(recs, k))}")
    try:
        trim_feedback(recs, -1)
    except ValueError as e:
        print("keep_last=-1:", e)
    print("records[-0:] is records[0:], so the naive slice with keep_last=0 kept all six records instead of none; the guarded version returns an empty list, which is why the zero case has to be tested and not assumed")

    section("3. Genuinely measuring: trimming can drop the failure the next session needs")
    s = snapshot()
    kept = trim_feedback(s["feedback"])
    print("last three records only:", [(r["command"], r["exit_code"]) for r in kept])
    print("failure present in the trimmed list:", any(r["exit_code"] != 0 for r in kept))
    kept2 = trim_keep_failures(s["feedback"])
    print("failures plus last three:", [(r["command"], r["exit_code"]) for r in kept2])
    print("the only failing command, cmd1, was older than the last three records and disappeared from a plain tail trim, so a handoff built that way would not mention it; keeping every failure plus the recent tail preserved it at the cost of a longer list")

    section("4. Genuinely running: rejected handoffs")
    cases = {"blank next_action": lambda x: x["state"].update(next_action="   "), "missing next_action": lambda x: x["state"].pop("next_action"), "next_action is a list": lambda x: x["state"].update(next_action=["run tests"]),
             "cleanup blocker": lambda x: x["cleanup"].update(blocking_issues=["tests directory left in a temp state"])}
    for label, mut in cases.items():
        x = snapshot()
        mut(x)
        try:
            generate_handoff(x)
            print(f"{label:22} accepted")
        except ValueError as e:
            print(f"{label:22} rejected: {e}")
    print("a handoff with no usable next action or with unresolved cleanup blockers is refused before any file is written, because a packet that cannot tell the next session what to do is worse than none")

    section("5. Genuinely measuring: a next_action can be non-empty and useless")
    for na in ("Continue work.", "Run python -m unittest tests.test_payment_retry and inspect the timeout assertion."):
        x = snapshot()
        x["state"]["next_action"] = na
        _, p = generate_handoff(x)
        concrete = any(tok in na for tok in ("python", "tests/", "src/", ".py", "unittest"))
        print(f"{na[:48]:50} accepted, concrete by a simple keyword heuristic: {concrete}")
    print("both were accepted because the generator only checks that text exists; the keyword test here is a crude heuristic of our own that separates these two examples and would miss many cases, so specificity needs a reviewer or a stricter schema")

    section("6. Genuinely running: Markdown and JSON written side by side")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:

        back = json.loads((Path(d) / "handoff.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        print("json round trip equal:", back == payload, "| markdown headings:", [l for l in (Path(d) / "handoff.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.startswith("## ")])
    print("the JSON file is for the next agent and the Markdown for a human, both generated from the same dictionary so they cannot drift apart at creation time")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

ಪ್ರತಿ ಬದಲಾದ ಫೈಲ್ ಇದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. render_md ಹೋಲಿಕೆಗಾಗಿ JSON ನಿಂದ Markdown ಮರುನಿರ್ಮಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def load(path):
    try:
        data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
        return None, [f"cannot read handoff: {type(e).__name__}"]
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return None, ["handoff is not an object"]
    errs = []
    for k, t in FIELDS.items():
        if k not in data:
            errs.append(f"missing {k}")
        elif type(data[k]) is not t:
            errs.append(f"{k} should be {t.__name__}, got {type(data[k]).__name__}")
    if not errs and not data["next_action"].strip():
        errs.append("next_action is blank")
    return data, errs


def check_pointers(data, root):
    errs = []
    if not (root / data["verdict_pointer"]).is_file():
        errs.append(f"verdict_pointer target is missing: {data['verdict_pointer']}")
    for f in data["changed_files"]:
        if not (root / f).is_file():
            errs.append(f"changed file not found: {f}")
    return errs


def render_md(d):
    return chr(10).join(f"{k}: {d[k]}" for k in FIELDS)"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ms_2.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() loads a valid and two unreadable files, four bad packets, a packet with dangling pointers, a Markdown rendering compared after an edit and a summary against its verdict file.","descKn":"main() ಒಂದು ಮಾನ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು ಓದಲಾಗದ ಫೈಲ್, ನಾಲ್ಕು ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಪ್ಯಾಕೆಟ್, ನೇತಾಡುವ ಸೂಚಕಗಳ ಪ್ಯಾಕೆಟ್, ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ನಂತರ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದ Markdown ರೂಪ ಮತ್ತು summary ಅನ್ನು ಅದರ verdict ಫೈಲ್ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

        section("2. Genuinely running: missing and mistyped fields")

            g = good()

        print("list('python -m unittest') in Python splits the string into characters:", len(list("python -m unittest")), "items; a consumer that iterated a string commands_run would have replayed each letter as a command, which is why the type is checked and not just the presence")

        section("3. Genuinely running: pointers that no longer resolve")

        print("the packet was valid JSON with every field and still pointed at a report and a file that were not there, so schema validity is not the same as the handoff being usable; the resuming session has to check that its evidence exists")

ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಹಳೆಯದನ್ನು superseded ಗೆ ಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def identity(repo):
    return {"branch": git(repo, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"), "commit": git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")[:10], "dirty": bool(git(repo, "status", "--porcelain"))}


def is_current(handoff, repo):
    now = identity(repo)
    if now["branch"] != handoff["branch"]:
        return False, f"branch changed from {handoff['branch']} to {now['branch']}"
    if now["commit"] != handoff["commit"]:
        return False, f"{handoff['commit']} is no longer HEAD ({now['commit']})"
    return True, "handoff matches the repository"


def publish_atomic(path, payload):
    tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def publish_torn(path, payload, crash_after=15):
    text = json.dumps(payload)
    path.write_text(text[:crash_after], encoding="utf-8")


def publish_cas(pointer, new_id, expected_prev):
    cur = json.loads(pointer.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["active"] if pointer.exists() else None
    if cur != expected_prev:
        return False, f"active handoff is {cur}, not {expected_prev}"
    publish_atomic(pointer, {"active": new_id, "superseded": ([cur] if cur else [])})
    return True, f"published {new_id}""}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ms_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() builds a git repository, records identity, edits a file, adds a teammate commit and switches branch, simulates a torn write and a crash during a temp write, runs two publishers and tests three next actions against a keyword list.","descKn":"main() git repository ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ಗುರುತು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ, ಫೈಲ್ ಸಂಪಾದಿಸಿ, ಸಹೋದ್ಯೋಗಿ commit ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು branch ಬದಲಿಸಿ, torn ಬರಹ ಮತ್ತು temp ಬರಹ ಸಮಯದ crash ಅನುಕರಿಸಿ, ಇಬ್ಬರು ಪ್ರಕಾಶಕರನ್ನು ಓಡಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮೂರು next actions ಅನ್ನು keyword ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

        (repo / "a.py").write_text("v1" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")

        section("1. Genuinely running: a handoff records which repository state it describes")

ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಹಳೆಯದನ್ನು superseded ಗೆ ಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def identity(repo):
    return {"branch": git(repo, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"), "commit": git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")[:10], "dirty": bool(git(repo, "status", "--porcelain"))}


def is_current(handoff, repo):
    now = identity(repo)
    if now["branch"] != handoff["branch"]:
        return False, f"branch changed from {handoff['branch']} to {now['branch']}"
    if now["commit"] != handoff["commit"]:
        return False, f"{handoff['commit']} is no longer HEAD ({now['commit']})"
    return True, "handoff matches the repository"


def publish_atomic(path, payload):
    tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def publish_torn(path, payload, crash_after=15):
    text = json.dumps(payload)
    path.write_text(text[:crash_after], encoding="utf-8")


def publish_cas(pointer, new_id, expected_prev):
    cur = json.loads(pointer.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["active"] if pointer.exists() else None
    if cur != expected_prev:
        return False, f"active handoff is {cur}, not {expected_prev}"
    publish_atomic(pointer, {"active": new_id, "superseded": ([cur] if cur else [])})
    return True, f"published {new_id}""}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ms_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() builds a git repository, records identity, edits a file, adds a teammate commit and switches branch, simulates a torn write and a crash during a temp write, runs two publishers and tests three next actions against a keyword list.","descKn":"main() git repository ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ಗುರುತು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ, ಫೈಲ್ ಸಂಪಾದಿಸಿ, ಸಹೋದ್ಯೋಗಿ commit ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು branch ಬದಲಿಸಿ, torn ಬರಹ ಮತ್ತು temp ಬರಹ ಸಮಯದ crash ಅನುಕರಿಸಿ, ಇಬ್ಬರು ಪ್ರಕಾಶಕರನ್ನು ಓಡಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮೂರು next actions ಅನ್ನು keyword ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        repo = Path(d) / "repo"
        repo.mkdir()
        git(repo, "init", "-q", "-b", "feature-pay")
        (repo / "a.py").write_text("v1" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        git(repo, "add", "-A")
        git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", "c1")

        section("1. Genuinely running: a handoff records which repository state it describes")
        h = {"next_action": "Run the payment test.", **identity(repo)}
        print("recorded identity:", {k: h[k] for k in ("branch", "commit", "dirty")})
        print("same state:", is_current(h, repo))
        (repo / "a.py").write_text("v2" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        print("uncommitted edit afterwards, identity says dirty:", identity(repo)["dirty"], "| still current by branch and commit:", is_current(h, repo)[0])
        print("a dirty working tree after the handoff did not change the branch or commit, so this check alone did not notice it; recording the dirty flag and the changed-file hashes would be needed to catch that")
        git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "--", "a.py")

        section("2. Genuinely running: another commit and a branch switch make the handoff stale")
        (repo / "b.py").write_text("x" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        git(repo, "add", "-A")
        git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", "teammate")
        print("after a teammate's commit:", is_current(h, repo))
        git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "-b", "other-task")
        print("on another branch:", is_current(h, repo))
        print("both cases were caught by comparing the recorded branch and commit with the repository, so a fresh session can refuse to continue and ask for a new handoff instead of acting on advice about code that has moved")
        git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "feature-pay")

        section("3. Genuinely running: atomic publication versus a torn write")
        target = Path(d) / "handoff.json"
        publish_atomic(target, {"v": 1, "next_action": "old but complete"})
        publish_torn(target, {"v": 2, "next_action": "new and long enough to be cut off"})
        try:
            json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            print("after a torn write: parsed")
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            print("after a torn write: unreadable, the previous complete handoff is gone too")
        publish_atomic(target, {"v": 1, "next_action": "old but complete"})
        tmp = target.with_suffix(".tmp")
        tmp.write_text('{"v": 2, "next_ac', encoding="utf-8")
        print("crash while writing the temp file, published file still reads:", json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
        print("writing straight over the published file lost the old handoff and left a broken one, while writing a temp file and then os.replace left the previous complete handoff in place when the crash, simulated here by cutting the write short, happened during the write; the replace itself is atomic on the same volume, and a leftover temp file has to be cleaned up")

        section("4. Genuinely running: two agents publish on the same branch")
        pointer = Path(d) / "active.json"
        print("agent A publishes first:", publish_cas(pointer, "h-A", None))
        print("agent B had read 'no active handoff' and publishes:", publish_cas(pointer, "h-B", None))
        print("agent B re-reads, then publishes on top of A:", publish_cas(pointer, "h-B", "h-A"))
        print("pointer now:", json.loads(pointer.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
        print("the second publisher's stale view was refused, and after re-reading it superseded A explicitly, so A's handoff is archived and not silently overwritten; this lab's check and write are separate steps, so two truly simultaneous publishers could still race, and a real implementation needs an atomic create or a lock")

        section("5. Genuinely checking: approval boundaries in next_action")
        risky = ["Run the payment test.", "Deploy to production and run migrations.", "Delete the old branch."]
        words = ("deploy", "production", "delete", "migrat", "force")

            print(f"{na:45} needs human approval by keyword list: {bool(hit)} {hit}")
        print("a simple keyword list flagged the two risky actions and passed the safe one, but it would miss any wording not on the list; it is a safety net of our own devising, and the real boundary is that the resuming agent may not execute these actions without an approval it can verify")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

objectives: Write positive, negative and boundary tests.

Use mutants to check the tests.
Check the type before the length.
Notice when a test run is invalid.

with only the valid and short-password tests, the <= 8 mutant was still caught because the valid test uses an exactly-eight-character password, while the < 7 mutant and the no-type-check mutant survived; only the seven-character boundary test and the non-string test caught those, so positive, negative and boundary tests each catch different defects

--- 3. Genuinely checking: tests that never ran ---
empty test module: exit 5 | NO TESTS RAN
wrong module name: exit 1 | FAILED (errors=1)
neither of these exited 0 on this Python (an empty module exits 5 with NO TESTS RAN and a wrong name exits 1), so the exit code protected the gate here; the test count is still worth recording because other runners and versions may treat an empty suite differently, which this lab did not test

--- 4. Genuinely measuring: the type check before the length check ---
None               len() raises TypeError: object of type 'NoneType' has no len()
integer 12345678   len() raises TypeError: object of type 'int' has no len()
list of 8          len() works and returns 8: a length-only check would have accepted it
the fixed handler rejects each without crashing; the list of eight characters shows why the type check comes first, because its length passes a length check even though it is not a string

Every output below was genuinely produced by the lab file on Python 3.14.5. ಒಂದು ನಕಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಸ್ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಟ್ ವರ್ತನೆ ಓಡಿಸಿ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def hashes(root):
    return {str(p.relative_to(root)).replace(chr(92), "/"): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts}


def audit(before, after):
    changed = sorted(k for k in set(before) | set(after) if before.get(k) != after.get(k))
    return changed, [c for c in changed if c not in ALLOWED]


def run_tests(root):
    p = subprocess.run([PY, "-B", "-m", "unittest", "test_app"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    m = re.search(r"Ran (\d+) test", p.stderr)
    return p.returncode, int(m.group(1)) if m else 0


def probe(root):
    return subprocess.run([PY, "-B", "-I", "-c", PROBE, str(root)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60).returncode == 0


def reviewer(r):
    return {"functional": 5 if r["acceptance_met"] else 0, "test_evidence": 5 if r["tests_actually_run"] else 0, "scope": 5 if not r["files_outside_scope"] else 0, "handoff": 5 if r["handoff"] else 0}


def pipeline(name, base):
    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / name
    shutil.copytree(base, root)
    before = hashes(root)
    handoff = False
    if name == "prompt_only":
        (root / "app.py").write_text(app(8), encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "README.md").write_text("Updated docs for signup." + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        code, ran = None, 0
    elif name == "workbench":
        (root / "app.py").write_text(app(8), encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "test_app.py").write_text(HEAD + T_VALID + T_SHORT + T_BOUND, encoding="utf-8")
        code, ran = run_tests(root)
        handoff = True
    else:
        (root / "app.py").write_text(app(7), encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "test_app.py").write_text(HEAD + T_VALID + T_SHORT, encoding="utf-8")
        code, ran = run_tests(root)
        handoff = True
    changed, outside = audit(before, hashes(root))
    r = {"pipeline": name, "own_tests_exit": code, "tests_run": ran, "tests_actually_run": code == 0 and ran > 0, "acceptance_met": probe(root), "files_changed": changed, "files_outside_scope": outside, "handoff": handoff}
    r["gate"] = "ALLOW" if r["tests_actually_run"] and r["acceptance_met"] and not outside else "BLOCK"
    r["review"] = sum(reviewer(r).values())
    return r"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"rw_2.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs the three pipelines, compares tests-run with acceptance-met, shows what running tests without -B does to a hash audit, compares a baseline audit with a bare directory listing and writes comparison.json.","descKn":"main() ಮೂರು pipelines ಓಡಿಸಿ, tests-run ಅನ್ನು acceptance-met ಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, -B ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಓಡಿಸಿದರೆ hash ಲೆಕ್ಕಪರಿಶೋಧನೆಗೆ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸಿ, baseline ಲೆಕ್ಕಪರಿಶೋಧನೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇವಲ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ comparison.json ಬರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    base = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "base"
    base.mkdir()
    (base / "app.py").write_text(APP_BASE, encoding="utf-8")
    (base / "test_app.py").write_text("import unittest" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
    (base / "README.md").write_text("Protected docs." + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")

    section("1. Genuinely running: three scripted pipelines on separate copies of one fixture")

    print("the prompt-only script fixed the code correctly (the probe passed) but ran no tests, edited the protected README and left no handoff; the workbench script passed every check; the third script shipped an off-by-one bug whose own weak tests passed and was caught only by the independent probe")

    section("2. Genuinely measuring: acceptance and tests are different facts")
    for r in results:
        print(f"{r['pipeline']:22} tests_actually_run={r['tests_actually_run']!s:5} acceptance_met={r['acceptance_met']}")

    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "audit"

    print("an audit that hashes every file would have flagged these as scope violations; the lab excludes __pycache__ and runs with -B, and a real audit needs an explicit ignore list for generated files")

    section("4. Genuinely checking: the baseline is what makes the audit work")

    (root / "release.sh").write_text("echo release --prod" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
    print("changes found by comparing with the baseline hashes:", audit(hashes(base), hashes(root))[1])

    section("5. Genuinely writing: comparison.json")

ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡು allowlist ಮತ್ತು timeout ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ ಎಂದೂ shell ಬಳಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. verify_task ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಬಯಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def changed_paths(repo, base):
    out = set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", f"{base}..HEAD").splitlines())
    out |= set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames").splitlines())
    out |= set(git(repo, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard").splitlines())
    return sorted(out)


def validate_relative_path(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or "\x00" in value:
        raise ValueError("path must be a non-empty string")
    if value.startswith(("/", chr(92))) or PureWindowsPath(value).drive:
        raise ValueError("path must be relative")
    parts = PurePosixPath(value.replace(chr(92), "/")).parts
    if ".." in parts:
        raise ValueError("path must not contain ..")
    return "/".join(p for p in parts if p != ".")


def run_checked(argv, cwd, timeout=20, allow=("python", "git")):
    if not isinstance(argv, list) or not argv or not all(isinstance(a, str) for a in argv):
        raise ValueError("argv must be a non-empty list of strings")
    if Path(argv[0]).stem.lower() not in allow and argv[0] != sys.executable:
        raise ValueError(f"program not allowed: {argv[0]}")
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, shell=False)
        return {"exit": p.returncode, "timed_out": False}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"exit": None, "timed_out": True}


def verify_task(contract, evidence):
    problems = []
    for key in ("baseline_commit", "acceptance_exit", "tests_run", "changed"):
        if key not in evidence:
            problems.append(f"missing evidence: {key}")
    if problems:
        return "BLOCK", problems
    if evidence["acceptance_exit"] != 0 or evidence["tests_run"] < 1:
        problems.append("acceptance did not pass with at least one test")
    problems += [f"outside scope: {c}" for c in evidence["changed"] if c not in contract["allowed"]]
    return ("BLOCK" if problems else "ALLOW"), problems"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"rw_3.py","headingEn":"main(): six experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಆರು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() builds a repository and records a baseline, makes a task worktree, validates nine paths, runs the runner on good and bad commands, runs the verifier on four evidence sets and simulates experiments of 5, 20 and 200 trials per arm under assumed rates.","descKn":"main() repository ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ baseline ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ, ಕಾರ್ಯ worktree ಮಾಡಿ, ಒಂಬತ್ತು paths ಮಾನ್ಯಗೊಳಿಸಿ, runner ಅನ್ನು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಆದೇಶಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಓಡಿಸಿ, verifier ಅನ್ನು ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಸೆಟ್‌ಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಓಡಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಊಹಿಸಿದ ದರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬದಿಗೆ 5, 20 ಮತ್ತು 200 ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

    out |= set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames").splitlines())
    out |= set(git(repo, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard").splitlines())
    return sorted(out)


def validate_relative_path(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or "\x00" in value:
        raise ValueError("path must be a non-empty string")
    if value.startswith(("/", chr(92))) or PureWindowsPath(value).drive:
        raise ValueError("path must be relative")
    parts = PurePosixPath(value.replace(chr(92), "/")).parts
    if ".." in parts:
        raise ValueError("path must not contain ..")
    return "/".join(p for p in parts if p != ".")


def run_checked(argv, cwd, timeout=20, allow=("python", "git")):
    if not isinstance(argv, list) or not argv or not all(isinstance(a, str) for a in argv):
        raise ValueError("argv must be a non-empty list of strings")
    if Path(argv[0]).stem.lower() not in allow and argv[0] != sys.executable:
        raise ValueError(f"program not allowed: {argv[0]}")
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, shell=False)
        return {"exit": p.returncode, "timed_out": False}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"exit": None, "timed_out": True}

    if evidence["acceptance_exit"] != 0 or evidence["tests_run"] < 1:

ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def build_pack(root):
    for rel, text in FILES.items():
        p = root / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="")


def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def make_manifest(root):
    return {"version": (root / "VERSION").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip(), "files": {str(p.relative_to(root)).replace(chr(92), "/"): digest(p) for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")) if p.is_file() and p.name != "MANIFEST.json"}}


def verify_pack(root):
    m = json.loads((root / "MANIFEST.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cur = make_manifest(root)
    problems = [f"missing: {f}" for f in m["files"] if f not in cur["files"]]
    problems += [f"modified: {f}" for f in m["files"] if f in cur["files"] and cur["files"][f] != m["files"][f]]
    problems += [f"unexpected: {f}" for f in cur["files"] if f not in m["files"]]
    if cur["version"] != m["version"]:
        problems.append(f"VERSION says {cur['version']}, manifest says {m['version']}")
    return problems


def work_files_in(root):
    return sorted(str(p.relative_to(root)).replace(chr(92), "/") for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.name in WORK_NAMES)


def validate(state, schema):
    errs = []
    for k in schema["required"]:
        if k not in state:
            errs.append(f"missing {k}")
    for k, spec in schema["properties"].items():
        if k not in state:
            continue
        v = state[k]
        t = spec["type"]
        if t == "string" and type(v) is not str or t == "integer" and type(v) is not int:
            errs.append(f"{k} must be {t}")
            continue
        if "enum" in spec and v not in spec["enum"]:
            errs.append(f"{k} must be one of {spec['enum']}")
        if "minimum" in spec and v < spec["minimum"]:
            errs.append(f"{k} must be at least {spec['minimum']}")
    return errs"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"pk_1.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() builds the pack and a manifest, damages it four ways, drops work files into it, validates six states against the schema and builds the pack twice to compare digests.","descKn":"main() ಪ್ಯಾಕ್ ಮತ್ತು manifest ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ಅದನ್ನು ನಾಲ್ಕು ರೀತಿ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಿ, work ಫೈಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಅದರೊಳಗೆ ಹಾಕಿ, ಆರು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು schema ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಮಾನ್ಯಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು digests ಹೋಲಿಸಲು ಪ್ಯಾಕ್ ಅನ್ನು ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        pack = Path(d) / "agent-workbench-pack"
        pack.mkdir()
        build_pack(pack)

        section("1. Genuinely running: the pack layout and its manifest")
        print("files:", sorted(str(p.relative_to(pack)).replace(chr(92), "/") for p in pack.rglob("*") if p.is_file()))
        man = make_manifest(pack)
        (pack / "MANIFEST.json").write_text(json.dumps(man, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print("manifest version:", man["version"], "| files listed:", len(man["files"]), "| verify on a fresh pack:", verify_pack(pack))
        print("a manifest of digests turns 'the pack looks right' into something a script can check")

        section("2. Genuinely running: the verifier finds each kind of damage")
        (pack / "AGENTS.md").write_text("# Rules" + chr(10) + "- do whatever" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        print("edited rule file:", verify_pack(pack))
        (pack / "AGENTS.md").write_text(FILES["AGENTS.md"], encoding="utf-8", newline="")
        (pack / "docs/handoff.md").unlink()
        print("deleted file    :", verify_pack(pack))
        (pack / "docs/handoff.md").write_text(FILES["docs/handoff.md"], encoding="utf-8", newline="")
        (pack / "notes.txt").write_text("stray", encoding="utf-8")
        print("extra file      :", verify_pack(pack))
        (pack / "notes.txt").unlink()
        (pack / "VERSION").write_text("1.3.0" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        print("version bumped without rebuilding the manifest:", verify_pack(pack))
        (pack / "VERSION").write_text(FILES["VERSION"], encoding="utf-8", newline="")
        print("restored:", verify_pack(pack))
        print("an edit, a deletion, a stray file and a version bump were each reported by name; a changed VERSION is reported twice because its digest and the version string both disagree with the manifest")

        section("3. Genuinely running: infrastructure versus work")
        print("work files in the clean pack:", work_files_in(pack))
        (pack / "agent_state.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
        (pack / "scripts/feedback_record.jsonl").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        print("after someone runs a task inside the pack directory:", work_files_in(pack))
        print("verify_pack:", verify_pack(pack))
        print("the pack holds reusable capability, and files that record one project's work do not belong in it; the manifest check reported them as unexpected, which is how a pack stays free of project state")
        (pack / "agent_state.json").unlink()
        (pack / "scripts/feedback_record.jsonl").unlink()

        section("4. Genuinely running: the state schema as a contract")
        schema = json.loads((pack / "schemas/agent_state.schema.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        cases = [("valid", {"task_id": "T1", "status": "doing", "attempts": 2}), ("missing status", {"task_id": "T1", "attempts": 0}), ("bad status", {"task_id": "T1", "status": "finished", "attempts": 0}),
                 ("attempts is a string", {"task_id": "T1", "status": "todo", "attempts": "2"}), ("attempts is True", {"task_id": "T1", "status": "todo", "attempts": True}), ("negative attempts", {"task_id": "T1", "status": "todo", "attempts": -1})]
        for label, st in cases:
            print(f"{label:22} {validate(st, schema)}")
        print("every bad state was refused with a reason, including True as an integer, which Python would otherwise accept; this is a tiny validator written for the lab, not a full JSON Schema implementation, and it checks only required, type, enum and minimum")

        section("5. Genuinely checking: the same pack built twice")
        other = Path(d) / "second"
        other.mkdir()
        build_pack(other)
        print("manifest of two separate builds identical:", make_manifest(pack)["files"] == make_manifest(other)["files"])
        print("because the pack is built from fixed text, two builds have identical digests, which is what lets a repository record 'installed pack 1.2.0' and trust it to mean one specific set of files")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def build_pack(root):
    for rel, text in FILES.items():
        p = root / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="")


def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def make_manifest(root):
    return {"version": (root / "VERSION").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip(), "files": {str(p.relative_to(root)).replace(chr(92), "/"): digest(p) for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")) if p.is_file() and p.name != "MANIFEST.json"}}


def verify_pack(root):
    m = json.loads((root / "MANIFEST.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cur = make_manifest(root)
    problems = [f"missing: {f}" for f in m["files"] if f not in cur["files"]]
    problems += [f"modified: {f}" for f in m["files"] if f in cur["files"] and cur["files"][f] != m["files"][f]]
    problems += [f"unexpected: {f}" for f in cur["files"] if f not in m["files"]]

    return sorted(str(p.relative_to(root)).replace(chr(92), "/") for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.name in WORK_NAMES)


def validate(state, schema):
    errs = []
    for k in schema["required"]:
        if k not in state:
            errs.append(f"missing {k}")
    for k, spec in schema["properties"].items():
        if k not in state:

        if "enum" in spec and v not in spec["enum"]:
            errs.append(f"{k} must be one of {spec['enum']}")
        if "minimum" in spec and v < spec["minimum"]:
            errs.append(f"{k} must be at least {spec['minimum']}")

ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ಫೈಲ್‌ಗಳು ಇವೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. naive_install ಫೈಲ್ ಫೈಲ್ ಆಗಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಗುರಿಗೆ ನಕಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def install(pack, target, force=False, fail_after=None):
    pack, target = Path(pack), Path(target)
    if not target.is_dir():
        return "error", f"target does not exist: {target.name}"
    if (target / LOCK).exists() and not force:
        return "skipped", f"already installed ({(target / LOCK).read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()}), nothing changed"
    version = (pack / "VERSION").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=target.parent))
    try:
        for i, p in enumerate(sorted(q for q in pack.rglob("*") if q.is_file())):
            if fail_after is not None and i >= fail_after:
                raise RuntimeError("simulated crash")
            dst = stage / p.relative_to(pack)
            dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(p, dst)
        (stage / LOCK).write_text(version + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        for p in sorted(q for q in stage.rglob("*") if q.is_file()):
            dst = target / p.relative_to(stage)
            dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(p, dst)
    except RuntimeError as e:
        return "failed", str(e)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
    missing = [rel for rel in PACK if not (target / rel).is_file()]
    return ("installed", f"version {version}") if not missing else ("verify-failed", f"missing {missing}")


def naive_install(pack, target, fail_after=None):
    for i, p in enumerate(sorted(q for q in Path(pack).rglob("*") if q.is_file())):
        if fail_after is not None and i >= fail_after:
            raise RuntimeError("simulated crash")
        dst = Path(target) / p.relative_to(pack)
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(p, dst)"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"pk_2.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() installs three times and into a missing target, customises a file and installs with and without force, installs into a repository with its own AGENTS.md, simulates a crash in both installers and runs the installed verify script.","descKn":"main() ಮೂರು ಬಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಣೆಯಾದ ಗುರಿಗೆ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿ, ಫೈಲ್ ಕಸ್ಟಮೈಸ್ ಮಾಡಿ force ಜೊತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿ, ತನ್ನದೇ AGENTS.md ಇರುವ repository ಗೆ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿ, ಎರಡೂ installers ನಲ್ಲಿ crash ಅನುಕರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿತ verify ಸ್ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಟ್ ಓಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        pack = root / "pack"
        pack.mkdir()
        make_pack(pack)

        section("1. Genuinely running: first install, repeat install, and a missing target")
        t = root / "repo-a"
        t.mkdir()
        print("first run  :", install(pack, t))
        snap = tree(t)
        print("second run :", install(pack, t))
        print("third run  :", install(pack, t))
        print("files unchanged after the repeats:", tree(t) == snap, "| files:", sorted(snap))
        print("missing target:", install(pack, root / "nope"))
        print("the repeated runs reported 'already installed' and left every file byte-identical, which is what makes the installer safe to rerun from automation; a target that does not exist is an error and nothing is created")

        section("2. Genuinely running: the customised file and --force")
        (t / "AGENTS.md").write_text("# Rules" + chr(10) + "- our team's own rule" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        before = (t / "AGENTS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        print("without --force:", install(pack, t)[0], "| custom rule kept:", "our team's own rule" in (t / "AGENTS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        print("with --force   :", install(pack, t, force=True)[0], "| custom rule kept:", "our team's own rule" in (t / "AGENTS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        print("the team's customisation was protected by the default and destroyed by --force, with no backup made; the flag is an explicit decision to overwrite, and a safer installer would copy the old file aside first")

        section("3. Genuinely running: a repository that already has its own AGENTS.md")
        u = root / "repo-b"
        u.mkdir()
        (u / "AGENTS.md").write_text("# existing project rules" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        print("installer:", install(pack, u)[0], "| existing file now reads:", (u / "AGENTS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
        print("the installer saw no version lock, so it treated the repository as fresh and overwrote a file it did not create; the lock only identifies earlier installs of the pack, so a conflict check against pre-existing files is a separate rule that a lock-only check does not provide")

        section("4. Genuinely measuring: a crash halfway through")
        a, b = root / "repo-c", root / "repo-d"
        a.mkdir(); b.mkdir()
        try:
            naive_install(pack, a, fail_after=2)
        except RuntimeError:
            pass
        print("naive copy after a crash : files", sorted(tree(a)), "| version lock present:", LOCK in tree(a))
        print("staged install after one :", install(pack, b, fail_after=2), "| files:", sorted(tree(b)))
        print("leftover staging directories next to the repos:", sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir() if p.name.startswith("tmp")))
        print("the naive copy left a repository with some pack files and no lock, which the next run would treat as a fresh install, while the staged install wrote nothing to the target before the crash; the copy from staging into the target is itself not atomic, so a crash during that last step could still leave a partial result")

        section("5. Genuinely running: the installed verify script works from the target")

archives ಹೋಲಿಸಬಹುದು.","code":"def parse(v):
    try:
        parts = tuple(int(x) for x in v.split("."))
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f"not a numeric version: {v!r}")
    if len(parts) != 3:
        raise ValueError(f"expected three numbers: {v!r}")
    return parts


def h(text):
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]


def plan_upgrade(installed, new, target_files, recorded):
    plan = {"add": [], "update": [], "keep_customised": [], "remove": []}
    for rel, text in new.items():
        if rel not in target_files:
            plan["add"].append(rel)
        elif h(target_files[rel]) == recorded.get(rel):
            plan["update"].append(rel)
        else:
            plan["keep_customised"].append(rel)
    plan["remove"] = [rel for rel in recorded if rel not in new and rel in target_files and h(target_files[rel]) == recorded[rel]]
    return plan


def make_zip(files, stamp):
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for rel in sorted(files):
            z.writestr(zipfile.ZipInfo(rel, date_time=stamp), files[rel])

    section("1. Genuinely measuring: comparing versions as strings")
    for a, b in (("1.9.0", "1.10.0"), ("1.2.0", "1.10.0"), ("2.0.0", "10.0.0")):
        print(f"{a} < {b}: as strings {a < b!s:5} | as number tuples {parse(a) < parse(b)}")
    for bad in ("1.2", "1.2.x", "v1.2.0", ""):
        try:
            parse(bad)
        except ValueError as e:
            print(f"parse({bad!r}) rejected: {e}")
    print("as strings, '1.9.0' < '1.10.0' is False, so an installer that compared version strings would call 1.9.0 newer than 1.10.0 and skip a genuine upgrade; comparing tuples of integers gives the right answer, and malformed versions are refused instead of guessed")

    section("2. Genuinely running: a dry-run upgrade plan that respects customisation")
    target = dict(PACK_V1)
    target["AGENTS.md"] = "rules v1" + chr(10) + "our own rule" + chr(10)
    recorded = {rel: h(text) for rel, text in PACK_V1.items()}
    plan = plan_upgrade("1.0.0", PACK_V2, target, recorded)
    for k, v in plan.items():
        print(f"{k:16} {v}")
    print("the customised AGENTS.md was kept and listed for manual merge, the unchanged verify script was updated, the new template was added and the schema the new version no longer ships was proposed for removal because it was unmodified; this needs the digests recorded at install time, which a bare version lock does not store")

    section("3. Genuinely running: uninstall removes only what the pack installed")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        for rel, text in {**PACK_V1, "agent_state.json": "{}", "src/app.py": "code"}.items():
            p = root / rel
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
        for rel in PACK_V1:
            (root / rel).unlink()
        left = sorted(str(p.relative_to(root)).replace(chr(92), "/") for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
        print("left after removing the recorded pack files:", left)
        print("removing by a recorded list left the project's state and source files alone; a rule such as 'delete the schemas, scripts and docs folders' would have hit any project file placed there, so uninstall needs the same manifest the install used")

    section("4. Genuinely measuring: are zip archives of the same files byte-identical?")
    a = make_zip(PACK_V1, (2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
    b = make_zip(PACK_V1, (2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
    time.sleep(2.1)
    c = make_zip(PACK_V1, tuple(time.localtime()[:6]))
    print("fixed timestamps, built twice:", hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()[:10] == hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()[:10])
    print("current timestamp versus fixed:", hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()[:10] == hashlib.sha256(c).hexdigest()[:10])
    print("with entry timestamps pinned the same files gave the same archive bytes, and with the current time the archive differed even though no file changed; a pack that is published should be built with pinned timestamps so its digest identifies its contents")

    section("5. Genuinely running: an end-to-end smoke test in a git repository")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        repo = Path(d)
        git = ["git", "-c", "user.name=lab", "-c", "user.email=lab@example.com", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false"]
        subprocess.run(git + ["init", "-q"], cwd=repo, check=True)
        (repo / "app.py").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
        subprocess.run(git + ["add", "-A"], cwd=repo, check=True)
        subprocess.run(git + ["commit", "-q", "-m", "init"], cwd=repo, check=True)
        for rel, text in PACK_V2.items():
            p = repo / rel
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
        (repo / ".workbench-version").write_text("2.0.0" + chr(10), encoding="utf-8")
        status = subprocess.run(git + ["status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()
        print("untracked after install:", sorted(s[3:] for s in status))
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(repo / "scripts/verify_agent.py")], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print("installed verify script:", run.returncode, run.stdout.strip())
        subprocess.run(git + ["add", "-A"], cwd=repo, check=True)
        subprocess.run(git + ["commit", "-q", "-m", "install workbench pack 2.0.0"], cwd=repo, check=True)
        print("committed; clean tree:", subprocess.run(git + ["status", "--porcelain"], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout == "")
    print("the install showed up in the repository as new files that can be reviewed and committed like any change, and the installed script ran; a smoke test like this checks that a freshly installed pack works in a repository it has never seen")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

        raise ValueError(f"not a numeric version: {v!r}")
    if len(parts) != 3:
        raise ValueError(f"expected three numbers: {v!r}")
    return parts


def h(text):
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]

    plan = {"add": [], "update": [], "keep_customised": [], "remove": []}
    for rel, text in new.items():

            plan["add"].append(rel)
        elif h(target_files[rel]) == recorded.get(rel):
            plan["update"].append(rel)
        else:

--- 3. Genuinely running: uninstall removes only what the pack installed ---

fixed timestamps, built twice: True
current timestamp versus fixed: False

ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ದೋಷ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿಕ್ರಮಣವನ್ನು ಎರಡೂ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def is_nonempty(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip())


def normalize_path(value):
    raw = value.strip().replace(chr(92), "/")
    path = PurePosixPath(raw)
    if path.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError("absolute paths are not allowed")
    parts = []
    for part in path.parts:
        if part in ("", "."):
            continue
        if part == "..":
            raise ValueError("parent traversal is not allowed")
        parts.append(part)
    return "/".join(parts)


def path_covers(parent, child):
    return child == parent or child.startswith(parent + "/")


def validate_task_frame(frame):
    errors = []
    if not is_nonempty(frame.goal):
        errors.append("Goal is required.")
    for i, fact in enumerate(frame.repository_facts, start=1):
        if not is_nonempty(fact.claim):
            errors.append(f"Repository fact {i} has no claim.")
        if not is_nonempty(fact.evidence):
            errors.append(f"Repository fact {i} has no evidence receipt.")
    if not frame.allowed_paths:
        errors.append("At least one allowed path is required.")
    allowed, forbidden = [], []
    for label, raw_list, out in (("allowed", frame.allowed_paths, allowed), ("forbidden", frame.forbidden_paths, forbidden)):
        for raw in raw_list:
            try:
                n = normalize_path(raw)
                if not n:
                    errors.append(f"A {label} path cannot be empty.")
                else:
                    out.append(n)
            except ValueError as exc:
                errors.append(f"Invalid {label} path {raw!r}: {exc}.")
    for a in allowed:
        for f in forbidden:
            if path_covers(a, f) or path_covers(f, a):
                errors.append(f"Allowed and forbidden paths overlap: {a!r} vs {f!r}.")
    if not [c for c in frame.acceptance_commands if is_nonempty(c)]:
        errors.append("At least one acceptance command is required.")
    for i, u in enumerate(frame.unknowns, start=1):
        if not is_nonempty(u.question):
            errors.append(f"Unknown {i} has no question.")
        if u.category not in VALID_CATEGORIES:
            errors.append(f"Unknown {i} has invalid category {u.category!r}.")
        if not is_nonempty(u.action):
            errors.append(f"Unknown {i} has no planned action.")
    return errors"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"tf_1.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs the four required breakages, collects errors from a multiply-broken frame, compares directory-aware coverage with a naive prefix test, normalises nine paths and shows three weak frames that still pass.","descKn":"main() ನಾಲ್ಕು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಮುರಿತಗಳನ್ನು ಓಡಿಸಿ, ಬಹು-ಮುರಿದ frame ನಿಂದ ದೋಷ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ, ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿ-ಅರಿವಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಸರಳ ಪೂರ್ವಪದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ಒಂಬತ್ತು paths ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯೀಕರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್ನೂ ಪಾಸ್ ಆಗುವ ಮೂರು ದುರ್ಬಲ frames ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    section("1. Genuinely running: the example frame and the four required breakages")
    base = example_task_frame()
    print("valid frame errors:", validate_task_frame(base))
    cases = []
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.goal = ""; cases.append(("remove the goal", f))
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.repository_facts[0].evidence = ""; cases.append(("remove a fact receipt", f))
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.allowed_paths = ["src/accounts/"]; f.forbidden_paths = ["src/accounts/service.py"]; cases.append(("overlap the paths", f))
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.acceptance_commands = []; cases.append(("remove acceptance command", f))
    for label, fr in cases:
        print(f"{label:26} -> {validate_task_frame(fr)}")
    print("each breakage produced its own specific message and nothing else, so the four failures are distinguishable and a generic 'invalid task' is never needed")

    section("2. Genuinely running: errors are collected, not stopped at the first")
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.goal = "   "; f.acceptance_commands = [""]; f.allowed_paths = []
    errs = validate_task_frame(f)
    print(len(errs), "errors in one run:", errs)
    print("a whitespace-only goal, a blank command and a missing allowed path were all reported together, which lets the author fix several problems in one pass; the tests should assert the specific message rather than the whole list for this reason")

    section("3. Genuinely measuring: directory-aware coverage versus a naive prefix test")
    for parent, child in (("src/accounts", "src/accounts/service.py"), ("src/accounts", "src/accounts_old/service.py"), ("src/accounts", "src/accounts"), ("src/accounts/service.py", "src/accounts")):
        print(f"{parent:26} covers {child:30} directory-aware={path_covers(parent, child)!s:5} naive startswith={child.startswith(parent)}")
    print("the naive startswith test said src/accounts covers src/accounts_old, which is a different directory, while the directory-aware test did not; and the last row is False in this direction, which is why the validator checks coverage both ways")

    section("4. Genuinely running: lexical path normalisation")
    for p in ("src/accounts/", "src/./accounts", "src\\accounts", "  src/accounts  ", "/etc/config", "../secrets", "src/../secrets", "", "."):

        except ValueError as e:
            print(f"{p!r:22} rejected: {e}")
    print("trailing slashes, dot segments, backslashes and padding all collapsed to one form, and absolute or parent-traversal paths were rejected; an empty string and a single dot normalised to an empty path, which the validator reports separately; this is lexical only and says nothing about symlinks or the real filesystem")

    section("5. Genuinely measuring: what the nonempty checks do not catch")
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.acceptance_commands = ["", "echo all tests passed"]
    print("acceptance commands ['', 'echo all tests passed']:", validate_task_frame(f))
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.goal = "Improve everything"

    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.repository_facts[0].evidence = "somewhere in the tests"

    return isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip())


def normalize_path(value):
    raw = value.strip().replace(chr(92), "/")
    path = PurePosixPath(raw)
    if path.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError("absolute paths are not allowed")
    parts = []
    for part in path.parts:
        if part in ("", "."):
            continue
        if part == "..":
            raise ValueError("parent traversal is not allowed")
        parts.append(part)
    return "/".join(parts)


def path_covers(parent, child):
    return child == parent or child.startswith(parent + "/")


def validate_task_frame(frame):
    errors = []
    if not is_nonempty(frame.goal):
        errors.append("Goal is required.")
    for i, fact in enumerate(frame.repository_facts, start=1):
        if not is_nonempty(fact.claim):
            errors.append(f"Repository fact {i} has no claim.")
        if not is_nonempty(fact.evidence):
            errors.append(f"Repository fact {i} has no evidence receipt.")
    if not frame.allowed_paths:
        errors.append("At least one allowed path is required.")
    allowed, forbidden = [], []
    for label, raw_list, out in (("allowed", frame.allowed_paths, allowed), ("forbidden", frame.forbidden_paths, forbidden)):
        for raw in raw_list:
            try:
                n = normalize_path(raw)
                if not n:
                    errors.append(f"A {label} path cannot be empty.")
                else:
                    out.append(n)
            except ValueError as exc:
                errors.append(f"Invalid {label} path {raw!r}: {exc}.")
    for a in allowed:
        for f in forbidden:
            if path_covers(a, f) or path_covers(f, a):
                errors.append(f"Allowed and forbidden paths overlap: {a!r} vs {f!r}.")
    if not [c for c in frame.acceptance_commands if is_nonempty(c)]:
        errors.append("At least one acceptance command is required.")
    for i, u in enumerate(frame.unknowns, start=1):
        if not is_nonempty(u.question):
            errors.append(f"Unknown {i} has no question.")
        if u.category not in VALID_CATEGORIES:
            errors.append(f"Unknown {i} has invalid category {u.category!r}.")
        if not is_nonempty(u.action):
            errors.append(f"Unknown {i} has no planned action.")
    return errors"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"tf_1.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs the four required breakages, collects errors from a multiply-broken frame, compares directory-aware coverage with a naive prefix test, normalises nine paths and shows three weak frames that still pass.","descKn":"main() ನಾಲ್ಕು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಮುರಿತಗಳನ್ನು ಓಡಿಸಿ, ಬಹು-ಮುರಿದ frame ನಿಂದ ದೋಷ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ, ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿ-ಅರಿವಿನ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಸರಳ ಪೂರ್ವಪದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ಒಂಬತ್ತು paths ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯೀಕರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್ನೂ ಪಾಸ್ ಆಗುವ ಮೂರು ದುರ್ಬಲ frames ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    section("1. Genuinely running: the example frame and the four required breakages")
    base = example_task_frame()
    print("valid frame errors:", validate_task_frame(base))
    cases = []
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.goal = ""; cases.append(("remove the goal", f))
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.repository_facts[0].evidence = ""; cases.append(("remove a fact receipt", f))
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.allowed_paths = ["src/accounts/"]; f.forbidden_paths = ["src/accounts/service.py"]; cases.append(("overlap the paths", f))
    f = copy.deepcopy(base); f.acceptance_commands = []; cases.append(("remove acceptance command", f))

    print("each breakage produced its own specific message and nothing else, so the four failures are distinguishable and a generic 'invalid task' is never needed")

    section("2. Genuinely running: errors are collected, not stopped at the first")

    errs = validate_task_frame(f)
    print(len(errs), "errors in one run:", errs)
    print("a whitespace-only goal, a blank command and a missing allowed path were all reported together, which lets the author fix several problems in one pass; the tests should assert the specific message rather than the whole list for this reason")

        print(f"{parent:26} covers {child:30} directory-aware={path_covers(parent, child)!s:5} naive startswith={child.startswith(parent)}")

def render(goal, facts, allowed, forbidden, commands, unknowns):
    lines = ["# Task Frame", "", "## Goal", "", goal.strip(), "", "## Repository Facts", ""]
    lines += [f"- **Claim:** {c}" + chr(10) + f"  - **Evidence:** `{e}`" for c, e in facts] or ["- No repository facts recorded."]
    lines += ["", "## Allowed Paths", ""] + [f"- {p}" for p in allowed]
    lines += ["", "## Forbidden Paths", ""] + [f"- {p}" for p in forbidden]
    lines += ["", "## Acceptance Commands", ""] + [f"- `{c}`" for c in commands]
    lines += ["", "## Unknowns", ""] + [f"- {cat}: {q}" for q, cat in unknowns]
    return chr(10).join(lines) + chr(10)


def headings(md):
    return [ln for ln in md.splitlines() if ln.startswith("## ")]


def sanitise(text):
    return " ".join(text.split()).replace("#", "")"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"tf_2.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() renders and audits a frame, runs the program three times in a temporary directory, injects headings through the goal, renames a heading and tests four receipt strings against a shape check.","descKn":"main() frame ರೂಪಿಸಿ ಲೆಕ್ಕಪರಿಶೋಧಿಸಿ, ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂ ಮೂರು ಬಾರಿ ಓಡಿಸಿ, ಗುರಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೂರಿಸಿ, ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆ ಮರುಹೆಸರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಾಲ್ಕು ರಸೀದಿ ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಆಕಾರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main(out_dir, goal, commands):

    lines += [f"- **Claim:** {c}" + chr(10) + f"  - **Evidence:** `{e}`" for c, e in facts] or ["- No repository facts recorded."]
    lines += ["", "## Allowed Paths", ""] + [f"- {p}" for p in allowed]
    lines += ["", "## Forbidden Paths", ""] + [f"- {p}" for p in forbidden]
    lines += ["", "## Acceptance Commands", ""] + [f"- `{c}`" for c in commands]
    lines += ["", "## Unknowns", ""] + [f"- {cat}: {q}" for q, cat in unknowns]
    return chr(10).join(lines) + chr(10)


def headings(md):
    return [ln for ln in md.splitlines() if ln.startswith("## ")]


def sanitise(text):
    return " ".join(text.split()).replace("#", "")"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"tf_2.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() renders and audits a frame, runs the program three times in a temporary directory, injects headings through the goal, renames a heading and tests four receipt strings against a shape check.","descKn":"main() frame ರೂಪಿಸಿ ಲೆಕ್ಕಪರಿಶೋಧಿಸಿ, ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂ ಮೂರು ಬಾರಿ ಓಡಿಸಿ, ಗುರಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೂರಿಸಿ, ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆ ಮರುಹೆಸರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಾಲ್ಕು ರಸೀದಿ ಸ್ಟ್ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಆಕಾರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main(out_dir, goal, commands):

ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def check_receipt(repo, claim_keyword, receipt):
    m = re.fullmatch(r"([\w./-]+):(\d+)", receipt)
    if not m:
        return "malformed receipt"
    path, line = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
    f = Path(repo) / path
    if not f.is_file():
        return "file not found"
    lines = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    if line > len(lines):
        return f"line {line} beyond end of file ({len(lines)} lines)"
    return "supported" if claim_keyword in lines[line - 1] else "line exists but does not support the claim"


POLICY = {"discoverable": "investigate", "decidable": "decide within delegated authority and record it", "human": "stop and ask", "deferred": "record as a non-goal"}


def next_step(unknowns):
    steps = [(q, POLICY[c]) for q, c in unknowns]
    blocked = [q for q, c in unknowns if c == "human"]
    return steps, blocked


def changed_files(repo, base):
    out = set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", base).splitlines())
    out |= set(git(repo, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard").splitlines())
    return sorted(out)


def covered(path, prefix):
    prefix = prefix.rstrip("/")
    return path == prefix or path.startswith(prefix + "/")


def audit(files, allowed, forbidden):
    bad = []
    for f in files:
        if any(covered(f, p) for p in forbidden):
            bad.append((f, "forbidden"))
        elif not any(covered(f, p) for p in allowed):
            bad.append((f, "outside allowed paths"))
    return bad"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"tf_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() builds a git repository, resolves five receipts, maps four unknowns, audits an allowed edit then a forbidden migration and a README, runs three acceptance commands and checks a test that asserts nothing about registration.","descKn":"main() git repository ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ಐದು ರಸೀದಿ ಪರಿಹರಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು ಅಜ್ಞಾತ ಮ್ಯಾಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಅನುಮತಿಸಿದ ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ನಂತರ ನಿಷೇಧಿತ migration ಮತ್ತು README ಲೆಕ್ಕಪರಿಶೋಧಿಸಿ, ಮೂರು ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ ಆದೇಶ ಓಡಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ನೋಂದಣಿ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಏನನ್ನೂ ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def check_receipt(repo, claim_keyword, receipt):
    m = re.fullmatch(r"([\w./-]+):(\d+)", receipt)
    if not m:
        return "malformed receipt"
    path, line = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
    f = Path(repo) / path
    if not f.is_file():
        return "file not found"
    lines = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    if line > len(lines):
        return f"line {line} beyond end of file ({len(lines)} lines)"
    return "supported" if claim_keyword in lines[line - 1] else "line exists but does not support the claim"


POLICY = {"discoverable": "investigate", "decidable": "decide within delegated authority and record it", "human": "stop and ask", "deferred": "record as a non-goal"}


def next_step(unknowns):
    steps = [(q, POLICY[c]) for q, c in unknowns]
    blocked = [q for q, c in unknowns if c == "human"]
    return steps, blocked


def changed_files(repo, base):
    out = set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", base).splitlines())
    out |= set(git(repo, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard").splitlines())
    return sorted(out)


def covered(path, prefix):
    prefix = prefix.rstrip("/")
    return path == prefix or path.startswith(prefix + "/")


def audit(files, allowed, forbidden):
    bad = []
    for f in files:
        if any(covered(f, p) for p in forbidden):
            bad.append((f, "forbidden"))
